options.en: Attempt to remotely hack into the Nexus to retrieve the location of the planetkiller

texts.en:
It is not unusual that the Remnant Nexus exchanges signals with the local comm relay. Wherever Tri-Tachyon's AI fleets linger, one finds clouds of tiny spy-sats, relays, and repeaters chirping squirts of data back and forth. Very quietly, almost enough to be lost in the background noise. But not quite.

It is not a simple thing to tap into this self-evolved network to request a very specific piece of information. You assemble your senior officers and consider your options for hacking into the Nexus
texts.zh:
余辉中枢和星系内的通讯中继站进行信号交互并不罕见。毕竟无论这些 速子科技 麾下的 AI 舰队在哪儿徘徊，都会留下如云雾般密布的间谍卫星和中继转发系统，不停地来回吞吐数据流。虽然这些都安静到几乎能被背景噪音所掩盖，但也不是完全悄然无息。

接入这样一个自我进化出来的网络里获取某个特定的信息绝非易事。你将你的上级军官召集到了一起，考虑能采取什么行动来黑入中枢。

options.en: Use Tri-Tachyon command codes to make the task possible

texts.en:
As a commissioned privateer of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, you have been given a standard set of access codes. These are old protocols, and while they've migrated away from company standards over time (due, probably, to the meddling of idle AIs), your technical officers have the skill to adapt to the unusual changes.

After hours of painstakingly crafting a request - it must be asked in precisely the correct way and have the properly mutated access codes attached - the question is asked and the answer received nearly instantly. Unnervingly so. Nonetheless, you now have navigation coordinates which should lead to the planetkiller.
texts.zh:
身为一名 三一速子科技公司 麾下的签约私掠者，你被给予了一套标准访问编码。这些协议很老旧，而且和公司标准规范渐行渐远 (也许是那些到处闲逛的 AI 们搞的鬼)，不过你的技术官们完全有能力适应此类异常变动。

由于必须附上准确转换后的访问编码，并使用非常精确无误方式进行询问，检索请求在煞费苦心地认真编写了几个小时之后才发出去，之后却几乎立即就收到了回答，让人不禁有些胆怯。但无论如何，你现在拿到了应该都能通往行星杀手所在位置的导航坐标了。

texts.en: Your comms officer is taken aback, "But $playerSirOrMadam, what-"
texts.zh: 你的通讯军官看起来大吃了一惊，"但是，$playerSirOrMadam，这 ——"

options.en: Just do it. I've got an idea.
options.zh: 就这么办。我有一个主意。

texts.en:
Your comms officer inputs the commands, a look of confusion remaining on their face.

"Their system isn't built for comms. Um, at all. But, theoretically the adaptive protocols should... could interface, if there's a proper link..."

Another tap at the controls, "The line should be open. If someone, something... is listening."

Your display shows nothing but holo-snow. Your officers fall silent, and the signal processing amplifies the buzz of cosmic background radiation to a near-audible level. There's nought but a yawning void awaiting your words.
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官输入了指令，一脸的困惑依然没有散去。

"它们的系统构造没考虑过接受通讯，呃，完全没有。但，理论上自适应协议应该...也许能进行交互，如果有合适的链接的话..."

通讯军官又在控制台上按了一下，"链接应该开启了，如果有人，有什么东西...在听着的话。"

你的显示台上除了全息雪花噪之外什么都没显示。你的军官都安静了下来，与此同时，信号处理器自顾自地把宇宙背景辐射的嗡响放大到了几乎能听见的音量水平。在这无有之处中，仿佛有片虚空正打着哈欠等着你发话。

texts.en:
You couldn't quite say how you heard the words. It was as if they were spoken without a voice. Your senior officers all take a step back from the empty holo-display, eyes wide; shocked into silence.

Your comms officer exchanges a look with you - yes, they heard it too; no, they don't know what it is. They tear their eyes away from the nothing in the holo-display and start pulling telemetry into a buffer through their datapad interface.

你的通讯军官和你交换了一个眼色，对，也听到了；不，也不知道那是什么。通讯军官将视线从空白的全息显示屏上移开，并开始用数据平板遥测缓冲区数据。

texts.en:
Although nothing appears to change in the holodisplay, you hear nothing more from the voice.

It feels, somehow, as if an animating presence has departed.

Your comms officer looks wide-eyed at you in amazement. The others' expressions range from world-weary incomprehension to barely-suppressed terror.

你的通讯军官惊讶地瞪眼看着你。其他人的表情多是掩饰不住的恐惧和疲惫的不解。

texts.en:
Their reports don't tell you anything you couldn't already guess.

The techs who were ordered to run a more paranoid than usual sweep found nothing in your $shipOrFleet's computer systems that wasn't supposed to be there - any more than usual, at least. Nothing of the telemetry recorded during your 'chat' provides anything of use.

The navigational coordinates which appeared in the comms buffer appear valid, however.

但是在你通讯缓存中出现的航行坐标看上去确实是有效的。

Hacking $aOrAn $shortName will surreptitiously provide your fleets with the same benefits as the faction that currently controls it.

The hack will eventually be picked up and cleared out by maintenance subroutines, but should remain effective for at least three months.

texts.en:
Introducing false readings into the outbound data feed is likely to distract patrols and similar fleets by making them chase what isn't actually there.

Eventually, the firmware auto-calibration routines will clean out the corruption, but the process will take at least a month.

将错误读数注入到出站数据馈送中很可能会分散巡逻队和其他类似舰队的注意力，让他们去追逐虚假目标。

最终，周期自动校准固件会清除这些错误数据，但这个过程至少需要一个月。

texts.en:
Installing a comm sniffer will give you access to local intel as if you were in this star system.

The comm sniffer will remain active until it is detected and cleared out by the comm network's maintenance subroutines. The odds of this happening increase drastically when comm sniffers are installed on multiple relays in the network.
texts.zh:
安装通讯嗅探器能使得你实时获得当地的情报，就如同你在身处于星系中一样。

通讯嗅探器将保持活动状态，直到它被通讯网络的维护子程序检测并清除掉。当通讯嗅探器被同时安装在通讯网络中的多个中继器上时，被发现清除的几率会急剧增加。

texts.en: Uninstalling this comm sniffer will reduce the overall detectability of your other sniffers by the comm network maintenance protocols.
texts.zh: 卸载这个通讯嗅探器将降低其他嗅探器被通讯网络维护协议发现的概率。

texts.en: You do not have the resources required to proceed.
texts.zh: 你没有足够的所需资源来继续。

texts.en: The operation is successful, and your sensors officer is poring over the incoming data in short order. Any nearby slipstreams will now be visible on the map.
texts.zh: 行动很成功，你的传感器技官正在尽快研究获取到的数据。附近的所有超空间滑流现在都可以在地图上阅览。

texts.en: Your crews quickly complete a physical takeover of the structure, removing automated safeguards and installing black-box transmitters tuning its output frequency to your transponder codes.
texts.zh: 你的船员迅速占领了该设施，拆除自动防护装置并安装黑箱封装的发射器，将其输出频率调整为你的应答器代码。

texts.en: Your crews quickly complete an assessment of the structure. Replacing several common burned-out components seems to bring the $shortName back to operational status.
texts.zh: 你的船员们迅速完成了对该设施的评估，更换几个常见的易损部件之后似乎就使 $shortName 恢复运行了。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from, and the sniffer script is uploaded within a few minutes.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。随后嗅探脚本也在几分钟内完成了上传。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from. Your comms officer installs the data-collection script, and confirms receipt of telemetry from the $shortName.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。通讯军官安装了数据收集脚本，并确认了能从 $shortName 上接收遥测数据。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from. Your comms officer uploads the virus, which you elect not to question the provenance of.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。通讯军官随即上传了病毒进去，而你决定不去细想后者的来源。

texts.en: A soft chime from the comms console indicates the sniffer is installed and fully operational.
texts.zh: 通讯控制台发出了轻柔的提示音，表明嗅探器已经安装并正常运作。

texts.en: A soft chime from the comms console indicates the sniffer is offline.
texts.zh: 通讯控制台发出的轻柔的提示音，表明嗅探器已经离线。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: A nearby $faction fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 一支 $faction 舰队正在追踪你的行动，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.
texts.zh: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: A nearby $faction fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 一支 $faction 舰队正在追踪你的行动，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.
texts.zh: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.

texts.en: The $shortName can be overloaded to emit a neutrino burst directly into hyperspace, providing valuable topographical readings and detecting slipstreams within $COB_burstRange light-years.
texts.zh: $shortName 能够被超载并往超空间释放一次中微子爆发，借此获取有价值的超空间地形数据，并探测 $COB_burstRange 光年范围中的超空间滑流。

texts.en: Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction and will allow another structure to be built at this location.
texts.zh: 拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war, but given the makeshift nature of the structure, it's doubtful blame would be assigned to you with full certainty.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。但鉴于该设施的临时性，不清楚他们是否将责任完全归咎于你。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and destroying this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此破坏 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction.

It's an irreplaceable Domain artifact, with a quality that nothing currently capable of being built in the Sector can match.
texts.zh:
拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

这是一个无可替代的 人之领 遗物，星域内制造的同类设备无法媲美其品质。

texts.en: Taking control of the $shortName will grant your in-system fleets and colonies the benefits it provides.
texts.zh: 控制该处的 $shortName 将会为星系中的己方舰队与殖民地提供优势。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such a takeover of vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将针对重要基础设施的接管行动视为一种战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and taking control of this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此接管 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Hacking $aOrAn $shortName will surreptitiously provide your fleets with the same benefits as the faction that currently controls it.

The hack will eventually be picked up and cleared out by maintenance subroutines, but should remain effective for at least three months.
texts.zh:
黑入 $aOrAn $shortName 将暗中地为你的舰队提供与控制势力相同的优势。

黑客程序最终会被维护子程序发现并清除，但至少能生效三个月。

texts.en:
Introducing false readings into the outbound data feed is likely to distract patrols and similar fleets by making them chase what isn't actually there.

Eventually, the firmware auto-calibration routines will clean out the corruption, but the process will take at least a month.
texts.zh:
将错误读数注入到出站数据馈送中很可能会分散巡逻队和其他类似舰队的注意力，让他们去追逐虚假目标。

最终，周期自动校准固件会清除这些错误数据，但这个过程至少需要一个月。

texts.en:
Installing a comm sniffer will give you access to local intel as if you were in this star system.

The comm sniffer will remain active until it is detected and cleared out by the comm network's maintenance subroutines. The odds of this happening increase drastically when comm sniffers are installed on multiple relays in the network.
texts.zh:
安装通讯嗅探器能使得你实时获得当地的情报，就如同你在身处于星系中一样。

通讯嗅探器将保持活动状态，直到它被通讯网络的维护子程序检测并清除掉。当通讯嗅探器被同时安装在通讯网络中的多个中继器上时，被发现清除的几率会急剧增加。

texts.en: Uninstalling this comm sniffer will reduce the overall detectability of your other sniffers by the comm network maintenance protocols.
texts.zh: 卸载这个通讯嗅探器将降低其他嗅探器被通讯网络维护协议发现的概率。

texts.en:
There's a short delay as your comms officer corrects for time-space distortion between your $shipOrFleet and your command-control center.

"Secure hyperwave link established, captain," comms reports. "Encryption is green, line open. What are your orders?"
texts.zh:
你的通讯官需要校正你的$shipOrFleet与指挥控制中心之间的时空畸变，通讯因此短暂延迟。

"加密超波链路已建立，舰长，\" 通讯官报告道，\"加密状态正常，线路畅通。请指示。"

options.en: Plan the deployment of a combat task force
options.zh: 筹划部署一支作战特遣舰队

options.en: Never mind, just testing the hardware.
options.zh: 不必了，只是测试一下设备。

texts.en: You can order a support fleet to bring any needed crew, fuel, and supplies based on an assessment of your fleet's current needs prepared by your quartermaster.
texts.zh: 你可以下令派一支补给舰队，运来所需的船员、燃料和补给；具体数量由你的军需官根据舰队当前的需求评估决定。
effects: #SetTooltip csf_small "A small fleet will bring roughly half the provisions of a medium fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_medium "A medium fleet will bring roughly twice that of a small fleet and half of a large fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_large "A large fleet will bring roughly twice the provisions of a medium fleet."

texts.en: A combat task force will assist your $shipOrFleet in battle in the target system. The fleet can be ordered to follow your own $shipOrFleet or hold a given position.
texts.zh: 一支作战特遣舰队将在目标星系协助你的$shipOrFleet作战。你可以命令它跟随你的$shipOrFleet，或驻守指定位置。
effects: #SetTooltip csf_small "A small fleet will bring roughly half the fleet-power of a medium fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_medium "A medium fleet will bring roughly twice that of a small fleet and half of a large fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_large "A large fleet will bring roughly twice the fleet-power of a medium fleet."

options.en: Call in a small supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支小型补给舰队

options.en: Call in a medium supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支中型补给舰队

options.en: Call in a large supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支大型补给舰队

options.en: Call in a small task force
options.zh: 召来一支小型特遣舰队

options.en: Call in a medium task force
options.zh: 召来一支中型特遣舰队

options.en: Call in a large task force
options.zh: 召来一支大型特遣舰队

texts.en:
"Acknowledged, $playerSirOrMadam," your quartermaster salutes then defers to your navigation officer, who asks "Where shall we meet the support fleet, captain?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"收到，$playerSirOrMadam，\" 你的军需官敬了个礼，随后把话交给领航官，后者问道：\"我们该在哪里与补给舰队会合，舰长？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam. Where do you want to send the task force?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。你想把特遣舰队派往哪里？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want the resupply fleet to meet you, captain?" $HeOrShe pulls up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想让补给舰队在哪里与你会合，舰长？" $HeOrShe在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want to send the task force, captain?" $heOrShe asks, pulling up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想把特遣舰队派往哪里，舰长？" $heOrShe一边问，一边在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en: "Yes $playerSirOrMadam," your comms officer says with a nod.
texts.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你的通讯官点头说道。

texts.en: "Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says with flawless professional grace.
texts.zh: "当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" $heOrShe以无可挑剔的职业风度说道。

texts.en: Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction and will allow another structure to be built at this location.
texts.zh: 拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war, but given the makeshift nature of the structure, it's doubtful blame would be assigned to you with full certainty.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。但鉴于该设施的临时性，不清楚他们是否将责任完全归咎于你。

texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and destroying this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此破坏 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction.

It's an irreplaceable Domain artifact, with a quality that nothing currently capable of being built in the Sector can match.
texts.zh:
拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

这是一个无可替代的 人之领 遗物，星域内制造的同类设备无法媲美其品质。

texts.en: Taking control of the $shortName will grant your in-system fleets and colonies the benefits it provides.
texts.zh: 控制该处的 $shortName 将会为星系中的己方舰队与殖民地提供优势。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such a takeover of vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将针对重要基础设施的接管行动视为一种战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and taking control of this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此接管 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Hacking $aOrAn $shortName will surreptitiously provide your fleets with the same benefits as the faction that currently controls it.

The hack will eventually be picked up and cleared out by maintenance subroutines, but should remain effective for at least three months.
texts.zh:
黑入 $aOrAn $shortName 将暗中地为你的舰队提供与控制势力相同的优势。

黑客程序最终会被维护子程序发现并清除，但至少能生效三个月。

texts.en:
Introducing false readings into the outbound data feed is likely to distract patrols and similar fleets by making them chase what isn't actually there.

Eventually, the firmware auto-calibration routines will clean out the corruption, but the process will take at least a month.
texts.zh:
将错误读数注入到出站数据馈送中很可能会分散巡逻队和其他类似舰队的注意力，让他们去追逐虚假目标。

最终，周期自动校准固件会清除这些错误数据，但这个过程至少需要一个月。

texts.en:
Installing a comm sniffer will give you access to local intel as if you were in this star system.

The comm sniffer will remain active until it is detected and cleared out by the comm network's maintenance subroutines. The odds of this happening increase drastically when comm sniffers are installed on multiple relays in the network.
texts.zh:
安装通讯嗅探器能使得你实时获得当地的情报，就如同你在身处于星系中一样。

通讯嗅探器将保持活动状态，直到它被通讯网络的维护子程序检测并清除掉。当通讯嗅探器被同时安装在通讯网络中的多个中继器上时，被发现清除的几率会急剧增加。

texts.en: Uninstalling this comm sniffer will reduce the overall detectability of your other sniffers by the comm network maintenance protocols.
texts.zh: 卸载这个通讯嗅探器将降低其他嗅探器被通讯网络维护协议发现的概率。

texts.en:
A two-spacer team rides a work drone to the relay and makes a quick hull cut to access a hard data connection. Within a minute, the snoop algorithm is set loose, the hull re-sealed, and the ops team returns.

Now you wait for it to do its work.
texts.zh:
一支两人小队驾驶着一架工作无人机来到了中继站上，快速切割其外壳以便找到可与其内部硬件连接的接口。不到一分钟后，窥探算法安装完成，中继器的外壳也被重新密封，行动小组成功返回。

现在你开始等待算法完成自己的使命。

texts.en:
After a tense hour or so, your comms officer informs you that the snoop is complete. A team of officers and specialists proficient in techops, infosec, and comms has been analyzing the snoop's data as it has come in, and have already prepared a preliminary report.

"The team is still finishing the detailed analysis and decrypting what we can," your comms officer reports, "But we've got a pretty good idea of the big picture."
texts.zh:
紧张地等待了一个小时后，通讯军官告诉你，窥探算法的工作完成了。一组精通技术操作、信息安全和通讯的军官和专家一直在逐步分析陆续接收到的信息，并已经完成了一份初步报告。

"我们的团队仍在进行详细的分析，并尽可能地对我们得到的信息进行解密。" 通讯军官报告说，"但我们已经对总体情况有了一定程度的了解。"

texts.en:
"It looks like most major factions and a few freelancers and underworld agents have been showing an anomalous level of activity in the Isirah system. There are plausible explanations for this of course, but what tipped us off was some sloppy infosec by a Pather infiltrator."

Here, your comms officer pulls up a communication ID and a League ID summary.
texts.zh:
"看起来大多数主要势力，少数自由佣兵和地下特工在 Isirah 星系中的活动频率高的异常。这可以有不少合理的解释，但根据我们的分析，这种现象大概率是一个粗心大意地泄露了不少情报的左径分子造成的。"

说到这，通讯军官拿出了一份包含了通讯 ID 和 英仙座联盟 ID 的列表。

options.zh: 这上边值得注意的是哪个人？

texts.en:
"Jensen Gallegos. All the signs of a Pather infiltrator. The ID doesn't hold up to scrutiny as you can see... er, yes captain. The big picture," they flip through some irrelevant data logs then focus again on a series of messages sent as text, "They slipped up here, mentioning Coureuse by name, though misspelled. That led us to discover a simple code system used by what appears to be a cell of Pathers operating on Laicaille Habitat."

The League ID of not-Jensen Gallegos is joined by a handful more IDs with annotated discrepancies and errors.
texts.zh:
"Jensen Gallegos，各种意义上讲都像是一名左径渗透者。如你所见，舰长，这个身份经不起仔细审查...呃，总体来说，" 他们跳过了一些无关紧要的信息，并将展示的重点放在了一系列呈现为文本的秘密信息上，"看这里，他们疏忽大意地提到了 Coureuse 的名字，虽然拼错了。这让我们发现了一个正在 Laicaille 栖息地上活动的左径组织使用的暗号系统。"

更多除了 Jensen Gallegos 以外的，被注释了差异和错误之处的 英仙座联盟 ID 被加入了 ID 列表中。

texts.en:
"Lots of communication, both text and holo. They think Coureuse is on Laicaille Habitat, but they can't get close to her, and they don't think their identities will hold up to a security check. Which is correct," your comms officer says with a touch of pride. "It sounds like they're asking home base to call in some big guns, whatever that might be. Or whoever."

The full report will be completed within the shift, but you know what you need to know: Laicaille Habitat.
texts.zh:
"这里有大量的通讯信息，包括文本和全息两种形式。他们认为 Coureuse 就在 Laicaille 栖息地上，只是这些人没能力接近她。同时他们认为他们的身份信息无法通过安全检查 —— 这倒是千真万确。" 你的通讯军官带着一丝自豪说道，"他们似乎在要求总部送来一些不得了的东西，或是派来一些狠角色。"

完整的调查报告将在轮班前完成，但你已经知道你需要知道的信息了：Laicaille 栖息地上有问题。

texts.en:
With only one piece of evidence that Coureuse is at Laicaille Habitat you're not absolutely certain it would not be dismissed as merely circumstantial if you attempted to leverage it against the authorities.

You need to find one more piece of corroborating evidence.
texts.zh:
现在只有一项证据表明 Coureuse 在 Laicaille 栖息地，如果你试图以某种方式利用它对当局提出质疑，对方可能会以这只是间接证据为由不予考虑。

你得再找一个确凿的证据。

texts.en:
With multiple pieces of evidence, you feel confident that you have sufficient leverage to confront authorities at Laicaille Habitat about Scylla Coureuse.

It is time to talk to the archon of Laicaille Habitat.
texts.zh:
现在你有了两份不同的证据，你觉得自己已经有足够的筹码去和 Laicaille 栖息地的当局就 Scylla Coureuse 的事进行对质。

是时候和 Laicaille 栖息地的执政官谈谈了。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
Tapping into a comms router involves breaking more than a handful of interfactional laws but, as you tell yourself, the circumstances are exceptional.

Ops gives a nod across the bridge, confirming that the zero-G squad has finished the physical breach of the comms relay hardware.
texts.zh:
接入一台通讯路由器，要违反的势力间法律不止一两条，不过你对自己说，眼下情况特殊。

行动长官在舰桥那头点了点头，确认零重力小队已经完成对通讯中继站硬件的实体突破。

texts.en:
"IO is green across the board, captain," your comms officer reports. Tech chimes in, "Source is spoofed to read as originating from Sindrian Diktat Command & Control."

You suspect they are both suppressing a grin.

Ops, of course, is frowning in anticipation of what is going to go wrong next.
texts.zh:
"IO 全绿，舰长，\"你的通讯官报告。技术官插话道，\"来源已伪装，读数显示发自辛达强权指挥控制中心。"

你猜这两人都在憋着笑。

行动长官自然是皱着眉，在预想接下来会出什么岔子。

texts.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
texts.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en:
"This'll take a minute," says Tech. "It's big. Don't know what Rao's cooked up, considering, uh."

With an apologetic look your tech officer shuts up and adopts a stiff at-attention posture as if to make up for the breach of protocol.
texts.zh:
"这要花上一分钟，\"技术官说，\"东西很大。考虑到眼下的情况，真不知道 Rao 都捣鼓了些什么，呃。"

你的技术军官带着歉意看了你一眼，闭上嘴，摆出一副僵硬的立正姿势，仿佛想以此弥补方才的失礼。

texts.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
texts.zh:
"好了，啊，$playerSirOrMadam，\"技术官报告道，\"确认回执为真。通讯流量很大..."

一个干脆的敬礼之后，他们退回了副行动室的岗位。

options.en: Open a link to Oxana Hyder's fleet
options.zh: 与 Oxana Hyder 的舰队建立通讯链路

texts.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

After a moment, Hyder herself appears, at attention.

A look of shock flashes across her face as she registers it is indeed you she is looking at, not a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress orbiting Sindria, as she expected.
texts.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

片刻之后，Hyder 本人出现在画面中，站得笔直。

当她看清屏幕对面确实是你，而不是她预想中那位驻守 Sindria 轨道恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅时，脸上闪过一丝震惊。

options.en: Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. We have much to discuss.
options.zh: 副星际元帅 Hyder。我们有很多事要谈。

texts.en: She swats the privacy field control, and a vague blurriness grows around her.
texts.zh: 她啪地拍下隐私场控制键，一层朦胧的模糊在她周围弥漫开来。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you all but declared yourself Supreme Executor the last time we spoke. You have no tact and less honor. You're nothing but Macario's pet imp, sent to tempt and corrupt."

"And now, what has happened? He's cut you loose? Declared you terrorist and murderer - for all I know it's true. Maybe it doesn't-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得上次谈话时，你几乎就要自封最高元首了。你毫无分寸，更无荣誉可言。你不过是 Macario 养的一只小恶魔，被派来引诱和腐蚀别人。"

"现在呢，出什么事了？他把你甩了？宣布你是恐怖分子和杀人犯——就我所知，这或许是真的。也许这并不——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you were Macario's lickspittle. Now he's cut you loose, it appears. Declared you his nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"I don't trust a word you-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得你是 Macario 的跟屁虫。现在看样子，他把你甩了。宣布你是他的死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"你说的每一个字我都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word. "Macario's lickspittle."

"I see he's cut you loose, declared you his nemesis. A terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"Now you hack our comms? Not only do you have no honor, you waste your-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。\"她把这个字吐了出来，\"Macario 的跟屁虫。"

"我看出来了，他把你甩了，宣布你是他的死敌。恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"现在你还来黑我们的通讯？你不但毫无荣誉，还白白浪费你的——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"Last we spoke you were acting as Macario's minion. Now you're declared his arch-nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. To speak with you is treason."

"Was betrayal your reward? Not that I believe Dolos, of course."

Her expression doesn't soften.

"Not the way he tells it, anyway. Were the killings just a job? Or are you another convenient Spider's patsy whose worth is spent?"
texts.zh:
"上次我们说话时，你还是 Macario 的走狗。如今你被宣布为他的头号死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。跟你说话就是叛国。"

"背叛就是你的报酬？当然，我并不相信 Dolos 的说辞。"

她的神色没有缓和。

"至少不像他说的那样。那些谋杀只是一桩差事吗？还是说，你又是蜘蛛随手用完即弃的替罪羊，价值已经耗尽？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName." She pauses, then takes a deep breath.

"I do not believe Macario. At least, I don't believe whatever has happened went the way he tells it. The entire announcement... secret heirs, after all this time?"

She looks at you, suspicious, but clearly wanting answers.
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"她顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario。至少，我不信发生的一切真像他说的那样。整场宣告...秘密继承人，过了这么久才冒出来？"

她看着你，满腹狐疑，可显然是在等一个答案。

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "...secret heirs, hidden conspiracies suddenly revealed? After all this time?"
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"...秘密继承人、暗藏的阴谋突然被揭穿？过了这么多年？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "if the files you gave me are all true..."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"要是你给我的那些档案都是真的..."

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"Much has happened. Philip, declared dead. Macario presenting this... clone of Philip as successor. Your files were real."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"发生了很多事。Philip，被宣布死亡。Macario 把 Philip 的...那个克隆体推出来当继承人。你的档案是真的。"

options.en: The existence of Andrada's clone-sons is the true part, actually.
options.zh: 不过，Andrada 有几个克隆儿子，这部分倒是真的。

options.en: The existence of Andrada's clone-sons is true, actually.
options.zh: 其实，Andrada 的克隆儿子确实存在。

options.en: They are. I've confirmed all of it.
options.zh: 都是真的。我全都核实过了。

options.en: They are. I've confirmed all of it.
options.zh: 都是真的。我全都核实过了。

texts.en:
"I don't trust a word from-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Cease the apologies, you've already interrupted. If it's critical, report!"

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you. Accusing.
texts.zh:
"那边的话我一个字都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停住了，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别再道歉了，你已经打断了。要是紧急，就报告！"

她听着，目光随之转回你身上。带着责问。

options.en: What I have to say is more important than old disagreements.
options.zh: 我要说的事，比旧日的分歧重要得多。

options.en: I should thank your underling, that was getting upsetting.
options.zh: 我倒该谢谢你的下属，刚才那场面快让人受不了了。

texts.en:
"$PlayerLastName," Hyder says with all the dignity she can recover. "No more games. If we meet again, it will be in battle."

The fire died from her voice; she doesn't care about you anymore. Something else has her worried.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerLastName，"Hyder 说话时已拾回了几分威严。"别再耍花样了。若我们再见面，那就是在战场上。"

她声音里的火气熄了；她已经不再在意你。有别的事让她忧心。

通讯切断。

texts.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam," your comms officer continues, a whisper in your ear. "Holofeed from the relay, direct from Sindria- full broadcast, priority override. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."
texts.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"通讯军官在你耳边低语着继续说，\"中继站转来的全息信号，直接从 Sindria 发来——全频道广播，最高优先级覆盖。内容筛选标记为极高关注。"

texts.en:
Horacio Caden appears on the holo.

Sweating, distraught. His eyebrows twitching.

Dolos Macario flanks him, face blank and still. To Caden's right there is space for another. Heavy banners bearing Sindrian Diktat crest and color fall behind them in velvet waves.

Caden is speaking.
texts.zh:
Horacio Caden 出现在全息影像中。

满头大汗，心神大乱。眉毛不住抽动。

Dolos Macario 立在他侧后，面无表情，静止不动。Caden 右手边空着一个位置。缀着辛达强权徽记与色彩的厚重旗帜在他们身后如天鹅绒的波纹般层层垂落。

Caden 正在讲话。

texts.en:
"-to announce that our beloved Supreme Executor," his voice catches for a moment. He proceeds. "Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, conqueror of Askonia, philosopher... teacher... died early this morning. He-"

You can almost picture it in your mind.
texts.zh:
"...宣布我们敬爱的最高元首，\"他的声音哽了一下，随即继续，\"最高元首 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮，Askonia 的征服者，哲人...导师...已于今日凌晨逝世。他——"

你几乎能在脑中勾出那幅画面。

texts.en:
* * *

The man would have brought a squad of marines, a special unit attached to the Ministry of Internal Security for "wet work".

Loyal. Compromised. And two, perhaps three, senior officers of INTSEC in full uniform. To project authority.

There'd have been signs of violence. Perhaps a streak of blood where a body was pulled away. Inconvenient witnesses or principled objectors, purged.

If they had passed any bond-workers, those would have gaped shamelessly. Their guards would have known to salute.
texts.zh:
* * *

那人会带上一队陆战队——一支隶属于内部安全部、专门干"脏活"的特种小队。

忠诚。各有把柄。还有两三名 INTSEC 高级军官，全套制服在身，用以彰显权威。

现场本该留下暴力的痕迹。也许还有一道拖走尸体时蹭出的血迹。碍事的目击者，或是讲原则的反对者，都被清除了。

要是他们路上遇到什么契约工，那些人准会毫不掩饰地张大嘴看。看守他们的工头自然也懂得敬礼。

texts.en:
The lead officer would have halted at a biometric scanner, taking a moment to input unlock authorization. The armored doors would have opened, the movement of their enormous mass like the weight of a passing age.

That officer's white hair and long black coat gave him a priestly silhouette.

The party proceeded into a bunker deep, deep within Sindria.
texts.zh:
领头的军官会在生物识别扫描仪前停下，花片刻输入解锁授权。装甲大门随之开启，那巨大门扇的移动，沉重得仿佛一个正在逝去的时代从身边碾过。

那名军官白发、黑色长外套，勾勒出一副祭司般的剪影。

一行人向 Sindria 深处、极深处的掩体行去。

texts.en:
Beyond tiers of heavy blast doors lay a luxurious receiving room. A handful of offices and a suite - grand, yet hunkered somehow under the weight of armor and miles of rock.

The party entered an antiseptic inner chamber.

A giant coffin-like vessel lay flat. An off-white sarcophagus of ceramic and intricate technology, a golden winged crest. Within lay a corpse-like figure, its body invaded by bundles of tubing and wires leading to ranks of medical machines attending their master like boxy, robotic courtiers.

A wretched echo of Leonidas' cradle in far-off Irkalla.
texts.zh:
层层厚重的防爆门之后，是一间奢华的会客厅。几间办公室和一套居所——气派非凡，却又像是被装甲与数英里岩层的重量压得伏低了身子。

一行人走进一间洁净得近乎无菌的内室。

一具巨大的棺状容器平放着。那是陶瓷与精密技术打造的灰白色石棺，镶着一枚金色翼形纹章。棺内躺着一个形如尸体的身影，躯体被成束的管线侵入，管线连向一排排医疗机器——那些方头方脑的机器如同机械廷臣，侍奉着自己的主人。

遥远 Irkalla 那具 Leonidas 的摇篮，在此处落下一个凄凉的余响。

texts.en:
The neurological monitors would have shown 100% brain death, and must have for a long time.

Nanoscale filaments inserted into the brainstem compel a facsimile of life from the decaying nervous system.

A hand gloved in black reached toward the master switch. When it closed upon the power to end life, it did not hesitate.

The white noise died to half its former volume. Just ventilation and the creak of black armor as the INTSEC marines shifted their weight, unsure of protocol.
texts.zh:
神经监测仪上显示的该是百分之百的脑死亡，而且必定已持续很久。

插入脑干的纳米级细丝，强迫那具衰败的神经系统挤出一丝生命的假象。

一只戴着黑手套的手伸向总控开关。当它握住那终结生命的权力时，没有半分迟疑。

白噪音的音量降到原先的一半。只剩通风的声响，以及 INTSEC 陆战队员挪动重心时黑色装甲的吱嘎声——他们拿不准该按什么规矩行事。

texts.en:
The body of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, Lion of Sindria, must have finally died under remorseless eyes.

* * *

Caden's next words were forgettable. He's unsteady and red-faced. In his drink, no doubt.

"My father," Hector has taken the podium; young, powerful, and confident, "was a great man."

His expression is brash. As he speaks, he sends challenging looks to each side, staring down imagined rivals.
texts.zh:
辛达强权最高元首、辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的躯体，想必终于在那双毫无怜悯的眼睛下死去了。

* * *

Caden 接下来的话没什么值得记的。他站得不稳，满脸通红。多半是喝多了。

"我的父亲，\"Hector 已走上讲台；年轻、强壮、自信，\"是一位伟人。"

他神情张扬。说话时，他朝两侧各投去挑衅的目光，像是在逼视想象出来的对手。

texts.en:
Caden is staring at his feet. Nothing is as he hoped.

Macario is the very image of poise.

"As Supreme Executor, the last of Philip's blood, pledge yourself to me! Pledge yourself as I pledge to carry on His traditions; His people, His work, His philosophy, His grand project - the Sindrian Diktat!"

Cheers erupt, pounding of fists and feet.

The display switches to a long shot - rank upon rank of officers, soldiers, navy, citizens; new subjects of the new age hail their Supreme Executor.
texts.zh:
Caden 盯着自己的脚。一切都不如他所愿。

Macario 则是镇定的化身。

"身为最高元首、Philip 最后的血脉，向我宣誓效忠！向我宣誓，正如我宣誓继承他的传统、他的人民、他的事业、他的理念、他的宏图——辛达强权！"

欢呼声爆发，拳与脚砰砰地砸着。

画面切到远景——一列列军官、士兵、海军、市民；新时代的新子民在向他们的最高元首致敬。

texts.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You flick a control surface and the image dies away.
texts.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你拨了一下控制面板，影像熄灭了。

texts.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You catch your breath, returning to the moment, and press a control surface.

The image slowly fades away.
texts.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你缓过一口气，回到当下，按下一块控制面板。

影像缓缓淡去。

texts.en: He's consolidating power. You must be ready.
texts.zh: 他在收拢权力。你必须做好准备。

texts.en: The link with Horus Yaribay re-opens. He looks pale.
texts.zh: 与 Horus Yaribay 的通讯重新接通。他脸色苍白。

texts.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Hyder.
texts.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Hyder 的通讯。

texts.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Achilles Andrada.
texts.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Achilles Andrada 的通讯。

texts.en: You take a deep breath, then open your eyes.
texts.zh: 你深吸一口气，然后睁开眼。

texts.en:
It is highly likely that this is going to become a dangerous place to be found meddling with Diktat infrastructure, and soon.

The civil war must begin when Achilles declares his claim.

Which he must, and soon.
texts.zh:
此地十有八九很快就会变成一个危险的地方：一旦被人发现你在动强权的基础设施。

内战必定会随着 Achilles 宣布继承权而开始。

而他必定会，而且很快。

texts.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Caden - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Caden——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Caden 会约束住他的舰船吗？Hyder 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

texts.en: You need to go to Yesod and contact Achilles, as Fortuna Kato requested.
texts.zh: 按 Fortuna Kato 的请求，你需要前往 Yesod，与 Achilles 取得联系。

options.zh: 重新接通与 Hyder 的通讯
重新接通与 Achilles 的通讯

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

texts.en:
The image of Hyder reforms.

She looks as if her bridge's agrav has been tuned too high.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的影像重新成形。

她看上去，像是舰桥的人工重力被调得太高了。

texts.en: "It's happening," she says distantly.
texts.zh: "开始了，"她声音飘忽地说。

texts.en: "He was just like-" Hyder shakes her head. "The files. The truth is undeniable."
texts.zh: "他简直就像——\"Hyder 摇摇头。\"那些文件。真相无可辩驳。"

texts.en: "So now a 'son' of Andrada appears. With Macario's enthusiastic backing." A sniff, then, "Caden's evidently less so."
texts.zh: "于是，Andrada 的一个'儿子'登场了。带着 Macario 满腔热情的支持。\"她哼了一声，\"Caden 显然就没那么热情了。"

options.en: I recovered files on the seven sons of Philip Andrada... (explain)
options.zh: 我找回了关于 Philip Andrada 七个儿子的文件... (解释)

options.en: Have you considered what you're going to do now? Time is short.
options.zh: 你想过接下来要怎么做吗？时间不多了。

texts.en:
"I can deploy a fleet to battle, balance my sabotaged logistics." It seems like she's speaking to herself. "This..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching. Like she can't bring herself to ask.

The next step.
texts.zh:
"我可以派一支舰队去作战，可以平衡被人动了手脚的后勤。\"听上去她像是在自言自语。\"可这个..."

Hyder 话音渐止。目光四下搜寻。像是怎么也开不了口问出来。

下一步。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

options.en: Let me be candid - Orcus Rao sent me to discover your intentions.
options.zh: 我就直说了——Orcus Rao 派我来探你的意图。

options.en: Another clone, heir, then. One could be a man of character and ability.
options.zh: 那就换个克隆体，换个继承人。总该有一个是有品性、有本事的。

options.en: Maybe a schemer. A spymaster, a sneak, a rogue. Everything you're not.
options.zh: 也许要个阴谋家。一个间谍头子、一个暗探、一个无赖。所有你不是的东西。

options.en: I suspect Macario plans to eliminate you. You've got to be ready.
options.zh: 我怀疑 Macario 打算除掉你。你得做好准备。

options.en: This is your chance! If you seize the initiative, you could become Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 这是你的机会！只要抓住先机，你就能成为最高元首。

options.en: Turn yourself over to the Hegemony. I'll get Orcus Rao's assurance of a fair trial. Maybe a deal.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。我会拿到 Orcus Rao 的保证，给你一场公正的审判。也许还能谈个交易。

options.en: Turn yourself in to the Hegemony. You'll get a fair trial, or a deal from... from Orcus Rao.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。你会得到公正的审判，或者...或者从 Orcus Rao 那里得到一个交易。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Achilles Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Achilles Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You should back Achilles Andrada. He is the better man.
options.zh: 你应该支持 Achilles Andrada。他才是更合适的人。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Hector Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Hector Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You must stand by Hector Andrada. He is the rightful heir.
options.zh: 你必须站在 Hector Andrada 这边。他才是名正言顺的继承人。

options.en: Duty and honor above all. Stand by your oath to the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 责任与荣誉高于一切。守住你对辛达强权的誓言！

options.en: I'm not here to tell you what to do. Just a warning about what is to come.
options.zh: 我不是来教你怎么做的。只是提醒你，接下来要发生什么。

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

options.en: Maybe. But his loyalty to the Hegemony is greater than his hatred for you.
options.zh: 也许。但他对霸主的忠诚，胜过对你的恨意。

options.en: It doesn't matter what he thinks. It matters what you are going to do.
options.zh: 他怎么想无关紧要。重要的是你打算怎么做。

texts.en:
She looks into the feed.

"And what good does that do me?"
texts.zh:
她望向通讯画面。

"那对我有什么好处？"

texts.en:
"Yes." She looks directly into the feed.

Uncertain. And working hard not to show it.
texts.zh:
"是。"她直直望向通讯画面。

心里没底。而且正竭力不露出来。

texts.en: "Who did you have in mind?" She looks skeptical.
texts.zh: "你心里想的是谁？"她神情怀疑。

options.en: Hercules. A historian. Young, but... he's smart, and stable.
options.zh: Hercules。一个历史学者。年轻，可是...他聪明，也稳重。

options.en: I'm, uh, not sure. It was just a thought.
options.zh: 我，呃，还没想好。只是随口一提。

texts.en:
"A historian?"

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"历史学者？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en:
"An academician."

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"一位院士？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en: "How many capital ships does he have?"
texts.zh: "他手上有多少主力舰？"

texts.en:
Her expression doesn't visibly change, but somehow Hyder looks even less impressed now than she did before.

She closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose, as if warding off an impending headache.
texts.zh:
她的表情看不出变化，可 Hyder 现在似乎比刚才更不以为然了。

她闭上眼，揉了揉鼻梁，像是在压住一场快要发作的头痛。

texts.en: She doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh: 她看上去并不以为然。

texts.en: Hyder folds her arms, giving you an impatient look.
texts.zh: Hyder 抱起双臂，不耐烦地看着你。

texts.en:
She looks entirely skeptical of the notion.

"Elaborate."
texts.zh:
她对这个说法显然满心怀疑。

"说下去。"

options.en: K-O Jove. He's a sort of information broker and spy on Qaras...
options.zh: K-O Jove。他算是 Qaras 上的情报贩子，也干间谍的活儿...

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Faro Inesis. He's... an agent, of sorts, for an arm of Tri-Tachyon. He'll do it for credits.
options.zh: Faro Inesis。他算是...速子科技某个分支机构的代理人。给星币他就办事。

options.en: Finlay Siyavong. He's a Persean League agent...
options.zh: Finlay Siyavong。他是英仙座联盟的特工...

options.en: Arnaud Iscare. He's a reputable Charterist...
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare。他是个口碑不错的宪章派...

options.en: Perhaps this wasn't such a good idea...
options.zh: 也许这主意本来就不怎么样...

texts.en:
"A criminal and a pirate, you mean," she says, interrupting. "From Qaras, a notorious and lawless gathering of spacer trash of the worst kind."

"I'll hear no more of it."
texts.zh:
"你是说，一个罪犯、一个海盗，\"她打断你。\"从 Qaras 来的——那地方声名狼藉、无法无天，聚着最下等的太空渣滓。"

"这事我不想再听了。"

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

texts.en: "The Hegemony already sentenced me for... mutiny," she speaks robotically. "They abhor mutiny, as well they should."
texts.zh: "霸主已经以...叛乱罪判过我，\"她机械地说。\"他们痛恨叛乱，这理所应当。"

options.en: Let me try. I'll speak to him, get a deal.
options.zh: 让我试试。我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。

options.en: I'll speak to him, get a deal. Anything is possible.
options.zh: 我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。什么事都有可能。

texts.en:
Hyder takes a deep breath, composing herself.

"I will hear your offer. But I agree to nothing."
texts.zh:
Hyder 深吸一口气，稳住心神。

"你的提议我可以听。但我什么都没答应。"

options.en: In the meantime, watch yourself. Macario...

texts.en:
She places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank you captain, your report will be given due consideration by the appropriate authorities. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her expression is grimly neutral.

"That will be all."
texts.zh:
她双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长。你的报告会由有关部门予以适当考虑。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

她的神情冷硬，毫无波澜。

"就到这里。"

texts.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
texts.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

texts.en:
"For credits." She can't keep the tone of disgust from her voice. "He'll be one of Tri-Tachyon's degenerate, half-mad cyborg executives, I imagine. Willing to sell anything, everything, for credits."

She leans forward. "I loathe their ilk. I'll hear no more of Faro Inesis."
texts.zh:
"为了星币。\"她语气里的厌恶掩不住。\"我猜他就是速子科技那种堕落的、半疯的改造人高管。为了星币，什么都肯卖，什么都能卖。"

她向前倾身。"我厌恶他们那一类人。Faro Inesis 的事，我不想再听了。"

texts.en:
"I know about Siyavong. He's a meddler."

She can't hide her look of disgust.

"You suggest I betray all I've sworn, to give everything to Fortuna Kato and her ilk. Degenerate, squabbling nobles."
texts.zh:
"Siyavong 我知道。他是个爱插手的家伙。"

她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"你是要我背弃自己立过的所有誓言，把一切都交给 Fortuna Kato 和她那一类人。一群堕落、只会内斗的贵族。"

texts.en:
"The League."

She can't hide her look of disgust.

"You suggest I betray all I've sworn, to give everything to those degenerate, squabbling nobles?"
texts.zh:
"联盟。"

她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"你是要我背弃自己立过的所有誓言，把一切都交给那些堕落、只会内斗的贵族？"

options.en: It's not all the gens. Some in the League believe in ideals, you know.
options.zh: 不是所有氏族都那样。联盟里也有人真心相信理想，你知道的。

options.en: No, not for the gens - do it for Achilles. Siyavong believes he serves the League.
options.zh: 不，不是为氏族——是为了 Achilles 去做。Siyavong 相信自己在为联盟效命。

texts.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

"He could be as you say," Hyder admits.

"However I have seen reports of Fortuna Kato's recent... investments. Mercenaries, warships, heavy weapons. Without Fortuna, Achilles has no fleet, no power. No chance."

"Tell me, is he the heir to Andrada or the figurehead of a League invasion?"
texts.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

"他也许真如你所说，"Hyder 承认。

"可我看过报告，Fortuna Kato 最近在...投资。雇佣兵、战舰、重型武器。没有 Fortuna，Achilles 就没有舰队、没有实力。没有胜算。"

"告诉我，他是 Andrada 的继承人，还是联盟入侵的一块招牌？"

texts.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

Hyder listens, nodding. When you finish, she asks,"And how many capital ships does he command?"
texts.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

Hyder 听着，点了点头。等你说完，她问道："那他能指挥多少主力舰？"

texts.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

Hyder listens, nodding. When you finish, she asks,"And how many capital ships does he command?"
texts.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

Hyder 听着，点了点头。等你说完，她问道："那他能指挥多少主力舰？"

options.en: As many as Gens Kato can afford, from the sounds of it. She's backing him.
options.zh: 听这意思，Kato 氏族出得起多少，他就有多少。她在给他撑腰。

options.en: As many as Gens Kato can afford, from the sounds of it.
options.zh: 听这意思，Kato 氏族出得起多少，他就有多少。

texts.en:
"So this is what Fortuna Kato has been up to. Mercenaries, hulls, heavy weapons, freelance marines. Distorting half the Core Worlds' military markets." She flashes a look, "Unofficial sources of materiel has been extremely relevant to my situation for some time, captain."

"Tell me," she says coldly. "Is your Achilles to be heir to Andrada - or the spearhead of a League invasion?"
texts.zh:
"原来 Fortuna Kato 一直在忙这些。雇佣兵、舰体、重型武器、自由陆战队。把半个核心世界的军火市场都搅乱了。"她瞟了你一眼。"舰长，非官方的物资来源，对我眼下的处境来说，已经重要了很久。"

"告诉我，\"她冷冷地说。\"你那位 Achilles，是要做 Andrada 的继承人——还是联盟入侵的矛头？"

options.en: With your support he could be his own man, not Fortuna's puppet. A true heir to Andrada.
options.zh: 有你的支持，他就能自立，不必做 Fortuna 的傀儡。做 Andrada 真正的继承人。

options.en: With your backing, the Sindrian Diktat could join the League. You'd be safe - and free.
options.zh: 有你的支持，辛达强权就能加入联盟。你会安全——而且自由。

texts.en:
"To back these... 'reformers'. It would be a betrayal."

Hyder's face is impassive. Brittle.

"I swore an oath."
texts.zh:
"支持这些...'改革派'。这是背叛。"

Hyder 面无表情。像随时会碎。

"我立过誓。"

options.en: Was that oath made to Hector?
options.zh: 那道誓是向 Hector 立的吗？

options.en: You once broke an oath to the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你曾经背弃过对霸主的誓言。

options.en: Is inertia to be the better part of valor?
options.zh: 难道坐视不动，反倒成了勇气的上策？

options.en: Then follow it! Go pledge yourself to Hector.
options.zh: 那就遵誓而行！去投效 Hector。

texts.en:
She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the perfect tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "Kindly ensure that you respect official comms protocol in the future."

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，那语气完全是上级军官打发人的腔调。\"今后请务必遵守官方通讯规程。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

texts.en:
She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the perfect tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done. Kindly keep your $shipOrFleet clear of my course."

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，那语气完全是上级军官打发人的腔调。\"要做的事还有很多。请让你的 $shipOrFleet 离我的航路远一点。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

texts.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
texts.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

texts.en:
She can't hide her look of disgust.

"Betray all I've sworn to give everything to Fortuna Kato and her ilk. To be... 'free'? Speak no more of it."
texts.zh:
她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"背弃我立过的一切誓言，把一切都交给 Fortuna Kato 和她那一类人。就为了...'自由'？别再提了。"

texts.en: "I know who Iscare is, captain. He's among the most wanted terrorists in the Askonia System."
texts.zh: "舰长，我知道 Iscare 是什么人。他是 Askonia 星系头号通缉的恐怖分子之一。"

texts.en:
"I know who Iscare is, captain. He's among the most wanted terrorists in the Askonia System - a list presently led by you, by the way."

"Did you know that he - his people - tried to assassinate me? It was a bomb," she says, tone acidic. "I'll hear no more of him."
texts.zh:
"舰长，我知道 Iscare 是什么人。他是 Askonia 星系头号通缉的恐怖分子之一——顺便说一句，那份名单现在排在第一位的是你。"

"你知道他——他的人——曾经试图暗杀我吗？用的是一枚炸弹，\"她说，语气尖刻。\"他的事我不想再听了。"

texts.en:
Her eyes dart to meet yours..

"And how should I 'be ready'? He has informants and agents everywhere. Among my crew and on my staff, no doubt."
texts.zh:
她的目光骤然迎上你的。

"那我该怎么'做好准备'？他的线人和特工无处不在。我的船员里、我的幕僚里，肯定都有。"

texts.en:
Her eyes dart to meet yours..

"And how should I 'be ready'? He has informants and agents everywhere. Among my crew and on my staff, no doubt."
texts.zh:
她的目光骤然迎上你的。

"那我该怎么'做好准备'？他的线人和特工无处不在。我的船员里、我的幕僚里，肯定都有。"

options.en: You need allies who can do what Macario does.
options.zh: 你需要能替你做 Macario 那些事的盟友。

options.en: You need allies who can protect you. And each other.
options.zh: 你需要能保护你的盟友。也能彼此保护的盟友。

texts.en: "And who would that be?"
texts.zh: "那会是谁？"

texts.en:
Hyder is taken aback.

"I cannot," she says softly.

"I cannot!" Louder.

"Askonia is not a battleship, captain. Can't you see that? Victory cannot be won by fleet action alone. I'm no... no politician, but I know enough to know that I am not a Supreme Executor."

She looks away. "I've seen what it does to a man."
texts.zh:
Hyder 愣住了。

"我不能，"她轻声说道。

"我不能！"声音更大了。

"Askonia 不是一艘战列舰，舰长。你看不出来吗？胜利不可能只靠舰队作战取得。我不是...不是政客，但我至少明白，我当不了最高元首。"

她移开目光。"我见过那个位置会把人变成什么样。"

options.en: That did not stop Philip Andrada. He made himself Supreme Executor!
options.zh: 这可没拦住 Philip Andrada。他自己当上了最高元首！

options.en: You must. Macario is going to eliminate you if you don't do something.
options.zh: 你必须这么做。你要是不动手，Macario 就会除掉你。

options.en: Then turn yourself into the Hegemony. I'll talk to Rao, a fair trial. Maybe even a deal.
options.zh: 那就向霸主自首吧。我去找 Rao 谈，争取一场公正的审判。说不定还能谈成条件。

texts.en:
"Where is he now? Dead, or as good as!"

She doesn't shout, not quite.

"And where has he left us? Askonia is a trap, a prison, fought over by clones and cronies!"
texts.zh:
"他现在在哪儿？死了，还是跟死了没两样！"

她没有喊出来。差一点。

"他给我们留下的是什么？Askonia 是个陷阱、一座监狱，一群克隆体和亲信为了它打个不停！"

options.en: I'm surprised to hear you speak like that about Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 听你这样评价 Philip Andrada，我很意外。

options.en: They don't all belong to Macario. There is Achilles, trained as a Persean League officer...
options.zh: 他们并不都归 Macario 管。还有 Achilles——他是按英仙座联盟军官的路子培养出来的...

options.en: You knew then what you know now. Back the strong - Hector Andrada.
options.zh: 你现在知道的这些，你那时就知道。那就押强者——Hector Andrada。

options.en: There's got to be something you can do.

texts.en:
"Don't pretend you're surprised for my sake, captain."

It's like something's broken in her.

"It's been like this for a long time. It's a silence that's only grown more deafening with each cycle. It's unsaid by everyone except the most ignorant dullards."
texts.zh:
"舰长，别为了照顾我装出一副吃惊的样子。"

她像是有什么地方坏掉了。

"这样已经很久了。那是一种沉默，每过一星历年，就变得更震耳。除了最愚钝的蠢货，谁都不去说破。"

texts.en:
You explain that while Hector has been misinformed by Macario concerning yourself, and likely others, he is confident and aggressive. He has Andrada's fire - his fire, steel, and determination to pursue and win victory!

Macario has surely underestimated Hector's willfulness - he will make a poor pawn for Macario's plans. But he needs help.

Your help.

And her's. Her honor, her duty, and the loyalty of the fleets of the Sindrian Diktat navy.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Hector 虽然被 Macario 灌输了关于你的错误说法，很可能还有关于别人的，但他自信，锐气逼人。他有 Andrada 的那股火——那股火、那股钢铁般的意志，以及追击并夺取胜利的决心！

Macario 显然低估了 Hector 的意志——他不会是 Macario 计划里好用的棋子。但他需要帮助。

你的帮助。

还有她的。她的荣誉、她的职责，以及辛达强权海军各舰队的忠诚。

texts.en:
You explain that Hector possesses Andrada's fire - his fire, steel, and determination to pursue and claim victory.

And although Hector has been misinformed by Macario concerning yourself, and likely others, he bears Andrada's blood and in time will wield a correct understanding of Andrada's transcendent philosophy. Macario has surely underestimated Hector's capability - he will make a poor pawn. But he needs help.

Your help.

And her's. Her honor, her duty, and the loyalty of the fleets of the Sindrian Diktat navy.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Hector 身上有 Andrada 的那股火——那股火、那股钢铁般的意志，以及追击并夺取胜利的决心。

而且，虽然 Hector 被 Macario 灌输了关于你的错误说法，很可能还有关于别人的，但他身上流着 Andrada 的血，假以时日，他会真正理解 Andrada 那套超凡的哲学。Macario 显然低估了 Hector 的能力——他不会是枚好用的棋子。但他需要帮助。

你的帮助。

还有她的。她的荣誉、她的职责，以及辛达强权海军各舰队的忠诚。

texts.en:
Hyder nods, grimly.

"An heir to Andrada. The blood of Andrada. That was in my oath, after all. A bit of poetical flourish, I once thought."

She sighs, closing her eyes.

"I could see it. If... if he can be rid of Macario's festering influence."
texts.zh:
Hyder 神情凝重地点了点头。

"Andrada 的继承人。Andrada 的血脉。我的誓言里确实有这一条。我曾经以为，那不过是句诗意的漂亮话。"

她闭上眼，叹了口气。

"我能看到那个可能。如果...如果他能摆脱 Macario 那套溃烂的影响。"

options.en: Then we're agreed. You'll back Hector.
options.zh: 那就这么说定了。你支持 Hector。

texts.en:
Her eyes open. "I swore it, did I not?"

"You, however, are officially kill-on-sight as a traitor, terrorist, and murderer."

Hyder almost sounds darkly amused. Almost.

"The only one who can rescind that order is the Supreme Executor."
texts.zh:
她睁开眼。"我发过誓，不是吗？"

"不过你就不一样了。官方已经把你定为叛徒、恐怖分子、杀人犯，格杀勿论。"

Hyder 的语气里几乎带着一丝阴沉的玩味。几乎。

"唯一能撤销那道命令的，只有最高元首。"

options.en: Unless that order was no longer in effect...
options.zh: 除非那道命令已经不再有效了...

options.en: Then I must speak with Hector Andrada.
options.zh: 那我必须去和 Hector Andrada 谈。

texts.en:
"That order was authorized by Philip Andrada, the-"

She stops herself, brow furrowed.

"Yes, I know that Philip did not himself sign the order. But Macario has such control of the executive bureaucracy... and an order authorized by the Supreme Executor cannot be revoked - except by the Supreme Executor."
texts.zh:
"那道命令是 Philip Andrada 批准的，那位——"

她收住话头，皱起眉。

"是的，我知道那道命令不是 Philip 亲笔签的。可 Macario 把行政官僚体系抓得那么紧...而最高元首授权的命令无法撤销——除非由最高元首本人来撤。"

options.en: What if the order was 'successfully' executed?
options.zh: 如果那道命令已经被'成功'执行了呢？

texts.en:
Hyder glares.

"I shall not lie. Especially not against the ultimate authority of the Supreme Executor's law."
texts.zh:
Hyder 瞪着你。

"我不会撒谎。尤其不会拿最高元首法律的至高权威来做假。"

options.en: Does the order require I be killed instantly?
options.zh: 那道命令要求立即处死我吗？

texts.en:
You receive another look of consternation.

Hyder lifts a TriPad and smashes through an unlock, then a query. She reads, rapidly, then her eyes return to the link.

"The order is built on a standard template employed against high-value terrorists." A tap and swipe. "Pre-amble is custom written for you. You know the details from Macario's speech. The list of crimes attributed to your name is... excessive."

She swipes a few times, scrolling rapidly through the document. "But the terms are boilerplate. It does not specify instant death, but 'delivery unto proper authorities such that' et cetera. And extended period of... interrogation is assumed."

Hyder looks back up at you, over the TriPad. Is that amusement?
texts.zh:
你又换来一记惊愕的目光。

Hyder 拿起一台 TriPad，飞快地解锁，随即调出一份检索。她迅速读着，目光随后回到通讯画面上。

"这道命令套的是对付高价值恐怖分子的标准模板。"她点了点，又划了一下。"开头部分是专门为你写的。细节你从 Macario 的演讲里已经知道了。挂在你名下的罪状清单...长得过分。"

她划了几下，快速翻过文件。"但条款都是套话。它没有写明要立即处死，只说'移交有关当局，以便'云云。而且还默认会有一段漫长的...审讯。"

Hyder 越过 TriPad 抬头看你。那算是在觉得有趣吗？

texts.en:
Hyder puts her hands behind her back, TriPad still held, and adopts a formal posture.

"I hereby accept the surrender of $playerName and place them into the sole authority of the Navy of the Sindrian Diktat pending prisoner debriefing, processing, and transfer made with safety arrangements appropriate to the present crisis."

"Thus order 044-25766 is fulfilled, and it shall be so communicated to the fleets and legions of the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
Hyder 把双手背到身后，TriPad 仍握在手里，摆出正式的姿态。

"本人特此接受 $playerName 的投降，并将其全权交由辛达强权海军处置，待完成战俘问询、处理，并按当前危机所需的安保安排进行移交。"

"至此，044-25766 号命令即告执行完毕，并将照此通报辛达强权的各舰队与军团。"

options.en: You're not bad at bending the rules when you put your mind to it.
options.zh: 你认真起来，钻规矩空子的本事倒不差。

texts.en: "This won't work for long," she says, voice tight. "You must contact Hector as soon as possible to... clean this up."
texts.zh: "这撑不了多久，\"她声音发紧。\"你必须尽快联系上 Hector，把这事...收拾干净。"

texts.en:
She closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath. Asserting calm.

"Macario will be controlling the new Supreme Executor's comms. As he did, in time, with Philip's."

Hyder considers for a moment, then her posture straightens. The tone of command re-enters her voice.

"Avoid the Sindrian Diktat fleets - it would not do well for the morale of the navy to be forced to report an escaped prisoner. If you've other allies, forces to marshal, some angle to play against Macario... seek them now. An opportunity shall arise to make contact with Hector when open conflict breaks out. Macario cannot personally control fleet comms in war."
texts.zh:
她闭上眼，深吸一口气。强自镇定。

"Macario 会控制新任最高元首的通讯。就像他当初一步步控制了 Philip 的一样。"

Hyder 思索片刻，随即挺直了身子。发号施令的语气又回到她声音里。

"避开辛达强权的舰队——要是海军被迫上报囚犯脱逃，对士气可不是好事。如果你还有别的盟友、有能调动的兵力、有能用来对付 Macario 的门路...现在就去找。等公开冲突爆发，与 Hector 接触的机会自然会出现。战时的舰队通讯，Macario 没法亲自控制。"

options.en: How will I know it is time?
options.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候是时机？

texts.en:
She is silent, but after a moment it comes to her.

"When the League-backed pretender makes his claim," she says. "As soon he must."
texts.zh:
她沉默着，但片刻之后，答案自己浮了上来。

"等那个有联盟撑腰的人出来争继承权的时候，\"她说。\"他迟早必须这么做。"

texts.en:
She is silent, but after a moment it comes to her.

"When the League-backed pretender makes his claim," she says. "As soon he must."
texts.zh:
她沉默着，但片刻之后，答案自己浮了上来。

"等那个有联盟撑腰的人出来争继承权的时候，\"她说。\"他迟早必须这么做。"

texts.en:
Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the confident tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done."

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的站姿。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，语气笃定，带着指挥官办公室里惯有的那种送客口吻。\"还有许多事等着办。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

texts.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
texts.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

texts.en:
"Don't," she spits.

"This won't work for long," she says, voice tight. "You must contact Hector as soon as possible to... clean this up."
texts.zh:
"别说了，"她厉声道。

"这撑不了多久，\"她声音发紧。\"你必须尽快联系上 Hector，把这事...收拾干净。"

texts.en:
She nods, slowly. Pensive.

"Macario will be controlling the new Supreme Executor's comms. As he did, with time, Philip's."

Hyder considers for a moment, then her posture straightens. The tone of command enters her voice.

"Avoid the Sindrian Diktat fleets - we have our orders and will follow them to the death. If you've other allies, forces to marshal, some angle to play against Macario... seek them out. An opportunity will arise to make contact when open conflict becomes inevitable. Macario cannot personally control fleets comms in a time of war."
texts.zh:
她缓缓点头。若有所思。

"Macario 会控制新任最高元首的通讯。就像他当初随着时间推移，控制了 Philip 的一样。"

Hyder 思索片刻，随即挺直了身子。发号施令的语气回到她声音里。

"避开辛达强权的舰队——我们有自己的命令，会至死执行。如果你还有别的盟友、有能调动的兵力、有能用来对付 Macario 的门路...就去找他们。等公开冲突变得不可避免，接触的机会自然会出现。战时的舰队通讯，Macario 没法亲自控制。"

options.en: How will I know it is time?
options.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候是时机？

texts.en:
"Is he?" She looks defensive.

"And if he is - how can I fight informants, agents, assassins. He's bribed or blackmailed someone in every senior staff and ministry."

"Fleet armaments can't fight that war."
texts.zh:
"是吗？"她神情戒备起来。

"就算真是这样——我又怎么去对付线人、特工、刺客。每个高级幕僚班子、每个部里，都有人被他收买或要挟。"

"舰队火力打不了这场仗。"

options.en: You need allies. Allies who can do what Macario does.
options.zh: 你需要盟友。能替你做 Macario 那些事的盟友。

texts.en:
"After all of these... spy-games, that's what you have to say?"

She looks aside, distressed and annoyed.

"Honor, yes. I have upheld it through all, against schemers and traitors on all sides. Now a new-declared Supreme Executor, and soon another, no doubt. Which Sindrian Diktat shall I serve?"

Hyder turns to you.

"And why should I speak to you of such things? You've been nothing but a harbinger of chaos."
texts.zh:
"闹了这么多...间谍把戏，你就给我这一句？"

她移开目光，既烦躁又苦恼。

"荣誉，对。我自始至终都守着它，对抗四面八方的阴谋家和叛徒。如今又有人自立为最高元首，而且毫无疑问，很快还会有下一个。我该效忠哪一个辛达强权？"

Hyder 转向你。

"再说，我凭什么跟你谈这些？你从头到尾只会带来混乱。"

texts.en:
"Yes." She nods, not looking into the feed. "Of course."

She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the confident tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done."

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
"是。\"她点点头，目光没有看向通讯画面。\"当然。"

她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的站姿。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，语气笃定，带着指挥官办公室里惯有的那种送客口吻。\"还有许多事等着办。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

texts.en:
"I am disappointed," she says, voice going distant. A commander ordering a squad to certain death. "You approach me with critical information, and then - confusion. More underhanded schemes, half-truths."

"Is this yet another Macario scheme?" Her head tilts, just slightly. "I'm not even sure you would know it is, if it is. It would explain a lot. Everything, perhaps."
texts.zh:
"我很失望，\"她说道，声音渐渐疏远。像一位指挥官在下令让小队去送死。\"你带着关键情报来见我，结果却是——混乱。更多的暗地算计、半真半假的话。"

"这又是 Macario 的一场算计吗？\"她的头微微一偏。\"我甚至不确定，若真是如此，你自己会不会知道。这能解释很多事。也许能解释一切。"

options.en: Look, I'm just trying to help you. It isn't easy.
options.zh: 听着，我只是想帮你。这不容易。

options.en: Your paranoia is playing right into Macario's hands. This is what he wants!
options.zh: 你的偏执正合 Macario 的心意。这正是他想要的！

options.en: If that's what you think, I'll leave you to your own devices.
options.zh: 既然你这么想，那就随你自便吧。

texts.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

texts.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

texts.en:
You tell of extracting the encrypted files meant for Dolos Macario from the head of a courier (deceased) floating in space after a mercenary destroyed their transport on the fringe of the Askonia system.

And the contents: seven sets of reports on seven clones of Andrada hidden in seven systems spread across the Persean Sector.

You describe the details. Hyder's expression is closed.
texts.zh:
你讲起事情的经过：一名信使的运输船在 Askonia 星系边缘被雇佣兵击毁，你从漂浮在太空中的那具遗体上取出了本该交给 Dolos Macario 的加密文件。

还有文件的内容：七组报告，关于七个 Andrada 的克隆体，被藏在英仙座星域各处七个星系里。

你详述了细节。Hyder 面无表情。

texts.en:
"I don't trust you," she says, voice level.

"And most of all I don't trust Macario. I have no reason to believe this isn't another of his games."

She crosses her arms.
texts.zh:
"我不信你，"她说道，声音平板。

"而我最不信的是 Macario。我没有理由相信这不是他又一场把戏。"

她抱起了双臂。

texts.en:
"Though I respect your word as an officer," she says, "I would be remiss not to confirm the alleged contents of these files myself."

She crosses her arms.
texts.zh:
"尽管我尊重你身为军官的保证，\"她说道，\"但若不亲自核实这些文件所称的内容，就是我的失职。"

她抱起了双臂。

options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

options.en: You're going to have to take my word for it, $rank.
This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
options.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。
把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

texts.en:
"Hold a moment, captain."

She takes a few minutes, scrolling rapidly through files. Rapidly assessing new intel as a trained combat officer must. Her frown only deepens.

A sign, you think, that she might believe these are real.

She sets her TriPad down and looks back through the comms, distantly. As if staring across light-years.
texts.zh:
"等一下，舰长。"

她花了几分钟，飞快地翻动文件。以一名训练有素的战斗军官应有的方式，迅速评估着新情报。她的眉头越皱越紧。

你觉得，这是个迹象——她或许相信这些都是真的。

她放下 TriPad，隔着通讯望回来，目光遥远。像是在凝视数光年之外。

texts.en:
"It is... disturbing." She looks away.

"Heirs of Andrada. Plots and schemes. A battle for spies, assassins, and," a look of disgust, "politicians."

Her eyes snap to yours. "How much of this have you personally confirmed?"
texts.zh:
"这...令人不安。"她移开了目光。

"Andrada 的继承人。阴谋与算计。一场由间谍、刺客，还有，\"她露出厌恶的神色，\"政客来打的战争。"

她的目光猛地转向你。"这些，你亲自核实了多少？"

options.en: None of it, yet. I came to you first.
options.zh: 一个都还没核实。我先来找的你。

texts.en: A quick nod. She unfocuses from you, thinking. For a moment.
texts.zh: 她迅速点了点头，目光从你身上散开，思索着。只片刻。

texts.en: A slow nod. She takes a moment to assemble her thoughts.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头，花了一会儿整理思绪。

texts.en:
"I risk much to even speak of this subject. I need one hundred percent confirmation from you before this goes any further."

She sets her TriPad aside, then places her hands behind her back in formal posture.

"Thank you captain. That will be all."
texts.zh:
"光是谈论这件事，我就已经冒了极大风险。在事情继续推进之前，我需要你百分之百的确认。"

她把 TriPad 放到一旁，随后双手背到身后，摆出正式的仪态。

"谢谢你，舰长。就这样吧。"

options.en: Watch your back. Macario is going to make a move sooner or later.
options.zh: 小心背后。Macario 迟早会动手。

options.en: Remember that I gave you this. That it's me trying to protect you.
options.zh: 记住，这是我把机会给你的。是我在想办法保护你。

texts.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

texts.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

texts.en: She doesn't react for a moment.
texts.zh: 她一时没有反应。

texts.en: She doesn't react for a moment. As if an underling made an error and she's providing a chance for self-correction.
texts.zh: 她一时没有反应。像是在等一名下属自己纠正错误。

texts.en:
"Your word is not enough. If you're lying, or wrong... that is treason."

Her expression only cools.

"Treason is death."
texts.zh:
"你的话不够。如果你在撒谎，或者搞错了...那就是叛国。"

她的神情只是更冷了。

"叛国，就是死。"

options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

options.en: It's the best I can do. Trust me.
options.zh: 我只能做到这一步。相信我。

options.en: This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
options.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。

texts.en:
"I cannot," she says with cold finality.

"Do not contact me again. Hyder out."

The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
"我不能，"她说道，冷硬而决绝。

"不要再联系我。Hyder 完毕。"

通讯骤然中断。

texts.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"Threatening an officer is a capital crime, captain. I've been far too lenient in indulging your treasonous paranoia."

"No more chances. Vacate this orbit."

"Hyder out." The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
她眯起了眼睛。

"威胁一名军官是死罪，舰长。我对你那套叛国式的偏执，实在太过纵容了。"

"没有下一次了。离开这条轨道。"

"Hyder 完毕。"通讯骤然中断。

texts.en:
"Captain, I've only just watched this... clone announces himself as Supreme Executor. This is..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching.
texts.zh:
"舰长，我刚看着这个...克隆体自称最高元首。这简直..."

Hyder 没有说下去。目光游移，像是在搜寻什么。

texts.en:
Achilles re-appears.

There's more color in his face than you've seen before, and he's breathing heavily - but steadily. Controlled.

This might be what passes for anger, even rage, in him.
texts.zh:
Achilles 再次出现在通讯画面中。

他脸上涨起的血色比你以往见过的都浓，呼吸粗重——但很平稳。克制住了。

在他身上，这大概就算是愤怒，甚至是暴怒了。

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer giving rapid orders. "My staff shall contact you. An invitation."

A pause, and he adjusts his tone, remembering that he ought to be polite in a moment in which he does not exactly outrank you. Yet.

"I would... invite you to attend."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官下达急令时那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。"

一顿。他调整了语气，想起此刻自己其实并不比你高一级——暂时还不。

"我... 想邀请你出席。"

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. I would... invite you to attend."

"I ask no oath, no pledge. Only your presence."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。我... 想邀请你出席。"

"我不要誓言，也不要承诺。只要你人到场。"

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

texts.en:
He produces a brief and joyless smirk, then you can see his eyes and his attention shifting elsewhere.

"I have much to do," he says, and reaches for his interface.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他扯出一个短促、毫无喜色的笑，随后你眼看着他的目光与注意力转向了别处。

"我还有很多事要办，"他说着，伸手去按他的界面。

通讯中断。

texts.en:
You cut the comms.

True to his word, an invitation arrives shortly thereafter. A ceremony - unspecified - is to be held on a warship held in a Gens Kato-owned spacedock.

Quite soon.

They must have been waiting, and ready. The Gens Kato strategists allowed Hector to make the first move - and had contingencies prepared for whatever form it took.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯。

他说到做到，邀请很快就到了。一场仪式——细节未明——将在一艘停泊于 Kato 氏族名下太空船坞的战舰上举行。

就在不久之后。

他们一定早有准备，一直在等。Kato 氏族的谋士们任由 Hector 先动手——并为他可能采取的任何形式都备好了后手。

texts.en:
Some hours later, you (and your bodyguards) step off your shuttle wearing your finest uniforms.

An attendant in Gens Kato livery meets you, reading instructions off a datapad.

"Um, $titlePL $PlayerName? $PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, you and your, uh, party; if you could please come with me?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你 (带着你的保镖) 走下穿梭机，穿着你最体面的制服。

一名穿着 Kato 氏族服饰的侍从迎上来，一边从数据板上读着指示。

"呃，$titlePL $PlayerName？$PlayerSirOrMadam。对，就是你和你的，呃，随行人员；请跟我来好吗？"

texts.en:
You follow the attendant to the spacedock, then through a luxuriously spacious access bridge into a large hangar within a warship.

Lines of fighters and munitions ready to be loaded dominate a crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians. More are streaming in by the minute, led to their positions by flustered attendants.

Most are wearing uniforms - an odd design to your eyes, as if the ghost army of some long-lost battlegroup appeared out of deep space. Looking closer, you see something of the utilitarian League Armada fit done up with tyrian trim on off-white field with gold touches.
texts.zh:
你跟着侍从走向太空港，穿过一条宽敞得近乎奢华的连接廊桥，进入一艘战舰内的大机库。

成排待装的战机与弹药横在眼前，抢尽了一群军官、船员、陆战队员与技师的风头。每一分钟都有更多人涌进来，被手忙脚乱的侍从领到各自的位置。

大多数人穿着制服——在你眼里式样古怪，仿佛某支早已湮没的战斗群的幽灵大军从深空里冒了出来。再细看，你辨认出几分联盟舰队那种实用主义的剪裁，只是配上了泰尔紫的镶边，米白的底子上缀着金色点缀。

texts.en:
You're led to a section of VIPs and their associates - dominated by Gens Kato, but with many notable client gens. Businessfolk of many worlds, glowering mercenaries, and a proud but more humbly dressed group set along the corridors with the best access from softly buzzing camera drones - refugees of Askonia, primarily Opis.

A bold association.

You are feted with drinks and snacks, the attention of VIPs, and the lingering look of more than a few media drones. The chatter grows to a respectable din. Speculation directed toward an empty stage at one end of the hangar.

The lights dim, and the chatter subsides.
texts.zh:
你被领到贵宾及其随从的区域——Kato 氏族的人占了多数，但也有不少显赫的附庸氏族。来自多个世界的商人、面色阴沉的雇佣兵，还有一群神情骄傲却衣着朴素的人，站在位置最好、能让嗡鸣的摄像无人机顺畅取景的廊道边——他们是 Askonia 的难民，多数来自 Opis。

这一手相当大胆。

酒水点心款待着你，贵宾们围着你说话，还有不止一架媒体无人机久久地打量你。交谈声渐渐汇成一片体面的喧响。种种猜测都指向机库尽头那座空着的舞台。

灯光暗下，喧响平息。

texts.en:
A lone figure emerges as a shadow into the bright spotlight. Judicious application of muffling fields ensures an awed hush.

Achilles Andrada stands, eyes cast downward, face in shadow for a long moment. You can feel the tension build.
texts.zh:
一个孤身的人影自暗处走入明亮的聚光。消音场开合得恰到好处，压出一片敬畏的静默。

Achilles Andrada 站定，垂着眼睛，面孔在阴影里停留了很久。你能感觉到紧张在积聚。

texts.en:
"My father," he begins. "Was a man who showed many faces. A war hero." The muffling field adjusts to let am uneasy murmur through, then asserts itself to allow the next words. "-And the Hegemony's greatest traitor."

"He was a ruthless man. A genius, and to some, a monster. As great and terrible as a force of nature; the iron hand of history set in motion."

"Above all, he was a visionary."
texts.zh:
"我的父亲，"他开口道，"是个有许多副面孔的人。一位战争英雄。"消音场稍稍放开，让一阵不安的低语透了出来，随即又重新压住，为接下来的话留出空隙。"——也是霸主最大的叛徒。"

"他是个无情的人。一个天才，在某些人眼里则是怪物。如自然之力般伟大而可怖；是历史被启动时的那只铁手。"

"而最重要的，他是个有远见的人。"

texts.en:
Achilles stares out at the crowd, his gaze directed at some elevated point. A practiced pose.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat rotted under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
Achilles 望向人群，目光却落在某处高点上。一个练熟了的姿势。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权在那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手里烂掉了。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection.

"A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。"他的手势压下了所有异议。

"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing in the carefully arranged lighting. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光在精心布置的灯光里锋利逼人。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

texts.en:
"I shall be the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I shall be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; I ask only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"Andrada 的继承人，理应是我！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

texts.en:
The lighting shifts subtly, illuminating the hangar. As if on cue, the crowd cheers.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
灯光悄然变换，照亮机库。人群仿佛接到了信号，齐声欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。
