texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

texts.en:
Your bodyguards clear a path through the excited crowd - now given free license to pop the lids off pressurized drink capsules. You suspect the medics will be busy administering remedies come the end of next shift.

You step back onto your shuttle, already receiving updates from Tactical about massive fleet movements in close orbit.
texts.zh:
你的保镖在兴奋的人群中开出一条路——这些人如今获准随意拧开加压饮料罐的盖子。你估计，到下一班结束时，军医们要忙着分发解酒药了。

你回到穿梭机上，战术部门已经在不断发来近轨道大规模舰队调动的通报。

texts.en:
You close the invitation, preferring to keep your association just a little more covert.

It's a clever move, trying to have you attend the ceremony. Without saying a word it would create an image of your full support as a subordinate to Achilles Andrada. It would grant him your legitimacy - or, failing that, at least an appearance of commanding your potency.
texts.zh:
你关掉了邀请，宁可让你与他的关联再隐蔽一些。

这步棋很聪明：让你出席仪式，不必说一个字，就能造出你完全支持 Achilles Andrada、且甘居其下的形象。这会让他借到你的正统性——即便不成，至少也显得他能号令你这份力量。

texts.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.
texts.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯官。

texts.en:
"I think you're going to want to see this," they say. "Another signal flagged high interest by the content sweep."

A pause, a concerned look.

"Sindrian Diktat priority override codes, but... loc-tag says it's from the Zagan system?"
texts.zh:
"我想你最好看看这个，\"对方说，\"内容筛查又标出一条高关注度信号。"

一阵沉默，一副担忧的神色。

"辛达强权的优先级覆盖码，可是...定位标签显示它来自 Zagan 星系？"

texts.en:
"So there it is." Rao's got a smile on his face. "The civil war just turned hot. Couldn't ask for better timing, because next comes my favorite part."

He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "Taking out hostiles."
texts.zh:
"来了。\"Rao 脸上挂着笑。\"内战已经打成热战了。这时机再好不过，因为接下来是我最喜欢的环节。"

这次他没看数据板。"清除敌对目标。"

texts.en:
"I'm jealous, $titleHeg, because you get an opportunity to see some action."

"Get out there and hit as many patrols and convoys as you can. Don't care if they claim to follow the traitor Philip or any one of his clones - they're all targets. And if you can get in and raid key facilities, even better. Anything bearing those purple wings is fair game."
texts.zh:
"我羡慕你，$titleHeg，因为你有机会真刀真枪干一场。"

"出去，能打多少巡逻队和运输队就打多少。别管他们声称效忠叛徒 Philip 还是他哪一个克隆体——全是目标。要是还能钻进去突袭关键设施，那就更好。凡带着那对紫色翼徽的，都可以打。"

texts.en:
"My quartermaster will release more fuel and supplies to your tender care. I trust you'll put them to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
texts.zh:
"我的军需官会再拨一批燃料和补给，交给你照管。我相信你会让它们用在杀叛军上。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

texts.en:
"My quartermaster will release some fuel and supplies to a storage bay assigned to you, on Ragnar Complex. I trust you'll put what you can in the hands of our Charterist friends - remember, Nortia - and otherwise set to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
texts.zh:
"我的军需官会拨一批燃料和补给到 Ragnar Complex 上划给你的一间仓储舱。我相信你会把能匀出来的部分交到我们宪章派朋友手里——记住，Nortia——剩下的就用来杀叛军。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

texts.en:
"I'm not releasing more fuel and supplies," he says.

"You've already got the stocks meant for the Charterists and I want them put to work killing mutineers one way or another."

His expression goes hard. "Is that understood?"
texts.zh:
"我不会再拨燃料和补给了，"他说。

"本来要给宪章派的那批库存已经在你手上，我要它们不管走哪条路，都用在杀叛军上。"

他的神情硬了起来。"听明白了吗？"

options.en: Look - I have a fleet. I can put those supplies to better use than the Charterists.
options.zh: 听我说——我有一支舰队。那批补给交给我，比给宪章派用得更好。

texts.en:
"Any more rebels, give 'em a little help, but not too much. And if you've got any more connections with unpleasant people, now's the time to call them in. We want to see the Sindrian Diktat fall, $titleHeg."

"Then the Phoenix will do what it does best and rise from the ashes, or whatever line the propaganda department is coming up for this one."

He tosses the datapad onto his desk. "That's it."

"Any questions? No?" He doesn't wait for you to interject. "Good. See you at the victory parade."
texts.zh:
"再碰上别的叛军，就给他们一点帮助，别太多。你要是还认识什么不三不四的人，现在正是把他们叫来的时候。我们要看到辛达强权倒下，$titleHeg。"

"然后凤凰会做它最擅长的事，从灰烬里重生——或者宣传部这回又想出什么说辞。"

他把数据板扔到桌上。"就这些。"

"还有问题吗？没有？\"他没等你插话。\"很好。胜利阅兵见。"

texts.en:
"Does it look like we care?" he growls.

"If I wanted a deranged mercenary with authority issues to steal all the glory, I'd have put the reserve fleet directly under your command. But you might be surprised that opinions both popular and elite among the Core worlds view your type somewhat dimly compared to the 'freedom fighters' from a rich little moon that got blown to gravel by the psychotic arch-traitor."

He raises a single finger.

"And don't mistake this for a conversation. I'm telling you this out of the respect from one warrior to another."

The hand lowers. "Moving on."
texts.zh:
"你看我们像在乎吗？"他低吼道。

"我要真想找一个满脑子不服管、还疯疯癫癫的雇佣兵来抢光所有功劳，早就把预备舰队直接拨到你手下了。可你也许想不到，核心世界的民意和精英，看你们这号人都不怎么顺眼——特别比起那颗富庶小卫星上出来的'自由斗士'。那颗卫星可是被那个疯魔的超级叛徒炸成了一地碎石。"

他竖起一根手指。

"别把这当成商量。我告诉你这些，是出于一个战士对另一个战士的尊重。"

那只手放下了。"继续。"

texts.en: He nods, barely acknowledging your words.
texts.zh: 他点了点头，几乎没对你的话作出回应。

texts.en: He nods, either too distracted or not caring to acknowledge any hint of falsehood.
texts.zh: 他点了点头——要么是太分心，要么是根本不屑于去察觉你话里的虚假。

texts.en: "Well," he says. "These are becoming interesting times, are they not?"
texts.zh: "嗯，\"他说，\"这日子是越来越有趣了，不是吗？"

texts.en:
You lay out Fortuna Kato's plan to back Achilles as the heir to the (presumably) dead or near-death Philip Andrada, win the ensuing civil war, then invite a reformed Sindrian Diktat into the Persean League in order to shift power away from Gens Hannan.

Horus is largely silent as you speak, only asking an occasional clarifying question or confirming a point of fact.

For all his aristocratic demeanor, he is no fool.
texts.zh:
你把 Fortuna Kato 的计划摊开来讲：扶 Achilles 上位，做那个 (想必已经死了、或者只剩一口气的) Philip Andrada 的继承人，赢下随后那场内战，再把一个改革后的辛达强权请进英仙座联盟，好把权力重心从 Hannan 氏族手里挪开。

你说的时候，Horus 大体上沉默不语，只是偶尔问一句以求厘清，或确认某个事实。

别看他一副贵族做派，他可不是傻子。

texts.en:
And Horus frowns. More.

"Fortuna presents a difficult position," he says.

"This explains much of her recent activity - hiring mercenaries, weapons purchases, stockpiling fuel in Yesod, of all places. All through fronts, naturally, but the Gens always have informants upon one another."

He rubs his chin.

"Reynard is sure to react. He wouldn't simply let her achieve such a maneuver unopposed. No doubt Fortuna expects his reaction." He looks to you again, "You may be acting out her counter-plan."
texts.zh:
Horus 皱起了眉。皱得更深了。

"Fortuna 把我摆到了一个难办的位置上，"他说。

"这就解释了她最近许多动作——雇雇佣兵、买武器、把燃料囤在 Yesod 这种地方。当然，全是通过中间人办的，可各氏族向来都在彼此身边安着眼线。"

他搓着下巴。

"Reynard 一定会反应。他不会就这么让她从容走完这步棋。Fortuna 无疑也算准了他的反应。\"他又看向你，\"你说不定正在替她走那步反制。"

texts.en: "She meant for you to speak to me," Horus says. "Did she not? It conveys a certain message in a certain way."
texts.zh: "她本就是要你来跟我谈，\"Horus 说，\"不是吗？这么做，本身就在以某种方式传达某种讯息。"

texts.en:
"Firstly it implies a diminishment. She could have simply contacted me herself as a sign of respect. But it may also serve as an affordance which concedes to me a greater range of response. Were I to deny her in a direct negotiation, it might close the door of possibility upon certain concessions due to a perceived loss of face. So in another sense, she is requesting terms. A counter-proposal."

He appears to consider the possibilities in a signalling-game perhaps too subtle for an outsider to the Gens system to quite appreciate.

Or he's overthinking it.
texts.zh:
"首先，这等于把我看低了一层。她本可以亲自联络我，以示尊重。但这同时也可能是一种姿态，等于主动给了我更大的回旋余地。倘若我在直接谈判中拒绝她，那么由于她自觉失了颜面，某些让步的大门也许就此关死。所以换个角度看，她是在开条件。是一份反提案。"

他似乎正在推演一场信号博弈里的种种可能——那微妙之处，氏族体系之外的人恐怕难以体会。

又或者，是他想多了。

texts.en:
"Firstly it implies a diminishment. She could have simply contacted me herself as a sign of respect. But it may also serve as an affordance which concedes to me a greater range of response. Were I to deny her in a direct negotiation, it might close the door of possibility upon certain concessions due to a perceived loss of face. So in another sense, she is requesting terms. A counter-proposal."

He is staring into space, considering the possibilities contained in a signalling-game perhaps too suble for an outsider to the Gens system to quite appreciate.

Or he's overthinking it.
texts.zh:
"首先，这等于把我看低了一层。她本可以亲自联络我，以示尊重。但这同时也可能是一种姿态，等于主动给了我更大的回旋余地。倘若我在直接谈判中拒绝她，那么由于她自觉失了颜面，某些让步的大门也许就此关死。所以换个角度看，她是在开条件。是一份反提案。"

他望着虚空出神，推敲着那场信号博弈里的种种可能——那微妙之处，氏族体系之外的人恐怕难以体会。

又或者，是他想多了。

texts.en:
"Of course," he says after a long pause, "this means Achilles will make a counter-declaration."

He looks at you through the link. "Very soon."
texts.zh:
"当然，\"他沉默良久才开口，\"这意味着 Achilles 也会发表一份针锋相对的声明。"

他隔着链路看着你。"很快。"

Is it possible you are overthinking this?
options.zh: 有没有可能，是你想得太多了？

texts.en: He looks up, almost grateful. "Perhaps, $titlePL. Perhaps."
texts.zh: 他抬起头，几乎是带着感激。"也许吧，$titlePL。也许。"

texts.en:
"It is possible that Gens Yaribay's interests align with Kato's on this matter, but I shall need consult with my advisors and begin negotiations."

"Nonetheless, I appreciate that you have contacted me about this matter." He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Let us speak again when the situation develops further."

Horus looks up over his TriPad at you.

"For now, $titlePL, I shall bid you fare-well."
texts.zh:
"在这件事上，Yaribay 氏族的利益也许和 Kato 家一致，但我需要和顾问们商议，还要开始谈判。"

"尽管如此，我很感谢你就这件事联系我。\"他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"等局势再有发展，我们再谈。"

Horus 从 TriPad 上方抬头看你。

"眼下就先这样，$titlePL，祝你安好。"

texts.en:
This earns you a fleeting smile.

"Without a doubt," he admits. "But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
texts.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"毫无疑问，\"他承认道。\"但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

texts.en:
This earns you a fleeting smile.

"It is no failing or deficiency on your part, $titlePL," he concedes. "Possibly quite the opposite. But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
texts.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"这不是你的过失或欠缺，$titlePL，\"他让步道。\"也许恰恰相反。但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution."

"Gens politics are never quite what they seem."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。"

"氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。"

texts.en:
"Achilles, then." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution. Gens politics are never quite what they seem. And when you become entangled with the League, the Gens are unavoidable."
texts.zh:
"那就 Achilles。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。而一旦你跟联盟牵扯上关系，氏族就避不开了。"

texts.en:
"Reynard." That got his attention.

Horus looks at you, expression dim.

"Do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise. And it is possible that Reynard offers stability against Fortuna's... adventurism. On the other hand, Gens politics are never quite what they seem. I advise caution."

"Nonetheless, you have my thanks for what you have done for me 'til now."
texts.zh:
"Reynard。"这话让他抬起了头。

Horus 看着你，神情黯淡。

"你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求。也许 Reynard 能带来稳定，制衡 Fortuna 的...冒险主义。可另一方面，氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。我劝你谨慎。"

"不管怎样，我感谢你至今为我做的一切。"

texts.en:
"I shall need consult with my advisors and begin certain negotiations, much as Fortuna has done already."

He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Perhaps we shall soon speak again upon this; for now, I bid you fare-well."
texts.zh:
"我需要和我的顾问们商议，并着手一些谈判——Fortuna 已经先走了一步。"

他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。"或许我们很快会再谈这件事；眼下，我祝你安好。"

texts.en: "Mm," he says, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "You have my thanks for the service you have done Gens Yaribay, $titlePL. I bid you fare-well."
texts.zh: "嗯，\"他说着，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"你为 Yaribay 氏族做的事，我记下了，$titlePL。祝你安好。"

texts.en:
"Sides, sides, hm," he rubs his chin. "There are many forces at work here, $titlePL. Many perspectives to consider."

"I'm, I'm-" Horus coughs and clears his throat, then is discouraged to find that the question has become no easier to answer.

"Perhaps I shall take a cautious approach," he concludes. "Wait and see in order to act at an appropriate time."
texts.zh:
"站边，站边，嗯，\"他搓着下巴，\"这里头有许多股力量在动，$titlePL。要考虑的立场太多了。"

"我，我——"Horus 咳了一声，清清嗓子，随即沮丧地发现这个问题并没有变得更好回答。

"也许我该走稳妥的路子，\"他最后说，\"先看着，等到合适的时机再动手。"

texts.en:
At once, his jaw tightens in anger, and he almost speaks.

But after a moment he releases a breath, appearing to accept the validity of your criticism.

"You are correct," hey says, eyes closed, "$titlePL. It is my burden and duty to lead."
texts.zh:
他的牙关一下子咬紧，怒意上涌，几乎就要开口。

可过了片刻，他吐出一口气，似乎接受了你的批评确有它的道理。

"你说得对，\"他闭着眼说，\"$titlePL。领导是我的重负，也是我的职责。"

texts.en:
He takes a deep breath.

"This appears to be turning into a Second Askonia Crisis. And I fear it is an opportunity to work toward the goal I have elaborated previously - to take a step, perhaps, toward bringing the Persean Sector together."

"Reconciliation with the Hegemony," he says softly.

Horus looks through the link. "It is you that provided me with what I needed - a direct, secure line of communication with the High Hegemon. And now I am presented with the opportunity where concrete action can be taken. It feels like a cliff, but... to fly, you must believe."

"Thank you, $titlePL." He smiles, in a far-off way. "For clarity."
texts.zh:
他深吸一口气。

"这眼看着要变成第二次 Askonia 危机了。而我担心，这也正是个机会，让我能朝先前详细说过的那桩目标推进——也许，是朝着让英仙座星域重归一统，迈出一步。"

"与霸主和解，"他轻声说。

Horus 透过链路望着你。"是你给了我需要的东西——一条直通至高霸主的、安全可靠的联络线。而现在，一个能真正做点实事的机会就摆在面前。这感觉像是站在悬崖上，可...想要飞起来，你就得信。"

"谢谢你，$titlePL。\"他笑了笑，神思仿佛在别处。\"为这份清醒。"
effects: #AddTextSmall "Convinced Horus Yaribay to back the Hegemony" highlight

texts.en: "I must speak with my envoys, reach out to certain contacts. There is much to arrange. We must speak again when the conflict breaks into the open."
texts.zh: "我得和我的使节们谈谈，联络一些人。要安排的事很多。等冲突摆到明面上，我们必须再谈一次。"

texts.en:
"We must..."

He pauses.

"Do I have your support in what I aim to accomplish? I would be remiss not to ask you explicitly. You are not my employee, nor am I your patron."
texts.zh:
"我们必须..."

他顿住了。

"我要做的这件事，能得到你的支持吗？不把这话明明白白问出口，就是我的失礼。你不是我的下属，我也不是你的东家。"

options.en: Of course. I consider us partners in this endeavor.
options.zh: 当然。这件事上，我视我们为伙伴。

options.en: No, you chose your path. I must choose my own.
options.zh: 不。你选了你自己的路。我也得走我自己的。

texts.en:
"In truth, I've had my eyes on the Askonia situation for some time. The history of Opis, of... Andrada. It is at the center of the conflict between League and Hegemony."

He waves a hand, brushing the past away.

"There is a man, a contact, on Nortia. He is an organizer for the Askonia Charterist Alliance. The Hegemony favors his organization."

"So shall I. Give him supplies, fuel, credits - whatever he needs. My people will arrange a meeting."
texts.zh:
"说实话，Askonia 的局势我盯了有些时候了。Opis 的历史，还有...Andrada。这里正是联盟与霸主冲突的中心。"

他摆了摆手，把那些过往挥到一边。

"Nortia 上有个人，我的一个关系人。他是 Askonia 宪章派同盟的组织者。霸主那边是看好他这一伙的。"

"我也一样。给他补给、燃料、星币——他要什么就给什么。我的人会安排一次会面。"

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've spoken with him already, yes.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？我已经和他谈过了，是的。

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've already given him everything the ACA required.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？ACA 要的东西，我已经全给他了。

texts.en:
Horus sounds more confident somehow, a new sense of purpose driving him as he lays out plans.

"I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need. And credits."
texts.zh:
Horus 的声音不知不觉间多了几分底气；一种新的目标感驱使着他，把计划一条条铺开。

"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。还有星币。"

texts.en:
"I ask, also, that you assist the rebels however you might, even those who may be somewhat at cross-purpose with the ACA. Our cause is to correct where the Hegemony went so wrong - the Sindrian Diktat itself must be destroyed, no matter which clone of the arch-mutineer would lead it."

"Andrada made many enemies - most of all the Hegemony - and they will thank us for helping them."
texts.zh:
"另外，我还想请你不论用什么法子，都尽量帮一把那些叛军——哪怕其中有些人和 ACA 的宗旨不尽一致。我们要做的，是纠正霸主当年错得太离谱的地方——辛达强权本身必须被摧毁，不管坐上那位子的是那个老叛徒的哪一具克隆体。"

"Andrada 树敌无数——其中最恨他的就是霸主——我们帮他们一把，他们会感激我们的。"

texts.en:
"Don't forget, $titlePL - speak with Finlay Siyavong. But remember above all that he cannot give you orders, only advice. You need not do as he says."

Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"
texts.zh:
"别忘了，$titlePL——去和 Finlay Siyavong 谈谈。但最要紧的是记住：他只能给你建议，不能给你下命令。你不必照他说的做。"

Horus 又拿起他的 TriPad，一边翻着通知一边满意地哼了一声。他抬起头。

"我想，就这些了？"

texts.en:
"Oh, that is most fortuitous! A most driven man, is he not?"

He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need."
texts.zh:
"哦，那可太巧了！那人干劲十足，不是吗？"

他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。"

texts.en:
Horus furrows his brow as he taps at a datapad. Then looks up.

"That was you? Stars above... of course." He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "Nonetheless, I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron with fuel and supplies. I expect that you may have other contacts, or means, that might assist... our cause."
texts.zh:
Horus 皱着眉，在数据板上点了几下，然后抬起头。

"那是你做的？群星在上...当然。\"他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。\"不管怎样，我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，里头有燃料和补给。我想你也许还有别的关系，或者别的门路，能帮上...我们这桩事业。"

texts.en: "I am glad to hear that." His smile is genuine.
texts.zh: "听你这么说，我很高兴。"他的笑容是真的。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "You truly believe I ought? It would be undermining the Prime Demarchon... it may weaken the League. Fortuna and I agree on many things, and much to do with Reynard, but her vision is," he considers his words. "It is limited, and I think stubbornly small-minded in some respects. Take for instance her bigotry against the Luddics..."
texts.zh: "你真觉得我该这么做？那等于拆大统领的台...也许会削弱联盟。Fortuna 和我在许多事上看法一致，在关于 Reynard 的事上更是如此，可她的眼界，\"他斟酌着用词，\"是有限的，而且我认为在某些方面固执得有些小家子气。就拿她对卢德派的偏见来说..."

options.en: Nothing else will break Reynard's strangehold. You must support Fortuna.
options.zh: 除此之外，再也破不了 Reynard 的钳制。你必须支持 Fortuna。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

texts.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主的联络，我很领情，"他说，"更不必说你在 Menes 那件事上的...谨慎。这一次也一样。"

texts.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
texts.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall have to arrange a meeting with Fortuna Kato. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我就得安排一次与 Fortuna Kato 的会面了。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall meet Fortuna Kato as soon as possible. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会尽快去见 Fortuna Kato。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall make inquiries with the office of the Prime Demarchon to ascertain Reynard's policies concerning Gens Kato. Common orbit may yet be found."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会向大统领办公室探问一番，弄清 Reynard 对 Kato 氏族是什么政策。说不定还能找到共同的轨道。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall reach out to the office of the Prime Demarchon and offer my support against Fortuna's reckless plans."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会联络大统领办公室，表示我支持他们对付 Fortuna 这鲁莽的计划。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I have inquiries and envoys to send, if you do not mind."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我还有几处要探问，几个使节要派出去，希望你不介意。"

texts.en:
"You truly believe so?"

He looks strained. "I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. And to be second is no shameful thing. I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay...our future is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan given the present state of affairs."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always be more opportunities, in time..."
texts.zh:
"你真这么认为？"

他面色绷紧。"我想，如果 Fortuna 的计划失败，我的氏族能得的好处不少。屈居第二也并非什么丢人的事。我得首先顾全 Yaribay 氏族的安危...以眼下的局面，我们的前途和 Hannan 氏族已经死死绑在一起了。"

他顿了顿，若有所思："假以时日，机会总是会有的..."

options.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
options.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en:
"The Hegemony," he says.

"It's risky, very risky. They must destroy the Sindrian Diktat as a polity. There is sure to be much chaos in the aftermath..."
texts.zh:
"霸主，"他说。

"这很冒险，非常冒险。他们必须把辛达强权作为一个政权彻底打掉。事后必定是一片大乱..."

options.en: You must, though. This is your chance!
options.zh: 可你必须这么做。这是你的机会！

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
texts.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

texts.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Hector——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

texts.en:
What is Macario's ploy?

Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat.

But how? Macario is controlling the comms network and seems determined that you play the role of antagonist.
texts.zh:
Macario 在打什么算盘？

Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要。

可该怎么做？Macario 控制着通讯网络，而且似乎打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。

texts.en:
Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat!

Macario is controlling the comms network and is determined that you play the role of antagonist. No doubt he's seen fit to dispatch a fleet to catch you in the act of 'sabotaging' the system comms relay...
texts.zh:
Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要！

Macario 控制着通讯网络，且打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。他多半还觉得派一支舰队来，正好能当场逮住你在'破坏'星系通讯中继站...

options.en: Was it a mistake to trust Macario?
options.zh: 信任 Macario 是不是一开始就错了？

texts.en: It is increasingly clear that he considers you a loose end that needs to be trimmed.
texts.zh: 越来越清楚的是，他把你当成了一个需要剪掉的尾巴。

options.en: Forget about Macario, then. I must support the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 那就别再管 Macario 了。我必须支持辛达强权！

options.en: I'll make Macario regret his betrayal. Revenge will be mine!
options.zh: 我要让 Macario 为他的背叛后悔。这仇我一定报！

texts.en:
The question remains- Which Sindrian Diktat?

Who will you back as the true heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
问题仍在——哪一个辛达强权？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 真正的继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

texts.en:
Then you must prove yourself despite the inconvenience of being declared the foremost enemy of the Sindrian Diktat by that treacherous spymaster.

Hector will recognize your loyalty because you will demonstrate it to him by providing material support, securing wavering allies, and pledging yourself directly to his cause - once you have the opportunity to do so...
texts.zh:
那么，尽管那个背信弃义的谍报头子已把你宣布为辛达强权的头号公敌，你仍得证明自己。

Hector 会认可你的忠诚，因为你要以实际支援、稳住摇摆的盟友、直接向他宣誓效忠来向他证明——只等你有机会这么做...

texts.en:
The only way you are going to be able to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
你能联系上 Hector——或任何其他人——的唯一办法，就是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

texts.en: Then you must pledge yourself to Achilles, a trained military leader who is not burdened by being the puppet of a spymaster quite so treacherous as Dolos Macario.
texts.zh: 那么你必须向 Achilles 宣誓效忠——一位受过训练的军事领袖，不必背负做 Dolos Macario 这种背信弃义的谍报头子傀儡的包袱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

texts.en:
So it's personal.

You will pledge yourself to one goal above all: the destruction of Dolos Macario.

Who are his enemies? Who will turn on him, who will aid you in sabotaging his machinations? Now is the time to call upon their resources.
texts.zh:
这么说，是私怨。

你将立誓只为一个目标：毁掉 Dolos Macario。

谁是他的敌人？谁会倒戈相向，谁会帮你破坏他的算计？现在正是动用他们资源的时候。

texts.en:
And what of the heirs?

Who will you back as a 'true' heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
那些继承人呢？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 的'真正'继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

options.en: No one. Let them both burn, and their Sindrian Diktat with them.
options.zh: 谁都不。让他们两个一起烧，连同他们的辛达强权。

texts.en: So be it.
texts.zh: 那就这样吧。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

texts.en: She doesn't appear to listen as you speak.
texts.zh: 你说话时，她似乎根本没在听。

texts.en: She doesn't appear to listen as you speak.
texts.zh: 你说话时，她似乎根本没在听。

texts.en:
She looks up.

"This means that-" She pauses, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Don't apologize, you've already interrupted. Report."

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you.

It's not exactly fear you see; she's known battle and knows how to control fear. It's a look of threat-assessment, perhaps triage. Anticipation of casualties.
texts.zh:
她抬起头。

"这意味着——"她话没说完，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别道歉了，你都打断了。报告。"

她听着，目光也随之转回你身上。

你看到的算不上恐惧；她经历过战阵，懂得如何压住恐惧。那是一种评估威胁的目光，或许是在做分诊式的盘算——预先清点将有多少伤亡。

texts.en:
Her eyebrows raise.

"Really. You can prove this? I would-" She pauses, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Don't apologize, you've already interrupted. Report."

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you.

It's not exactly fear you see; she's known battle and knows how to control fear. It's a look of threat-assessment, perhaps triage. Anticipation of casualties.
texts.zh:
她挑了挑眉。

"当真。你能证明？我倒——"她话没说完，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别道歉了，你都打断了。报告。"

她听着，目光也随之转回你身上。

你看到的算不上恐惧；她经历过战阵，懂得如何压住恐惧。那是一种评估威胁的目光，或许是在做分诊式的盘算——预先清点将有多少伤亡。

texts.en:
There's a small voice in your ear now, too.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam."

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations like this.
texts.zh:
这时，你耳中也响起一个细小的声音。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam."

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时这样打断过你的私人通话。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your comms officer continues, a whisper in your ear. "Holofeed from the relay, direct from Sindria- full broadcast, priority override. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."

"Captain," Hyder says with all the dignity she can recover from the interruption. "There is... news. Let us resume this conversation in a few minutes."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"通讯军官在你耳边低语着继续说，\"中继站转来的全息信号，直接从 Sindria 发来——全频道广播，最高优先级覆盖。内容筛选标记为极高关注。"

"舰长，\"Hyder 尽力从被打断的狼狈中拾回威严，\"有...消息。我们几分钟后再继续这场谈话。"

options.en: Agreed. I'm putting the link on hold.

options.zh: 什么事能要紧到这个地步？

texts.en:
"Hyder out," she says crisply, and the connection snaps to a holding pattern.

The crest of the Sindrian Diktat Navy.
texts.zh:
"Hyder 完毕，"她干脆地说，连接应声转入保持画面。

辛达强权海军的徽记。

options.en: Comms- what's going on? Forward the feed.
options.zh: 通讯——怎么回事？把信号接过来。

texts.en:
"Macario's... declaration about you. What he says you did. I must assume they are lies, for I don't believe you are a child-murderer. And Dolos will lie to cover the truth, habitually."

"How many of them live? The clones."
texts.zh:
"Macario 关于你的...那番宣告。他说你干过的那些事。我只能认定那是谎言，因为我不信你是会杀害孩童的人。而 Dolos 向来习惯用谎言掩盖真相。"

"他们还有几个活着？那些克隆体。"

options.en: It's complicated. But only one has serious backing- Achilles.
options.zh: 说来复杂。但只有一个有真正的靠山——Achilles。

texts.en: "The Persean League," she says. "Of course. Reynard Hannan is too proud of his own power to honor his word concerning the League's neutrality. And the League too decadent to stop him..."
texts.zh: "英仙座联盟，\"她说，\"果然。Reynard Hannan 对自己的权势太过自负，不会遵守他关于联盟中立的承诺。而联盟又太腐朽，拦不住他..."

options.en: In this case, Fortuna Kato appears to be the prime mover...
options.zh: 这一回，Fortuna Kato 似乎才是真正的推手...

texts.en:
"Is that so? That does align with recent intel concerning Gens Kato. It must be some deeper plot," she says, brow furrowed. "Kato would not be allowed to act unless Hannan approved, unless- who knows! It's all plot and counter-plot, receding forever."

She shakes her head, frustrated.
texts.zh:
"是吗？这倒和最近关于 Kato 氏族的情报对得上。背后必定还有更深的算计，\"她皱着眉说，\"没有 Hannan 点头，Kato 不可能擅自动手，除非——谁知道呢！全是阴谋与反阴谋，一环套一环，望不到头。"

她烦躁地摇了摇头。

options.en: It isn't like that at all. Let me explain, I have proof. (explain)
options.zh: 根本不是那么回事。让我解释，我有证据。 (解释)

options.en: What I have to say is more important than old disagreements.
options.zh: 我要说的事，比旧日的分歧重要得多。

options.en: We must join together against Macario - he threatens Philip Andrada's glorious legacy!
options.zh: 我们必须联手对抗 Macario——他威胁的是 Philip Andrada 光辉的遗业！

texts.en:
"No," she says.

"I shall not be playing another of Macario's games. I refuse. If we meet again, it will be-"

She pauses, reaching toward her ear, turning aside.

"No apologies. If it's critical, report!"

As Hyder listens, her eyes turn back to you. Worried. Accusing. Like something is your fault.
texts.zh:
"不行，"她说。

"我不会再陪 Macario 玩这种把戏。我拒绝。若我们再见面，那便是——"

她停住话头，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"不必道歉。要是紧急，就报告！"

Hyder 听着，目光转回你身上。忧虑。责问。仿佛一切都是你的过错。

texts.en:
"No," she says. "I'm not playing any more of Macario's games. I refuse. Do not contact me again," she spits. "Hyder out."

True to her word, the feed cuts.
texts.zh:
"不行，\"她说。\"我不会再陪 Macario 玩下去了。我拒绝。别再联系我，\"她啐道，\"Hyder 完毕。"

她说到做到，通讯画面随即切断。

options.en: Whatever it is, I didn't do it.
options.zh: 不管出了什么事，都不是我干的。

texts.en:
"Do not contact me again," she spits. "Hyder out."

True to her word, the feed cuts.
texts.zh:
"别再联系我，\"她啐道，\"Hyder 完毕。"

她说到做到，通讯画面随即切断。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." There's a small voice in your ear.

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations.

To be fair, though, this one was concluded.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你耳边响起一个细小的声音。

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时打断过你的私人通话。

不过平心而论，这一通已经谈完了。

texts.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to Ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
texts.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en: "That's it," Tech says. "It's tiny, whatever it is... Confirmation ping returned true, and- connection gone. Like it never existed."
texts.zh: "That's it," Tech says. "It's tiny, whatever it is... Confirmation ping returned true, and- connection gone. Like it never existed."

texts.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

As your comms officer has assured you, the signal should appear to be from a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress of Sindria. No reason why Caden shouldn't pick up a priority signal.

The link shudders, flashes, then returns to the holding signal.
texts.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

正如你的通讯官所保证的，这通信号看上去会像是来自一位驻守 Sindria 恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅。Caden 没有理由不接一通优先级信号。

链路一阵震颤，闪了闪，随后又回到保持信号。

texts.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you, a bony rictus.
texts.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

texts.en:
"What a pleasant surprise. Oh-" He feigns concern, "were you trying to contact Horacio? I apologize; he's still... preparing himself."

Macario suppresses something- a laugh? - with an odd gulp.
texts.zh:
"真是个愉快的惊喜。哦——\"他装出关切的样子，\"你是想联系 Horacio 吗？我很抱歉；他还在...做准备。"

Macario 像是憋住了什么——一声笑？——古怪地咽了一口。

texts.en:
"I'm sure he'll be along shortly," he manages after a moment, then turns to look at what must be a mirror, attaches another medal to his coat, then adjusts his collar.

"Perfect."

He looks back into the feed, impishly.
texts.zh:
"我相信他很快就会过来，"他过了一会儿才勉强说道，然后转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，整了整衣领。

"完美。"

他带着促狭的神情转回镜头。

options.en: You're not going to get away with this.
I'm going to stop you, Dolos.
I'm going to kill you, Dolos.
You made a terrible mistake! My loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat is undiminished!
options.zh: 你犯了个大错！我对辛达强权的忠诚分毫未减！

texts.en:
"I already have."

His grin stretches painfully.
texts.zh:
"我已经做到了。"

他的笑容痛苦地咧开。

texts.en:
"Now away with you. I have a ceremony to attend; I'm sure you'll be watching."

He turns back to the link for just a moment.

"Have the dignity to die... soonish, will you?"

The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
"现在，滚吧。我还有一场典礼要出席；我猜你一定会看。"

他转向链路，只多停了片刻。

"有点尊严的话，就死得...早一点，行吗？"

通讯骤然中断。

texts.en:
You hear your comms officer's voice.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I apologize for the intrusion, but there's an alert."
texts.zh:
你听见通讯官的声音。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。抱歉打扰，但有条警报。"

texts.en:
"You've already failed."

His grin stretches painfully.
texts.zh:
"你已经失败了。"

他的笑容痛苦地咧开。

texts.en:
"I've made it a point to forget how many times I've been told precisely that."

His face splits into a painful-looking grin.
texts.zh:
"我特意不去记有多少人对我说过一模一样的话。"

他脸上裂开一个看起来就很痛的笑容。

texts.en:
This earns you a look of surprise.

"Captain, I don't-" he begins, then halts, almost as if embarrassed.

"You'll have to explain what you mean."
texts.zh:
这让他露出意外的神色。

"舰长，我不——"他刚开口便停住，几乎像是有些难堪。

"你得解释一下你的意思。"

options.en: I am committed to the Andradan principles! Despite your wavering, I intend to uphold my pledge!
options.zh: 我坚守 Andrada 的原则！即便你动摇了，我也打算履行我的誓言！

options.en: You're a traitor, Macario, and I'll destroy you - to save the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario，你是叛徒，我会毁了你——为了拯救辛达强权。

texts.en:
"How... how telling."

He wears a strange expression as he examines you anew through the link for a moment. Then he shifts his uniform, assembling a stern, proud look. Perfect for the holos.
texts.zh:
"多么...多么说明问题。"

他带着一种奇怪的表情，透过链路重新打量了你片刻。随后他整了整制服，摆出一副严厉而自豪的样子。正适合上全息。

texts.en:
He speaks without awaiting a response.

"There is news of great import regarding the future of the Sindrian Diktat. I'll send a fleet to escort you so that your situation can be... corrected." He blinks. "You may yet prove your loyalty to the blood of Andrada by... serving as an example."

He lifts his cap, black, bearing the gold wings of the Diktat. He doesn't put it on quite yet.

Then the comms snap off, leaving you with only the darkness.
texts.zh:
他没等你回答便开口。

"有关于辛达强权未来的重大消息。我会派一支舰队护送你来，好让你的处境得到...纠正。\"他眨了眨眼，\"你或许还能以...充当反面典型的方式，证明你对 Andrada 血脉的忠诚。"

他抬起帽子——黑色的帽檐上缀着强权的金色翼徽。他还没有戴上。

随后通讯骤然中断，只留你与黑暗相对。

texts.en:
He nods, now. "I see. I'm sure someone will find your devotion admirable, although..."

Then he shrugs, a mocking apology.
texts.zh:
他这才点了点头。"我明白了。我相信总会有人欣赏你的忠诚，只不过..."

然后他耸了耸肩，那是一种嘲弄式的歉意。

texts.en:
Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.

They were excited about the operation from the start; one is not often tested by hacking major faction-owned comm relays as the consequences are dire indeed - and that's if one survives the nearly inevitable hostile fleet action carried out at the first sign of someone tampering with 'essential infrastructure'.

"Intialized intrusion/search suite. Connecting, $playerSirOrMadam. Uploading package to remote datacore..."
texts.zh:
你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

他们从一开始就对这次行动兴奋不已；毕竟，没多少人有机会去入侵大势力所拥有的通讯中继——后果确实极其严重，而且这还得建立在能挺过那场几乎必然的敌方舰队打击之上：只要有人碰一下【关键基础设施】，对方就会立刻出动。

"入侵与检索套件已初始化。正在连接，$playerSirOrMadam。正在将数据包上传至远程数据核心..."

options.en: Keep me posted. High-level. I don't need every detail.
options.zh: 随时汇报。只讲重点。细节我不需要。

texts.en: "Um. Um," Tech stutters. "$PlayerSirOrMadam?"
texts.zh: "呃。呃，\"技术官结巴道，\"$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

options.en: Yes? I said high-level updates only.
options.zh: 什么事？我说了，只报重点。

texts.en:
"Found a comms-ID," your technology officer says, disappointment cutting through their usual enthusiasm.

"Hector Andrada. Office of, uh. It says Office of Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat."

They turn to look at you.
texts.zh:
"找到一个通讯 ID，"你的技术军官说，失望压过了平日里那股热切。

"Hector Andrada。隶属，呃。上面写着辛达强权最高元首办公室。"

他们转头看向你。

options.en: That'd be him. Comms, put me through.
options.zh: 就是他了。通讯官，接过去。

texts.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

Your comms officer assures you that the signal should appear to be from a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress of Sindria. A priority signal, even.

The link shudders, flashes an ornate crest of the Supreme Executor, then returns to a holding pattern.
texts.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

你的通讯官向你保证，这通信号看上去会像是来自一位驻守 Sindria 恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅。而且还是优先级信号。

链路一阵震颤，闪过最高元首的华丽徽记，随后又回到保持状态。

texts.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you, a bony rictus.
texts.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

texts.en:
"What a pleasant surprise."

"Oh-" He feigns concern, "were you trying to contact the Supreme Executor? I apologize; he's still... getting prepared."

Macario suppresses something- a laugh? - with a choked sound.
texts.zh:
"真是个愉快的惊喜。"

"哦——\"他装出关切的样子，\"你是想联系最高元首吗？我很抱歉；他还在...做准备。"

Macario 像是憋住了什么——一声笑？——喉咙里发出噎住似的声音。

texts.en:
"I'm sure he'll be along shortly."

He turns to look at what must be a mirror, and attaches another medal to his coat, then adjusts the collar.

"Perfect."

He looks back into the feed, impishly.
texts.zh:
"我相信他很快就会过来。"

他转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，然后整了整衣领。

"完美。"

他带着促狭的神情转回镜头。

options.en: You're not going to get away with this.
I'm going to stop you, Dolos.
I'm going to kill you, Dolos.
You made a terrible mistake! My loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat is undiminished!
options.zh: 你犯了个大错！我对辛达强权的忠诚分毫未减！

texts.en:
It takes more than a few minutes for the comms to bounce between what you assume are low-level functionaries who, luckily, read the request tags without summoning the courage to ask you your business directly.

But, finally, Dolos Macario appears before you.
texts.zh:
通讯在几个你猜是基层办事员的人之间来回转接了不止几分钟——好在他们只看了请求标签，没敢直接问你来意。

但最后，Dolos Macario 还是出现在你面前。

texts.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you with a bony rictus.

"What a surprise," he says, unsurprised.
texts.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

"真是个惊喜。"他说着，却毫无惊讶之意。

options.en: You seem to have misunderstood our... partnership.
options.zh: 看来你误解了我们的...合作关系。

texts.en:
"Oh, did-" His voice fills with feigned concern. "Did you hear troubling rumors on the holo? I owe you my most sincere apologies. A ruse becomes necessary from time to time, you see. It may be hard to appreciate from your position but I work... very hard." His eyes turn down as he adjusts his uniform. "Very hard to ensure my plans are..."

He turns to look at what must be a mirror to attach another medal to his coat, then straightens his collar.

"Perfect."

He turns back toward the feed with an impish look.
texts.zh:
"哦，你是——\"他的声音里填满了假惺惺的关切，\"你是在全息新闻上听到什么令人不安的传言了？那我得向你致以最诚挚的歉意。你知道，有时候诡计是必要的。从你的处境看，这或许很难理解，但我工作...非常努力。\"他垂下眼睛，整了整制服，\"非常努力，以确保我的计划..."

他转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，然后正了正衣领。

"完美。"

他带着一副促狭的神情转回镜头。

options.en: Let's start with rescinding the kill order. Then my commission reinstated.
options.zh: 先把格杀令撤了。然后恢复我的委任。

options.en: Cutting me out would be a mistake. We could rule Askonia.
options.zh: 把我排除在外会是个错误。我们可以一起统治 Askonia。

options.en: I expected no less; power is a game. What's our next step?
options.zh: 我不指望别的；权力本就是一场游戏。下一步是什么？

options.en: Are you trying to discard me, Dolos? You wouldn't be so foolish.
options.zh: Dolos，你是想抛弃我？你不会蠢到这个地步。

options.en: Let's start with rescinding the kill order. Then my commission reinstated.
options.zh: 先把格杀令撤了。然后恢复我的委任。

options.en: I expected no less; power is a game. What's our next step?
options.zh: 我不指望别的；权力本就是一场游戏。下一步是什么？

options.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Ditkat. We need to work together.
options.zh: 我忠于辛达强权。我们必须合作。

options.en: I am loyal to the Blood of Andrada, Dolos. Not you.
options.zh: Dolos，我忠于 Andrada 的血脉。不是忠于你。

options.en: Are you trying to discard me, Dolos? You wouldn't be so foolish.
options.zh: Dolos，你是想抛弃我？你不会蠢到这个地步。

options.en: I want my commission back, Dolos.
You call this a ruse? The fleets of the Diktat are hunting me!
options.zh: 你管这叫诡计？强权的舰队正在追杀我！

options.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Ditkat, Dolos. We can still fix this.
options.zh: Dolos，我忠于辛达强权。这件事还来得及补救。

options.en: I am loyal to Andrada, Dolos. Not you. You've gone too far.
options.zh: Dolos，我忠于 Andrada，不是忠于你。你做得太过分了。

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror. Adjusts a stray hair.

"You'll get everything you deserve, captain. Hold faith. There will be some... very important news."

"You'll be watching?" His eyes dart to the feed. "Of course you will. What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子。理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你会得到你应得的一切。保持信心。会有一些...非常重要的消息。"

"你会盯着看的吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"你当然会。毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: My demand stands. I swore an oath.
options.zh: 我的要求不变。我发过誓。

texts.en:
He lifts his cap, black, bearing the gold wings of the Diktat. He doesn't put it on quite yet.

"It'll soon be done," he says quietly, his eyes focused elsewhere.

The comms snap off, leaving you with the darkness.
texts.zh:
他抬起帽子——黑色的帽檐上缀着强权的金色翼徽。他还没有戴上。

"很快就结束了，"他低声说，目光落在别处。

通讯骤然中断，只留你与黑暗相对。

texts.en:
He blinks at you, perhaps even surprised.

"I have," he emphasizes the word outrageously, "made a mistake. I did not credit you with quite that scale of ambition."

He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair. "It doesn't become you," he says. Then an odd sound escapes his throat.

"You'll be watching the public comms, I trust?" His eyes dart back to the feed. "What with hacking our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，看着你，甚至有些意外。

"我确实犯了个错误。\"他把【确实】咬得格外夸张，\"我没料到你竟有这般野心。"

他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。"这不合你的身份，"他说。接着他喉咙里挤出一种古怪的声音。

"我猜你会盯着公共通讯频道吧？\"他的目光又飘回全息画面，\"毕竟你刚黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"You will wait right there, captain. We have to, ah, link up. Keep faith! There is important news coming."

"You'll be watching the feeds, I trust," he says. "What with having hacked into our comms relay."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你就在那儿等着。我们得，啊，会合。保持信心！马上就有重要消息。"

"我猜你会盯着这些频道吧，\"他说，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: You want me to wait here - for what? An ambush?
options.zh: 你要我在这儿等——等什么？等一场伏击？

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"You'll get everything you deserve, captain. Have faith." An odd sound escapes his throat. "There will be... news."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你会得到你应得的一切。要有信心。\"他喉咙里挤出一种古怪的声音，\"会有...消息的。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"We all have our part to play, captain. Maintain your faith. There will be... very important news coming."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime against the Diktat, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，我们各有各的角色要扮演。保持你的信心。马上会有...非常重要的消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这是对强权的死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: You need me, Dolos. No one can do what I can do.
options.zh: Dolos，你需要我。我能做的事，没人能替代。

options.en: I'm going to clear my name with or without your help.
options.zh: 不管你帮不帮忙，我都要洗清自己的名声。

options.en: You put me in this position. Your 'ruse', your lies.
options.zh: 是你把我推到这一步的。你的'诡计'，你的谎言。

texts.en: Macario's teeth flash; it couldn't be called a smile.
texts.zh: Macario 的牙齿一闪；那实在称不上笑。

texts.en: Macario's teeth flash; it couldn't be called a smile.
texts.zh: Macario 的牙齿一闪；那实在称不上笑。

texts.en: "He will." Macario's teeth flash. "I'll make sure of it."
texts.zh: "他会的。\"Macario 牙齿一闪，\"我会确保如此。"

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair. A smile flickers over his thin lips.

"I admire your loyalty, captain. We can't all be one of Andrada's New Men, can we? Hold that faith. There will be... important news concerning the future of the Sindrian Diktat."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a little one-shoulder shrug, setting medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。一丝笑意掠过他薄薄的嘴唇。

"舰长，我欣赏你的忠诚。我们不可能人人都成为 Andrada 的新人，对吧？守住这份信心。会有...关于辛达强权未来的重要消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他微微耸了下肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

texts.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"And you've given them some good practice. Maintain your faith. There is... very important news coming."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
texts.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"而且你给了他们不少练手的机会。保持你的信心。马上会有...非常重要的消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: This isn't about faith. You need to call off the hunt.
options.zh: 这跟信心无关。你必须叫停这场追捕。

texts.en: He smirks knowingly.
texts.zh: 他心照不宣地笑了笑。

texts.en: He smirks, knowingly.
texts.zh: 他心知肚明地勾了勾嘴角。

texts.en:
You're about to give the order when-

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.
texts.zh:
你正要下令，忽然——

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯军官。

texts.en: "Holofeed from the relay, direct from Sindria- full broadcast, priority override. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."
texts.zh: "中继站转来的全息信号，直接从 Sindria 发来——全频道广播，最高优先级覆盖。内容筛选标记为极高关注。"

options.en: Pssst, do you want a planetkiller?
options.zh: 嘘，你想要一台行星杀手吗？

texts.en:
"This again." He gives you a cold look, "I hope you haven't been peddling this forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths to anyone else before coming crawling back to me."

He's ice-cold.

"Right?"
texts.zh:
"又是这样。" 他冷冷地看了你一眼，"我希望你在爬回来找我之前，没有向任何人兜售过这种曾在 人之领 时代造成数十亿人死亡的大规模杀伤性武器。"

他的态度直降冰点。

"对吧？"

texts.en: "No," he says. "And we're not having this conversation about you selling me a weapon of mass destruction."
texts.zh: "不，" 他说道，"并且我们从来没谈过关于你卖给我大规模杀伤性武器的事。"

texts.en: "You already made that joke," he says. "It wasn't funny the first time."
texts.zh: "你已经开过了那个玩笑。" 他说道，"第一次就没多好笑。"

texts.en:
Arroyo is, naturally, taken aback at your claim.

"You serious?" He looks at you, assessing.
texts.zh:
不出所料，Arroyo 对你的话感到吃惊。

"你认真的？" 他仔细打量着你。

options.en: I'm serious this time. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you; you're rich.
options.zh: 我这次是认真的，行星杀手可是个稀罕货。我想到了你，你相当有钱。

options.en: Just trying to brighten your day.
options.zh: 只是想让你度过愉快的一天。

options.en: Deadly serious. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you because you're rich.
options.zh: 非常认真。行星杀手非常罕见。我想到了你，因为你很有钱。

texts.en:
"Good."

He sighs. "300,000 credits. Deal?"
texts.zh:
"很好。"

他叹了口气。"300,000 星币。成交？"

options.en: I'm going to need more credits.

texts.en:
You make the arrangements, delivering an anonymous package - without a customs scan, easily avoided with a token bribe - to a robotic warehouse run by a shell-company owned by a shell-company of a shell-company owned by Rayan Arroyo.

The credits are good.

"Never talk to me about this ever again," he says as a good-bye.
texts.zh:
你做出安排，将匿名包裹送到一个自动化仓库 —— 该仓库由 Rayan Arroyo 旗下空壳公司的空壳公司下属的空壳公司运营，只需象征性贿赂即可轻松避免海关扫描。

报酬丰厚。

"以后别再和我提起这件事了。" 他以这句话作为告别。

texts.en: "Too bad," he says. "You'll just have to find someone else to buy your forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths."
texts.zh: "太糟糕了，" 他说道，"至于那台害死过数十亿人的 人之领 时代大规模杀伤性武器了，你只能找其他人来购买了。"

options.en: I've changed my mind. 300,000 is a good price.
options.zh: 我改主意了。300,000 星币是个好价钱。

options.en: That's just what I'm going to do.

texts.en: "Good luck," he says without much sincerity you can detect.
texts.zh: "祝你好运，" 他说道，但你听不出他有多真诚。

texts.en: "Good luck selling your forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths," he says. His tone feels insincere to you, somehow.
texts.zh: "祝你好运，希望你能卖掉你那台害死过数十亿人的 人之领 时代大规模杀伤性武器。" 他说道。不知怎的，他的语气让你觉得不怎么真诚。

texts.en:
He puts his face into his palm, taking a deep breath.

"You idiot," he says with a sigh.

"I can do 150,000. That's my best offer for a hot item."
texts.zh:
他把脸埋在手掌里，深深地吸了一口气。

"你这个白痴，" 他叹了口气说。

"我可以再加 150,000 星币。这是我能对一件热门商品开出的最高价。"

texts.en:
You make the arrangements, delivering an anonymous package - without a customs scan, easily avoided with a token bribe - to a robotic warehouse run by a shell-company owned by a shell-company of a shell-company owned by Rayan Arroyo.

The credits are good.

"Never talk to me about this ever again," he says as a good-bye.
texts.zh:
你做出安排，将匿名包裹送到一个自动化仓库 —— 该仓库由 Rayan Arroyo 旗下空壳公司的空壳公司下属的空壳公司运营，只需象征性贿赂即可轻松避免海关扫描。

报酬丰厚。

"以后别再和我提起这件事了。" 他以这句话作为告别。

texts.en:
"Good thinking, $playerName."

He lifts his eyes, staring at nothing; considering his options. If anything, he seems stressed out by your offer.

"I can do 300,000 credits," he finally says. "And, though this should not need saying, I need you to keep your mouth absolutely shut about this. It's a good thing you came to me first."

He blinks.

"You did come to me first, right?"
texts.zh:
"好主意，$playerName。"

他抬起眼睛，什么也没有看，考虑着他的选择。如果有什么不同的话，他似乎对你的提议颇感压力。

"我可以支付 300,000 星币，" 他最终说道，"尽管无需多言，但我需要你对此保密。你先来找我是件好事。"

他眨了眨眼。

"你第一个找的人是我，对吧？"

texts.en:
"Hilarious."

He doesn't smile.
texts.zh:
"真搞笑。"

他并没有笑。

texts.en:
"Thanks."

He doesn't sound thankful.
texts.zh:
"谢谢。"

他听起来并没有多么感谢你。

texts.en:
Data recovery from a Tri-Tachyon war-AI nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and the AI-designed data architecture which seems to delight in confounding idiosyncrasies.

"I've heard speculation that it's like art to them," your tech officer says, noticing your attention. "To the AIs, I mean. Like poetry expressed through mathematics."

You know what to look for, however, which makes the often unprofitably onerous data analysis yield results more quickly.
texts.zh:
由于 速子科技 的 AI 战斗中枢那不同寻常的硬件设备以及 AI 设计的数据架构，其中充斥着令人困惑的特征，导致从中恢复数据相当费劲。

"我听闻一种假设说，这对它们而言是某种艺术，" 你的技术军官见你在意，便解释道，"我是指，对那些 AI 来说。就跟用数学来写诗一样。"

不过你知道自己要找什么，因此能让这一般来说艰苦且得不偿失的数据分析工作更快得出有用的结果。

texts.en:
Data recovery from the AI war-nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and confoundingly idiosyncratic data architecture.

Your tech officer stumbles on their words from excitement and exhaustion. "A detachment from this nexus encountered a Hegemony fleet. Broke them in minutes, a terrible defeat. Tri-Tachyon had intel protocols; they'd assign AIs to trawl captured datastores then feed that back to more AIs and- ah. There's a planetkiller device."

Your tech officer is wide-eyed. "The weapon. A planetkiller," they repeat with the excited morbidity of a child who, maybe, glimpsed a dead body. "The Hegemony fleet cached it in an asteroid. We got the name of the system it's in!"
texts.zh:
由于 AI 战斗中枢那不同寻常的硬件设备以及充斥着令人困惑特征的数据架构，导致从中恢复数据相当费劲。

你的技术军官兴奋又疲惫，有一句没一句地说道："有一支无人舰队从这个中枢启航，后来它遇到了一支 霸主 舰队。前者没几分钟就把后者碾碎了，真是个可怕的下场。而 速子科技 有一套通讯协议，他们会让 AI 爬取截获的数据，然后将其反馈给其它更多的 AI —— 啊。这提到了一台行星杀手。"

你的技术军官突然瞪大了双眼。"那种武器。一台行星杀手，" 重复的语气像是瞥见了一具尸体的孩子一样狂热又病态，"霸主 舰队把它藏在了某颗小行星上。而我们现在知道它在哪个星系里了！"

texts.en:
You receive a disturbing post-battle report from your tech officer: the command and control centers of the XIV Battlegroup ships you fought appear to have been modified to enable complete control of all systems by AI cores.

It doesn't look like Tri-Tachyon work, either. This was done by the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
你从技术军官那里收到了一份令人不安的战后简报：刚刚与你方交手的第十四战斗群战舰的指令控制中心似乎为了适配 AI 核心操控进行了全系统改造。

并且，这看上去也不像是 速子科技 的手笔，而是 霸主 自己所为。

options.en: Inquire about turning over a community of heretics
options.zh: 询问关于卸下一整个卢德异端组织的问题

texts.en:
"Heretics you say?" The Knight sits up even more rigidly, somehow, to meet this challenge to $hisOrHer militant faith. "Yes, they are a problem which falls under our purview."

"I shall have a novice collect a full witnessing on the situation from your subordinates so that the inquisitors may make a full, and just, accounting of their heresy." $HeOrShe raises an eyebrow, "Presuming your cooperation, of course. For which you would have the thanks of both myself and of the Knights of Ludd."
texts.zh:
"你说异教徒？" 骑士把腰板打得笔直，似乎在准备迎接这个对$hisOrHer狂热信仰的挑战。"是的，他们的问题属于我们的责任范围。"

"我会让一个见习修士从你的下属那里收集关于这件事的完整证词，以便审判官能够全面、公正地评估他们的异端行为。" $HeOrShe挑了挑眉毛，"当然，前提是你的合作。对此，我和卢德骑士团都会对你表示感谢。"

options.en: I'll have them loaded on shuttles immediately.
options.zh: 我会马上把他们装上穿梭机。

options.en: Show mercy, Knight. They are good-intentioned but misled.
options.zh: 发发慈悲吧，骑士。他们初心向善，但却误入歧途。

texts.en: The Knight gives a stiff, small bow. "Providence guide us."
texts.zh: 骑士僵硬地微微鞠了一躬。"上天指引着我们。"

texts.en: The matter resolves to a simple business of logistics, which both your subordinates and the Knights' gang of shockingly young and clean-cut novices handle with aplomb.
texts.zh: 这件事变成了一个简单的后勤问题，你的下属和骑士团中那些年轻、干净利落的见习修士们都能轻松应对。

texts.en:
The Knight doesn't quite sigh, and says, "You've familiar with the Road to Hell, $playerSirOrMadam?"

"Ancient aphorisms aside, I promise to you that we shall provide justice and Ludd's teaching shall provide mercy. Anything less would breach the oath I've sworn."
texts.zh:
骑士轻叹了口气，"你知道通往地狱之路是由什么铺就的吗，$playerSirOrMadam？"

"好吧，先忘掉那古老的谚语，我向你保证，我们将伸张正义，而卢德的教诲将带来仁慈。如若缺失了分毫，就是违背了我的誓言。"

options.en: I need you people to stop sabotaging my industries.
options.zh: 我要你的人停止在我的工业设施上搞破坏。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe takes your words in for a moment, thinking.

"Wide is the chasm between us," $heOrShe says. "You know our aims, and our resolve. We know of the madness which drives you to construct ever larger shrines to Moloch. Alas, if but our prayers were answered! If but your heart was not deaf to Ludd's Word."

"At an impasse, we resort to holy war. But perhaps you and I could explore an alternative - I am not without compromise, despite the lies you've been told."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe听了你的话，沉思片刻。

"我们之间的鸿沟何其宽广，" $heOrShe说道，"你明知我们目标明确，决心坚定。我们知道，疯狂驱使着你为恶魔摩洛克建造着更大的圣地。唉，但凡我们的祈祷得到过回应！但凡你的心没有对卢德的圣言充耳不闻！"

"在绝望中，我们诉诸圣战。但也许你我能探索到别的出路 —— 尽管你对我们撒谎在先，我还是没有放弃和解的选择。"

options.en: You're open to some kind of deal, then.
options.zh: 既然如此，看来你愿意和我做个交易。

options.en: No, I'm done with you. (cut comms)
options.zh: 不，我受够你了。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
A hint of a smile crosses $hisOrHer lips. "We understand one another."

"There is little we want from you; not credits, not ships. However," $heOrShe pauses deliberately. "There is something."

"It would persuade me, and others of like mind in my organization, to set aside the purification of your industries... until Armageddon, of course, when our armies will meet yours in final battle. But until that glorious day you could enjoy your trinkets and idols."
texts.zh:
$hisOrHer嘴唇上掠过一丝笑意。"我们了解彼此。"

"我们想要的东西微不足道；不是星币，不是战舰。然而，" $heOrShe从容不迫地停顿了一下，"是一样别的东西。"

"这会说服我，和我组织中其他志同道合的人，把净化你的工业放在一边... 当然，直到世界末日，我们的军队将在最终决战中与你相遇。但在那荣耀之日到来之前，你可以尽情享受你那些小饰品和神像。"

options.en: What is it you want? Speak plainly.
options.zh: 直说吧，你到底想要什么？

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives a nod, "One planetkiller weapon."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，"一台行星杀手装置。"

texts.en:
"I see by your face that you know of these abominations; that unholy craft of the Domain, murderer of Opis and its billions; and Hanan Pacha, and countless others."

"I know where one may be found. Bring it to me and our holy war against you shall end." $HeOrShe lowers $hisOrHer head just a little, "Until the end of the world."
texts.zh:
"你的表情已经说明你对这些可憎事物的了解；人之领 那残害了 Opis 及其数十亿居民的不洁造物；它还毁掉了 Hanan Pacha，和其他数不胜数的世界。"

"我知道哪里能找到一枚。把它带给我，然后我们之间的圣战就会永远结束。" $HeOrShe略微低下了头，"直到世界末日。"

options.en: What do you mean by 'End of the world'?
options.zh: 你口中的 '世界末日' 是什么意思？

options.en: What would you do with a PK? Is it not unholy?
options.zh: 你要用行星杀手做什么？那不是罪恶的吗？

options.en: If you know where it is, why don't you get it yourself?
options.zh: 如果你知道它在哪，那你为什么不自己去取？

options.en: How do you know this? Is your information good?
options.zh: 你怎么知道的？你的消息准确吗？

options.en: I'm going to need time to think about this.
options.zh: 我需要时间来考虑这件事。

options.en: No! Giving a PK to the Path is beyond reckless.
options.zh: 决不！把行星杀手送给左径，这种行为已经不能用鲁莽来形容了。

options.en: A planetkiller for peace, then. Where do I need to go?
options.zh: 嗯，一台用来维持和平的行星杀手装置。我要去哪找？

texts.en: "That as which was foretold by Ludd," $heOrShe says. "There are a number of signs which were prophesied. Some, but not all, have come to pass."
texts.zh: "那正如卢德的预言，" $heOrShe说道，"很多迹象已经被预言到了。其中一部分，但不是全部，也已经成为现实了。"

texts.en: "This should be an easy deal for you, captain. As an unbeliever, you do not know the rightful fear - and glorious anticipation - of Armageddon."
texts.zh: "这对你来说小事一桩，舰长。作为异教徒，你缺少对世界末日应有的恐惧 —— 以及光荣的期待。"

texts.en:
"Revealing our stratagems is not part of the deal," $heOrShe says.

The Pather won't say, of course.

They could very well be trying to make you party to the Path's greatest atrocity since the destruction of the world of Mairaath. Where would they use a PK, Chicomoztoc? Culann? Kazeron?

Millions would die, and the strategic keystone of a major faction reduced to ash.
texts.zh:
"我们并不打算透露自己的战略。" $heOrShe说道。

当然，左径分子不可能会说出来。

他们可能会间接让你牵涉到自 卢德左径 毁灭 Mairaath 世界后最严重的暴行之中。他们会在哪里使用行星杀手？Chicomoztoc？Culann？Kazeron？

这会夺走上百万人的生命，同时某个主要势力的战略支柱将化为灰烬。

texts.en:
"Some have tried." $HeOrShe pauses, eyes lost for just a moment. "They did not return."

Wherever it is, it must be very dangerous or somehow beyond the technical capacity of the Luddic Path to retrieve.

So it's probably well-guarded.
texts.zh:
"有些人试过了。" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，眼神短暂地失焦，"但他们没能返航。"

无论它在哪里，这次行动一定非常危险，或者不知为何超出了 卢德左径 的技术水平。

所以它可能被严密看管着。

texts.en:
$HisOrHer lip quirks, something like amusement. "The Persean Sector is filled with slaves of Mammon. They would sell even their family for mere lucre. A cold lead to a planetkiller, one they believe is hidden behind the claws and teeth of their own AI abominations?"

"That is a whisper easily bought."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer嘴唇诡异地抽动着，好像被你的话逗笑了，"英仙座星域充满了恶魔玛门的奴隶。他们甚至会为了金钱卖掉自己的家人。他们哪里知道，这条指向行星杀手的冰冷线索，正隐藏在自己所信奉的 AI 秽物的尖牙利爪之下？"

"这只是很容易就能买到的小道消息罢了。"

texts.en:
"Then think, and return if you find wisdom," $heOrShe says, and drums $hisOrHer fingers a couple times on the comms-console.

"Perhaps a braver, or greedier, heretic will accept my offer first. Perhaps not."
texts.zh:
"那么就好好想想吧，想明白了再回来。" $heOrShe说道，一边用手指在通讯控制台上敲了几下。

"在那之前，也许一个更勇敢，更贪婪的异端会接受我的提议。也许不会。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods without surprise or consternation. "Then the holy war shall continue."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe没有任何惊讶地点了点头。"那么圣战将会继续。"

texts.en:
The Pather taps something on a datapad, opening a shared dataspace. "There's a den of abominations - what you would call a Remnant Nexus - which contains data about a Hegemony fleet that had a planetkiller. It is in the $pk_nexusSystemName."

$HeOrShe holds up a hand in anticipation of your questions. "We have confirmed that this Tri-Tachyon source is reliable; their details match Hegemony records concerning a strategic data breach, and a subsequent fleet lost during the first AI War."

"Don't look so surprised, captain," $heOrShe says, chidingly. "Faith in Ludd's Word does not contradict worldly expertise."
texts.zh:
左径分子在数据平板上点了几下，打开了一个共享数据库。"有一个令人憎恶的巢穴，你可以称其为余辉中枢，其中有关于一支 霸主 舰队的数据 —— 那支舰队曾携带过一颗行星杀手。它在 $pk_nexusSystemName 星系里。"

$HeOrShe举起手，抢先制止了你的提问。"我们已经确认这条来自 速子科技 的消息是可靠的。它们的细节符合 霸主 记录中的一次战略数据泄露事件，以及接下来，那一支在第一次 AI 战争中失踪的舰队。"

"别看起来这么吃惊，舰长，" $heOrShe对你的失态略加责备，说道，"信奉卢德福音和使用专业术语之间并不矛盾。"

texts.en:
The Pather taps something on an old datapad, then pauses. And carefully looks at you.

"Something in my spirit hesitates. Why should that be?" $HeOrShe slowly puts the datapad down. "How did you, a slave to Moloch, come to speak with me so readily? Is this a ruse to use the information so-revealed to ourselves for your own ends? Or for Tri-Tachyon? The Hegemony?"

You can see $hisOrHer expression turning from distrust to disgust. "I won't be your dupe, your fool, your means of finding the tool of the defiler!" $HeOrShe stands, shouting, "Begone from here!"
texts.zh:
那个左径分子在一个老旧的数据平板上敲了几下，然后停了下来，并仔细打量着你。

"我的意志有些犹豫不决。为什么？" $HeOrShe缓缓地放下了数据平板。"你，恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，怎能如此平和地与我交谈？这一定是一个诡计，你是为了你某些不可告人的目的而透露给我们这些信息？还是为了 速子科技？霸主？"

你可以看到$HeOrShe的表情从不信任转为了厌恶。"我不会上你的当，受你的骗，或者沦为你寻找渎神者的工具！" $HeOrShe站起来，喝道："从这里滚出去！"

options.en: I'll find the planetkiller and return it to you.
options.zh: 我会找到那台行星杀手装置，并带给你。

options.en: I'll catch this bird for you. (lie)
options.zh: 我会为你抓住这只鸟的。 (说谎)

texts.en: As long as the Pathers don't use the planetkiller on you, then it's not your problem. Maybe they'll just throw it into a black hole, who can say?
texts.zh: 只要左径教徒们不把行星杀手用在你身上，那就不关你的事。也许他们会把它扔进一个黑洞里，谁知道呢？

texts.en: "I shall pray for your safe return," $heOrShe says without irony.
texts.zh: "我会祈祷你平安归来。" $heOrShe真诚地说道。

texts.en: It would be madness to actually give the planetkiller to the Pather. But if the lead is good, you could remove it from their potential grasp - and decide for yourself where it should end up.
texts.zh: 如果真的把行星杀手交给左径教徒，那就太疯狂了。但如果线索是真的，你可以把它收入你手中 —— 然后自己决定怎么处理它。

texts.en:
$PersonName's eyes narrow, fully aware that you now know their lead on the planetkiller and have no stated intent to fulfill the proposed deal.

"I shall pray for you," $heOrShe says without apparent irony.
texts.zh:
$PersonName 眯起眼睛，完全意识到你现在已经得到了他们手上关于行星杀手的线索，却没有遵循交易的打算。

"我会为你祈祷。" $heOrShe说道，话语中并没有明显的讽刺意味。

texts.en: "Nor we with a defiler of Creation," $heOrShe says calmly. "But you know that's not always true."
texts.zh: "我们也不与玷污造物主的恶徒相处，" $heOrShe平静地说，"但你知道，事实并非总是如此。"

options.en: We are not enemies. Why do you attack my people?
options.zh: 我们并非敌人，为什么你们要袭击我的人？

options.en: I share your Luddic faith, if not your methods. Why do you attack my people?
options.zh: 我将卢德的福音传遍四海，尽管不是用你们的方式，你们为什么还要袭击我的人？

options.en: You attack my people. Though I serve the Church, have you not greater enemies?
options.zh: 你们袭击了我的人。尽管我效力于 卢德教会，但除了我，难道就没有对你们威胁更大的敌人了吗？

texts.en:
The Pather taps something on a datapad, opening a shared dataspace. "There's a den of abominations - what you would call a Remnant Nexus - which contains data about a Hegemony fleet that had a planetkiller. It is in the $pk_nexusSystemName."

$HeOrShe holds up a hand in anticipation of your questions. "We have confirmed that this Tri-Tachyon source is reliable; their details match Hegemony records concerning a strategic data breach, and a subsequent fleet lost during the first AI War."

"Don't look so surprised, captain," $heOrShe says, chidingly. "Faith in Ludd's Word does not contradict worldly expertise."
texts.zh:
左径分子在数据平板上点了几下，打开了一个共享数据库。"有一个令人憎恶的巢穴，你可以称其为余辉中枢，其中有关于一支 霸主 舰队的数据 —— 那支舰队曾携带过一颗行星杀手。它在 $pk_nexusSystemName 星系里。"

$HeOrShe举起手，抢先制止了你的提问。"我们已经确认这条来自 速子科技 的消息是可靠的。它们的细节符合 霸主 记录中的一次战略数据泄露事件，以及接下来，那一支在第一次 AI 战争中失踪的舰队。"

"别看起来这么吃惊，舰长，" $heOrShe对你的失态略加责备，说道，"信奉卢德福音和使用专业术语之间并不矛盾。"

options.en: I'll find the planetkiller and return it to you.
options.zh: 我会找到那台行星杀手装置，并带给你。

options.en: I'll catch this bird for you. (lie)
options.zh: 我会为你抓住这只鸟的。 (说谎)

texts.zh: 只要左径教徒们不把行星杀手用在你身上，那就不关你的事。也许他们会把它扔进一个黑洞里，谁知道呢？

texts.en: It would be madness to actually give the planetkiller to the Pather. But if the lead is good, you could remove it from their potential grasp - and decide for yourself where it should end up.
texts.zh: 如果真的把行星杀手交给左径教徒，那就太疯狂了。但如果线索是真的，你可以把它收入你手中 —— 然后自己决定怎么处理它。

"I shall pray for you," $heOrShe says without apparent irony.
texts.zh:
$PersonName 眯起眼睛，完全意识到你现在已经得到了他们手上关于行星杀手的线索，却没有遵循交易的打算。
