texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, new energy signatures are detected near the $shortName.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，$shortName 附近出现了新的能量信号。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, new energy signatures are detected near a larger piece of debris.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，一块大型残骸附近出现了新的能量信号。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, several energy signatures are detected coming online inside the probe's hold.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，侦测到这艘探测器的货舱内出现了数个能量信号。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, multiple energy signatures are detected coming online from various points on and within the flayed hull of the survey ship.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，勘测舰剥落的船体各处及内部出现了多个新的能量信号。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, numerous strong energy signatures are detected coming online inside the darkened work-bays of the mothership's vast hulk. Your sensors also detect several weapon emplacements powering up on the mothership itself.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，母舰庞大舰体内部那些昏暗的工作舱中出现了大量强劲的能量信号。你的传感器还检测到母舰本体上的数个武器装置正在启动供能。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, numerous strong energy signatures are detected coming online inside the darkened work-bays of the mothership's vast hulk.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，母舰庞大舰体内部那些昏暗的工作舱中出现了大量强劲的能量信号。

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, your sensors detect several weapon emplacements powering up in darkened crevasses on the mothership's vast hulk.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，你的传感器检测到母舰庞大舰体上的那些阴暗裂缝中有数个武器装置正在启动供能。

texts.en:
As your $shipOrFleet moves into a close holding orbit, an executive summary of the hypershunt's specifications is helpfully presented by your TriPad's pseudo-AI assistant.

The bridge sounds an alert as several previously undifferentiated shapes detach themselves from the superstructure and smoothly accelerate towards your fleet just as you finish reading, "-and for reasons of safety, automated defense drones are no longer a standard feature."

Your tactical officer waves for your attention, "We're close enough to the magfield generated by the megastructure that the anticipated combat volume should be unaffected by the star's corona. Mostly. However," they examine their console, "The hostiles, they're... unknown profile. Incoming fast." They are starting to look concerned, and in a brittle voice say, "This might be something new, captain."
texts.zh:
当你的$shipOrFleet进入了近距离保持轨道时，你的 TriPad 上的拟 AI 助手帮你调出了一份超空间分流器的规格概要。

舰桥里警报声大作：有几个先前无法正常识别的复杂几何造物从你面前的巨构中分离了出来，平稳地朝你的$shipOrFleet加速移动。这时你正好才读到，"—— 而且出于安全考虑，不再将自主防御无人舰作为标准配置。"

你的战术军官向你挥手，示意有情况要汇报，"我们现在离巨型设施的磁场足够近，预计我们在这里作战可以免受星冕的影响，大概，但..." 对方查看了一下控制台，"敌舰... 舰型未知。而且来得很快。" 气氛开始变得不安，对方用发紧的声音说道，"这是些没人见过的东西，舰长。"

texts.en:
As your $shipOrFleet moves into a close holding orbit, an executive summary of the hypershunt's specifications is helpfully presented by your TriPad's pseudo-AI assistant.

The bridge sounds an alert as a swarm of previously undifferentiated shapes detach themselves from the superstructure and begin to accelerate towards your fleet just as you finish reading, "-and for reasons of safety, automated defense drones are no longer a standard feature."

Your tactical officer waves for your attention, "We're close enough to the magfield generated by the megastructure that the anticipated combat volume should be unaffected by the star's corona. Mostly. However," they examine their console, "The hostiles, picking up AI War remnants, and..." a brittleness enters their voice, "Unknown... a couple unknown profiles. Incoming fast."
texts.zh:
当你的$shipOrFleet驶入近距离保持轨道，你 TriPad 上的拟 AI 助手贴心地呈上一份超空间分流器的规格概要。

你刚读到"——出于安全考量，自动防御无人机已不再是标准配置"，舰桥便响起警报：一群先前分不清轮廓的东西正从主体结构上脱离，朝你的舰队加速扑来。

你的战术官挥手唤你注意，"我们已经进入这座巨构生成的磁场范围，预计交战空域大体不受恒星日冕影响。大体上。不过，" 对方查看了一眼控制台，"来袭目标里，扫到了第一次 AI 战争的余辉，还有..." 声音里透出几分生硬，"未知...有两三个未知型号。来得很快。"

texts.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, sensors detect multiple contacts rising up from the murky red depths.
texts.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，传感器检测到有多个接触信号出现在了正下方，犹如从浑浊的红色深海之中浮出。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam!"

Your comms officer calls for your attention with an excited look, "I'm picking up an anomalous signal, it's an open channel. Just a carrier signal, a low-grade military fallback standard. Very faint and lossy. We're really only picking this up because of the MILAUX package installed in our comms system to help integrate with Hegemony fleet actions."

"Shall I open a link?" Their hands don't quite tremble over the controls. Whatever is using this frequency is either Hegemony or has some of their less secure emergency codes.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam！"

你的通讯军官兴奋地叫住你，"我捕获到一个开放频道上的异常信号，虽然只是个低级军事备用标准、微弱且有损的载波。要不是为了与 霸主 舰队协同作战而在通信系统中安装了辅助军组件，我们绝对无法捕获这样的信号。"

"我该建立链接吗？" 对方的手紧贴控制面板，几近颤抖。使用这一载波频率的对象，若不是 霸主 官方，便是其他掌握 霸主 低安全等级的应急编码之人。

texts.en:
Your comms officer tags the faint carrier wave which is using an obscure Hegemony signal standard. Someone - or perhaps no one - has been waiting for a response for quite some time.

"Shall I open a link?" your comms officer asks, mostly keeping their excitement over a mystery signal under control. Mostly.
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官标记了那个似乎遵循着 霸主 标准的微弱载波信号。那里或许已经有人久候多时，又或许早已人去船空。

"我该建立链接吗？" 你的通讯军官问道，面对着这样一个神秘信号，这位军官已经几乎按捺不住自己的兴奋了。

texts.en:
Your $shipOrFleet maneuvers closer to the asteroid.

Your sensors officer gives a shout of alarm - bogeys are spilling out of the asteroid, clouds of loosely-piled regolith and stealth-sheath panels spinning away as they are caught by thruster-bursts. The angular forms of Domain XIV Battlegroup hulls appear, veteran ships judging by the obvious field repairs. The IDs are automatically tagged and collated into the tactical display.

You have no time to ask why a ghost fleet from the First AI War has ambushed you.
texts.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet开始机动，并向小行星靠近。

你的传感器技官拉响了警报 —— 敌机正从小行星中涌出，松散的小行星物质和隐形护板在喷吐烈焰的推进器前四散纷飞。人之领 第十四战斗群那棱角分明的船体已显露出来，无数现场抢修在船体上留下的痕迹诉说着这支舰队纵横沙场的过往。舰船识别信息被标记、整合，并投射在战术显示器上。

你没时间质问为何一支来自第一次 AI 战争的幽灵舰队会伏击你。

options.en: Try to open a comm link on this channel
options.zh: 尝试在此频道建立通讯链接

options.en: Ignore it and close in on the asteroid
Try to open a comm link on this channel
options.zh: 尝试在此频道建立通讯链接

options.en: Ignore it and close in on the asteroid

texts.en:
Comms opens the link. Your sensors and tactical officers start flickering interfaces on their control consoles, and they exchange a look.

Tactical begins with a report, "SIGINT matches... almost... with previous encounters with autonomous Domain warships."

"I think," your comms officer jumps in, "I think I can convince their governing routines to stand-down from aggressive guard mode. We've got part of a very old Domain codeset in the Hegemony MILAUX package, meant to help auxiliaries avoid getting blasted by auto-defenses. We can't order a complete stand-down though; they didn't give us everything."
texts.zh:
通讯军官建立了链接。你的传感器技官与战术军官在他们的控制面板上频繁地切换着界面，两人交换了一个眼神。

战术军官向你报告道，"根据信号情报... 这几乎匹配... 匹配于我们之前遭遇过的 人之领 的自动化战舰。"

"我认为..." 你的通讯军官插话道，"我认为我可以命令它们的主控程序退出攻击性警戒模式。霸主辅助军组件中有一部分非常古老的 人之领 指令集，用于帮助辅助军避免被那些自动防御系统摧毁。不过我们不能命令它们完全解除警戒，霸主 没有把所有指令全交给我们。"

options.en: Try the codes. Maybe we can avoid a fight.
options.zh: 试试那条指令。我们或许可以避免与之一战。
战术军官，你说的 '几乎匹配' 是有多匹配？

options.en: Close the link and close in on the asteroid
options.zh: 关闭链接并接近小行星

texts.en:
Your comms officer gives a sanguine "Aye $playerSirOrMadam!" and starts transmitting. Your tactical officer turns to their station with a grim look.

You're not held long in suspense, for a fraction of a second after transmission an acknowledgment ping flashes on your comms officer's console. The asteroid blooms, casting undetected bogeys from itself in glowing icons on the tactical display. The bogeys form up into a standard patrol formation with inhuman synchronization.

It would have been a spectacular ambush to walk into.
texts.zh:
通讯军官骄傲地回复道："是，$playerSirOrMadam！" 并开始了传输。战术军官则一脸严肃地转向了自己的工作站。

这份悬念并未保持很久，在代码传输完成后不到一秒，对方的响应便已闪烁于通讯军官的控制面板上。小行星如花苞绽放般打开，原先未被探测到的敌机从中释放而出，在战术显示器上被投影为一个个发亮的图标。它们以一种人类所无法企及的协调性组建成了标准的巡逻阵型。

刚才若是贸然接近，一定会上演一场华丽的伏击战吧。

texts.en:
Hull-ids come in; combat-scarred XIV Battlegroup hulls, repaired without orbital dockyards. A veteran fleet, for sure. Between the fact that they've been hidden here for many cycles and your SIGINT, it is clear that humans do not command these ships.

But now the way is clear. Tactical mutters to sensors about keeping an eye on the automated swarm.
texts.zh:
舷号映入眼帘，第十四战斗群舰体上刻着被战火洗礼所留下的痕迹，那是不使用轨道船坞进行修复的证明。毫无疑问，这是一支久经沙场的舰队。从它们在数十个星历年间隐藏于此的事实，以及你收集的信号情报来看，这些舰船显然并非由人类指挥。

但至少，前路已然畅通无阻。战术军官低语着吩咐传感器技官，让其对自动化舰队时刻保持警惕。

options.en: Send a salvor team to access the cache
options.zh: 派遣打捞小组前往藏匿点

texts.en:
Your ops chief oversees the operation with familiar gruffness and wariness.

The salvors use a cloud of microdrones to cast a sensor net over the asteroid, coordinating with your $shipOrFleet's technicians to map density anomalies. There are faster methods, but this is the best way to find the surprises that tend to be left to protect far-flung caches.

The rock is spotted with hiding holes, empty, and fuel and supply stores, also empty. No surprise fusion mines or pinhead AM traps. Ops finally gives the order, and the salvors move in to uncover the camouflaged access point.
texts.zh:
你的行动长官一如以往，以粗中带细的风格指挥着打捞行动。

打捞员们使用一群微型无人机在小行星上组建了一个传感器网络，并与你$shipOrFleet的技术人员协同测绘了藏匿点的密度异常情况。虽然这不是最快捷的打捞技术，但要想完好地找到散落在藏匿点中的宝藏，这便是最好的办法了。

这块岩石上遍布着空的隐蔽洞穴，燃料和供给存储点中也空无一物。在确认没有聚变诡雷或者微型反物质陷阱后，行动长官终于下达了命令，打捞员们开始探测隐藏的对接口。

texts.en:
The shaky image from a salvor's helmetcam reveals the carapace of terrestrial death, glittering in the chaotic play of suitlamps.

One planetkiller.

Your ops chief cuts the excited chatter between salvors with a harsh word, and they return to procedural call-and-response. The planetkiller is soon secured in your flagship.
texts.zh:
头戴式摄像机传回的抖动画面之中，映出了崩灭大地之物的外壳，它在便携灯混乱的照射下闪闪发光。

那是一台行星杀手。

你的行动长官一声令下，打断了打捞员们兴奋的七嘴八舌，他们又开始一如既往地做出回复。行星杀手很快就被送到了你的旗舰上。

texts.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Many a powerful faction will want to secure this weapon so that they may not be dethroned in a shock-atrocity, and many a minor faction will want to use it to secure respect and protection. Ludd only knows what the Pathers would do with it, to say nothing of pirates.
texts.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域每个人头顶上的不祥阴影。它那残暴肆虐的力量，是曾让 Opis、Hanan Pacha 以及其他世界覆灭的罪魁祸首。

许多强大的势力都希望能拥有这样一件武器，来确保他们不会因为一次闪电突袭就被踢下王座。而许多二流势力也希望用其确保自己能受到尊重和保护。至于左径信徒会拿这件装置干些什么，恐怕只有卢德他老人家才会知道，更别提那些海盗了。

texts.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Ludd only knows what the Luddic Path would plan to do with such a device, and when you made your agreement, you didn't intend to find out by doing something so foolish as handing it over.

They might guess what you've found, however. In time, word will trickle through their network of Watchers, whether from some informant in your crew, or prayer and guesswork.
texts.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域所有人类头顶上的不祥阴影；在被它蹂躏过的其它所有世界上，包括 Opis，Hanan Pacha 在内，都留下了刻骨铭心的伤痛。

只有卢德他老人家才知道左径信徒会打算用这样的装置干些什么，而当你敲定这笔交易时，可没有蠢到简简单单地把行星杀手交出去只为了看看这样做会带来何种后果。

无论你作出何种努力，他们都会很快知道你发现了些什么。消息会通过他们的监视网络不胫而走，无论是来自你船员中的线人，亦或者是祈祷与臆测。

texts.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Ludd only knows what the Luddic Path plans to do with such a device. You did agree to hand it over to them, however. Perhaps they simply want to guarantee their safety and standing in the Sector. Perhaps they want to destroy the abomination.

Whatever you choose to do, they will know what you've found before long. Word will trickle through their network of Watchers, whether from some informant in your crew, or prayer and guesswork.
texts.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域所有人类头顶上的不祥阴影；在被它蹂躏过的其它所有世界上，包括 Opis，Hanan Pacha 在内，都留下了刻骨铭心的伤痛。

只有卢德他老人家才知道左径信徒会打算用这样的装置干些什么。然而你已经同意把行星杀手交给他们，也许他们只是想保障自己在这片星域里的安全和立足之地 —— 也许他们只是想毁掉这台可怕的憎恶科技造物。

无论你作出何种努力，他们都会很快知道你发现了些什么。消息会通过他们的监视网络不胫而走，无论是来自你船员中的线人，亦或者是祈祷与臆测。

texts.en:
"It's strange, $playerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer says, eyes flicking between displays. "They're using protocols newer than Domain-era, but certainly not recent Hegemony. It looks like something out of... the First AI War, I'd say."

Which could suggest something dangerous, and potentially more sophisticated than the current standard of Persean Sector military technology.
texts.zh:
"这很奇怪，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你战术军官向你说道，眼神来回扫过各个显示器，"它们的协议相较 人之领 时代的要更新些，但肯定又不是近期 霸主 所使用的那些协议。这似乎是出自于...要我说的话，第一次 AI 战争。"

这可能意味着这里埋藏着某些危险的东西，且其协议可能比当今英仙座星域军事标准的那些都更为复杂。

texts.en:
Comms opens the link. Your sensors and tactical officers start flickering interfaces on their control consoles, and they exchange a look.

Tactical begins with a report, "SIGINT matches... almost... with previous encounters with autonomous Domain warships."

"I think," your comms officer jumps in, "I think I can convince their governing routines to stand-down from aggressive guard mode. We've got part of a very old Domain codeset in the Hegemony MILAUX package, meant to help auxiliaries avoid getting blasted by auto-defenses. We can't order a complete stand-down though; they didn't give us everything."
texts.zh:
通讯军官建立了链接。你的传感器技官与战术军官在他们的控制面板上频繁地切换着界面，两人交换了一个眼神。

战术军官向你报告道，"根据信号情报... 这几乎匹配... 匹配于我们之前遭遇过的 人之领 的自动化战舰。"

"我认为..." 你的通讯军官插话道，"我认为我可以命令它们的主控程序退出攻击性警戒模式。霸主辅助军组件中有一部分非常古老的 人之领 指令集，用于帮助辅助军避免被那些自动防御系统摧毁。不过我们不能命令它们完全解除警戒，霸主 没有把所有指令全交给我们。"

options.en: Try the codes. Maybe we can avoid a fight.
options.zh: 试试那条指令。我们或许可以避免与之一战。
战术军官，你说的 '几乎匹配' 是有多匹配？

options.en: Close the link and close in on the asteroid
options.zh: 关闭链接并接近小行星

texts.en:
"It's strange, $playerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer says, eyes flicking between displays. "They're using protocols newer than Domain-era, but certainly not recent Hegemony. It looks like something out of... the First AI War, I'd say."

Which could suggest something dangerous, and potentially more sophisticated than the current standard of Persean Sector military technology.
texts.zh:
"这很奇怪，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你战术军官向你说道，眼神来回扫过各个显示器，"它们的协议相较 人之领 时代的要更新些，但肯定又不是近期 霸主 所使用的那些协议。这似乎是出自于...要我说的话，第一次 AI 战争。"

这可能意味着这里埋藏着某些危险的东西，且其协议可能比当今英仙座星域军事标准的那些都更为复杂。

texts.en:
Your comms officer gives a sanguine "Aye $playerSirOrMadam!" and starts transmitting. Your tactical officer turns to their station with a grim look.

You're not held long in suspense, for a fraction of a second after transmission an acknowledgment ping flashes on your comms officer's console. The asteroid blooms, casting undetected bogeys from itself in glowing icons on the tactical display. The bogeys form up into a standard patrol formation with inhuman synchronization.

It would have been a spectacular ambush to walk into.
texts.zh:
通讯军官骄傲地回复道："是，$playerSirOrMadam！" 并开始了传输。战术军官则一脸严肃地转向了自己的工作站。

这份悬念并未保持很久，在代码传输完成后不到一秒，对方的响应便已闪烁于通讯军官的控制面板上。小行星如花苞绽放般打开，原先未被探测到的敌机从中释放而出，在战术显示器上被投影为一个个发亮的图标。它们以一种人类所无法企及的协调性组建成了标准的巡逻阵型。

刚才若是贸然接近，一定会上演一场华丽的伏击战吧。

texts.en:
Hull-ids come in; combat-scarred XIV Battlegroup hulls, repaired without orbital dockyards. A veteran fleet, for sure. Between the fact that they've been hidden here for many cycles and your SIGINT, it is clear that humans do not command these ships.

But now the way is clear. Tactical mutters to sensors about keeping an eye on the automated swarm.
texts.zh:
舷号映入眼帘，第十四战斗群舰体上刻着被战火洗礼所留下的痕迹，那是不使用轨道船坞进行修复的证明。毫无疑问，这是一支久经沙场的舰队。从它们在数十个星历年间隐藏于此的事实，以及你收集的信号情报来看，这些舰船显然并非由人类指挥。

但至少，前路已然畅通无阻。战术军官低语着吩咐传感器技官，让其对自动化舰队时刻保持警惕。

options.en: Send a salvor team to access the cache
options.zh: 派遣打捞小组前往藏匿点

texts.en:
Your ops chief oversees the operation with familiar gruffness and wariness.

The salvors use a cloud of microdrones to cast a sensor net over the asteroid, coordinating with your $shipOrFleet's technicians to map density anomalies. There are faster methods, but this is the best way to find the surprises that tend to be left to protect far-flung caches.

The rock is spotted with hiding holes, empty, and fuel and supply stores, also empty. No surprise fusion mines or pinhead AM traps. Ops finally gives the order, and the salvors move in to uncover the camouflaged access point.
texts.zh:
你的行动长官一如以往，以粗中带细的风格指挥着打捞行动。

打捞员们使用一群微型无人机在小行星上组建了一个传感器网络，并与你$shipOrFleet的技术人员协同测绘了藏匿点的密度异常情况。虽然这不是最快捷的打捞技术，但要想完好地找到散落在藏匿点中的宝藏，这便是最好的办法了。

这块岩石上遍布着空的隐蔽洞穴，燃料和供给存储点中也空无一物。在确认没有聚变诡雷或者微型反物质陷阱后，行动长官终于下达了命令，打捞员们开始探测隐藏的对接口。

texts.en:
The shaky image from a salvor's helmetcam reveals the carapace of terrestrial death, glittering in the chaotic play of suitlamps.

One planetkiller.

Your ops chief cuts the excited chatter between salvors with a harsh word, and they return to procedural call-and-response. The planetkiller is soon secured in your flagship.
texts.zh:
头戴式摄像机传回的抖动画面之中，映出了崩灭大地之物的外壳，它在便携灯混乱的照射下闪闪发光。

那是一台行星杀手。

你的行动长官一声令下，打断了打捞员们兴奋的七嘴八舌，他们又开始一如既往地做出回复。行星杀手很快就被送到了你的旗舰上。

texts.en:
With the automated defenses cleared, your salvors are free to crack open the enormous zero-G vaults of the cache. Power is provided to dead conduits, fused circuits replaced with temporary fittings, and the great doors persuaded to loosen their mechanical restraints.

At first, it appears to be empty. A colossal tomb, never filled. Then probe-mounted radar starts to build a picture in your bridge display while suit lights pile their beams into the space, catching drifts of dust and gas set afloat by the re-opening. Spars gleam in the dark, revealing trifold radial symmetry.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tech officer says, attention fixed not on the suit cams or bridge display but on technical specs scrolling through a display already overfull with diagrams and documents. "You have to see this."
texts.zh:
解决掉自动化防御系统之后，你的打捞员们便可毫无阻拦地打开贮藏点巨大的无重力仓库。失去能量的管道被重新充能，融毁的线路被临时衔接替换，面前的大门终于被驯服，并缓缓松开了其机械门锁。

第一眼望去，仓库内似乎空无一物。仿佛一座巨大却又空旷的墓穴。随后，探测机上的雷达开始在你的舰桥屏幕上构造一副画面，而宇航服上的灯光也再度穿过被打开的大门所激起的尘埃，照向仓库深处。远处一些的闪烁的光点显示出了三重放射式对称的姿态。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 你的技术军官说到，他的注意力并不在舰桥投影或者宇航服摄像头画面之上，而是在翻阅一个屏幕上满满的数据图表和文件。"你得看看这个。"

texts.en:
The enormous zero-G vaults of the cache lie open, its depths black with portent like a colossal tomb.

The ancient wormhole anchor waits at its center, the flicker and caress of status queries returning green, mostly. It is still primed for use at the nearby stable location, but the shipment of transplutonics its automated systems were waiting for were never delivered.
texts.zh:
随着巨大零重力仓库的大门的敞开，其内部深邃的黑暗犹如一座巨型墓穴。

古老的 虫洞锚定装置 静候于其中，若干闪烁的状态显示灯大多闪烁着绿光来回应系统询问。此装置依旧有着在附近 稳定点 部署的适配数据，但是自动化系统所需的稀有元素却一直未被送达。

texts.en:
Your $shipOrFleet arrives at the coordinates provided by the scientist $saic_marketOnOrAt $saic_marketName, and just as $saic_heOrShe said, there is an impressive bounty of Domain-era goods and technology in nearly pristine condition. And in the middle of it all your salvage crew reports a cargo case bearing a Tri-Tachyon logo. It's emitting a bizarre, dynamic magnetic field extending two meters beyond the casing.

It's amazing that no one found this cache before, but then the long-range sensors did read it as a worthless debris cloud at first. The question is now, do you close the AI core into the shielded crate and send it off from your next port stop, or do you keep it for yourself? That scientist was surely no one important.
texts.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet到达了之前在 $saic_marketName 酒吧里遇到的学者所提供的坐标位置。如$saic_heOrShe所言，这里简直是塞满 人之领 时期的货物和科技物品的宝库，且基本上原封未动。你的一名打捞人员向你汇报，在这些物件之中发现了一个带有 速子科技 标志的上了锁的小箱子。它产生了一个奇怪的动态磁场，范围延伸到箱外两米左右。

令人惊讶的是，之前居然没有任何人发现这个藏匿处。不过刚开始的时候从远程传感器的读数上看，这里的确是被误判成了毫无价值的残骸区。现在眼下的问题是，你是打算把 AI 核心封入屏蔽箱，在下次靠港时将它快递寄走，还是说你打算把它据为己有？毕竟那个学者肯定只是个无足轻重的角色。

texts.en:
The long-haul cryosystems were built to last for centuries of interstellar travel so it's no surprise that most of the pod-support machinery reads as functional. While safe sleeper revival is beyond the capability of your fleet, a colony established within 10 light-years of this location could benefit from a huge influx in population if it built facilities to awaken long-haul sleepers.

Your executive officer cautions that it's unknown whether having sleepers make up a large percentage of a colony's population would cause any physical or psychological issues down the line.
texts.zh:
长途冷冻设施是为进行长达数个世纪的星际旅行为目的设计建造的，因此不出意料的，大部分的冷冻舱维持机构的读数显示其运作正常。虽然你的舰队没有能力安全地复苏休眠者，但在 10 光年范围内建立的殖民地可以通过建设低温复苏设施来获得庞大的人口流入量。

你的行政官员提醒你，目前还尚未明确复苏者在殖民地的人口中占比过高是否会引发潜在的生理或心理问题。

texts.en:
Salvage crews board the structure at key points and soon reports come in of extensive wear and damage. It is difficult to assess the entire structure in detail, but it is clear that it is not operable in its current state.

However, as with most mega-scale Domain technology from the late pre-Collapse era, the $nameInText features fantastic self-repair capabilities which requires only sufficient resources to be made available.
texts.zh:
打捞人员登上了设施的关键部位，并很快回报了大量的损伤与消耗。虽然很难对整个设施进行详细的评估，但很明显，它在目前的状态下是无法运作的。

幸好，和其他大崩塌前最后建造的 人之领 巨型技术遗物一样，$nameInText 具有奇迹般强大的自主修复能力，只需要提供足够的资源就可以进行自我修复。

texts.en: This structure appears to be fully functional.
texts.zh: 该设施看起来运作正常。

texts.en: This structure is currently undergoing automated self-repair which should be completed in short order.
texts.zh: 该设施目前正在进行自动化的自我修复，应该会在短期内完成。

texts.en:
Further scans reveal that the energy field is not entirely uniform - perhaps owing to a running-down power source - and your bridge crew is able to pick up a distress beacon transmitting from the surface.

The transmission is set on repeat and garbled in ways that are indicative of aging equipment. You make out enough to gather that part of a research team was stranded here - at a secret Tri-Tachyon research facility - after the fully automated defenses over-weighed certain executive security contingency orders in the wake of one of the AI Wars and decided it was now imperative to shoot down any craft attempting to leave the planet.
texts.zh:
进一步的扫描显示，能量场并不均一完整，可能是由于能量源已经年久失修。同时你的舰桥人员设法发现了一个从星球表面发出讯号的遇险信标。

该讯号被设定不断重播，且因为设备老化而产生了乱码。你从其中可以解读的信息推断，这里是 速子 的机密研究机构。在某一次 AI 战争期间，自动化防御系统对某条紧急安全命令采取了过激的响应，决定击毁任何试图离开这个星球的飞船，导致一支研究小组的部分成员被滞留在了这里。

texts.en:
The rock that autonomous fleet was defending is pocked with hiding holes, empty, and fuel and supply stores, also empty. After a thorough sensor sweep, your ops chief finally gives the order, and the salvors move in to uncover a camouflaged access point.

The shaky image from a helmetcam reveals the carapace of terrestrial death, glittering in the chaotic play of suitlamps.

One planetkiller.

Your ops chief cuts the excited chatter between salvors with a harsh word, and they return to procedural call-and-response. The planetkiller is soon secured in your flagship.
texts.zh:
那支全自动舰队所保护的小行星上布满了空荡荡的隐藏洞穴，里面的燃料和补给库空空如也。在彻底的传感器扫描后，你的行动长官终于下达了命令，让打捞员们进入了其中一个隐藏的对接口。

头戴式摄像机传回的抖动画面之中，映出了崩灭大地之物的外壳，它在便携灯混乱的照射下闪闪发光。

那是一台行星杀手。

你的行动长官一声令下，打断了打捞员们兴奋的七嘴八舌，他们又开始一如既往地做出回复。行星杀手很快就被送到了你的旗舰上。

options.en: Place the Tri-Tachyon case into the shielded crate and send it off as soon as possible
options.zh: 将核心放入学者提供的屏蔽箱内，并尽快寄出

options.en: Take the AI core for yourself
options.zh: 将 AI 核心据为己有

options.en: Send a salvage team down to the facility
options.zh: 派遣打捞小组前往研究机构

texts.en:
It's old. Very old. But the queries sent by your salvors' interfacers are returning green. For the most part.

"It's a wormhole anchor," your tech officer explains, excitement palpable. "Loaded with calibration data, and fuel to power whatever it was going to do. This was prepped to deploy at the nearby, um, point of stability. The automation went into standby at some point, and... here it is."
texts.zh:
它很古老。非常古老。但你的打捞员们通过交互界面发出的查询大多还是成功了。

"这是个虫洞锚定装置。" 你的技术军官兴奋地解释道，"里面满是校准数据，以及足够它运行的燃料。这东西原先是部署于，呃，某个稳定点附近的。它的自动进程在某个时候进入了待机状态，然后... 就搁这儿了。"

texts.en: The shielded crate shuts with the sound of powered bolts sliding home. It sends off a one-time coded hyperwave burst. Confirmation, you suppose. It would have been good of that scientist to warn you about this little trick; hopefully no pirates - or anything else - was listening nearby.
texts.zh: 屏蔽箱在电动闩滑动就位的声响中锁死了。这时它送出了一个一次性编码的超波突发通信。应该是确认讯号，你猜想到。但如果那个学者能提前跟你提一下这个小把戏就好了，现在只能希望附近没有海盗或是其他什么东西正在监听。

options.en: Loot the rest of the cache
options.zh: 把藏匿处的其他东西带走

texts.en: You open the Tri-Tachyon case and retrieve a single Alpha Core. It pulses with activity, and your smile is underlit by the cold, alien thoughts of the core. You order the scientist's shielded crate tossed out the airlock. If you want something done in this world, you'd best do it yourself.
texts.zh: 你打开了这曾属于 速子科技 的箱子，从中收获了一枚 Alpha 核心。核心的光芒随着它的运作不断地脉动，那冰冷的非人类思维因而照亮了你的笑脸。你下令把学者的屏蔽箱扔出气闸 —— 如果想在这乱世中办妥什么事，那最好别把它托给别人。

options.en: Loot the rest of the cache
options.zh: 把藏匿处的其他东西带走

texts.en:
Your TriPad chimes in with a helpful analysis: if brought online, this structure allows a colony within 10 light-years to establish 1 additional industry, provided it has a hypershunt tap installed and can maintain a healthy supply of transplutonics.

Ancient schematics in the TriPad's memory indicate a particular cargo area dedicated to storing these "taps", but salvage crews report that it is empty.

That Tri-Tachyon would have this information so readily available in their standard orbital works expert system database gives you just a moment of pause.
texts.zh:
你的 TriPad 提供了一个有用的分析结果：如果启动，这个设施允许 10 光年内的殖民地建立一个额外的工业设施，前提是在殖民地安装一个{超分流阀门}，并能保证充足的稀有元素供应。

储存在 TriPad 记忆体中的古老蓝图显示，设施中有一个用于存放这些 "阀门" 的专用货物区，但打捞人员报告说它是空的。

速子科技 居然在他们的标准轨道工业设施专家系统数据库里准备了这么详尽的信息，这让你稍微愣了一下。

options.en: Offload sufficient resources to repair the structure
options.zh: 提供足以修复结构的资源

texts.en:
Your crews finish offloading the raw materials and you send an activation signal to the structure's distributed repair nodes.

There's barely any reaction at first, just a smattering of previously undetected relays pinging one another through the superstructure. Your science officer assures you that the repair rate will increase exponentially, pulling up a display showing the relay pings expanding outward and the energy transmission curve steadily rising. After only minutes, despite little visual change, the overall heat output on sensors has increased dramatically. Whatever is quickening in the heart of this celestial machine...

"Captain," your science officer interrupts your thoughts hesitantly, "We may wish to pull the fleet back by a hundred klicks or so." You nod and give the order.

The $nameInText should be online in short order.
texts.zh:
船员完成了原料的卸载，你向该设施的分散式维修节点发送了激活信号。

一开始几乎没有任何反应，只是由有少数几个之前没发现的中继节点开始在超构造体中相互传递信息。科学专家保证修复速率将会以指数形式成倍增加，并拉出一个显示屏向你展示中继节点的信息传递在逐渐向外扩展，同时能量传输曲线稳步上升。短短的几分钟之后，尽管外观没有什么变化，但传感器显示的总体热输出已经急剧上升。不管是什么，有什么东西正在这个天体级大小的机器的心脏里加速...

"舰长，" 科学专家有些犹豫地打断了你的思考，"我们最好让舰队后撤一百星里左右。" 你点点头，下达了命令。

$nameInText 应该在短时间内上线。

texts.en: A tiny shuttle with a jury-rigged shield generator darts through a spot failure in the shield. A landing at the primary control center is achieved without incident and the crew is able to deactivate the shield entirely upon breaching the facility. Follow-up shuttles with heavier equipment launch quickly thereafter, and soon the salvage operation is in full swing.
texts.zh: 你派出一艘临时加装了护盾发生器的穿梭机，让它突入了护盾的一处破损点。穿梭机在主控制中心顺利着陆，机组人员成功突入设施，将护盾完全解除。随后，携带重型设备的后援穿梭机迅速跟进，开始全面展开打捞作业。

options.zh: 在打捞物中挑选战利品

options.en: Consider whether special measures might be taken to recover this ship
options.zh: 考虑是否采取特别措施来恢复这艘船

options.en: Consider whether special measures might be taken to recover this ship
options.zh: 考虑是否采取特殊手段抢救这艘船

texts.en:
Salvage teams dock their drone-shuttles at various entry points along the massive vessel's hull. At the precise moment the go-order is given, all telemetry feeds from the shuttles simultaneously blank out.

Your bridge officers initiate fallback procedures with practiced speed, contacting subordinates, performing checks and reinitializations to establish precisely where the systems fault occurred - and determine if it was a hostile act. Several agonizing minutes later, the salvage teams' data-feed and comms snap back to life.

"Captain!" Your tactical officer salutes, then launches into a status report, "Someone or something just tried to send a power core collapse signal to the shuttles' computers. Fortunately the security package caught it in time, but they had to perform a full systems shutdown and manually switch to backups; that's why their telemetry cut off. All salvage teams are now reporting all-green and are standing by."
texts.zh:
打捞小组将他们的无人穿梭机部署并对接在这艘巨型船体的各个入口处。在舰桥下令进入的时候，同一时间的所有的遥测信息反馈都消失了。

舰桥立即发出撤退指令，并且联络下属开始执行检查并试图初始化无人机，以精准定位系统故障的位置 —— 同时试图判断这是不是敌对行为。整个舰桥这几分钟都像热锅上的蚂蚁，打捞小组的通讯和数据反馈终于恢复了。

"长官！" 你的战术军官在你面前标准地敬了一个礼，并且开始向你报告状况，"有人试图对我们的穿梭机的内部电脑发送动力系统崩溃指令。幸运的是安全系统及时拦截了它，但我们不得不重启整个系统并且手动切换到备份上；以上是遥测被切断的原因。现在整个打捞小组随时可以出动。"

texts.en: Your salvage teams dock shuttles at various entry points along the vessel's massive hull.
texts.zh: 你的多支打捞小组分别对接在这艘巨舰船体上的各个入口上。

texts.en:
Your sensors officer begins a preliminary high-power scan of the dark mass as your operations chief preps salvor teams.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, this looks... there's nothing quite like this on file, but..." Sensors gives up on words and pulls a detailed false-color scan into the primary display.

Someone lets out a gasp.

The database assistant algorithm won't provide a positive ID, but that form is unmistakable to the human eye.

This is the Onslaught Mk.I, the ship of legend.
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官准备对这漆黑的大块物体进行高功率扫描，同时行动长官也正在组织打捞小组。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，档案中...没有匹配这玩意的条目，但是..." 传感器技官放弃用言语解释它，转而将详细的伪彩色扫描图像导入主显示器。

有人倒吸一口冷气。

尽管数据库无法提供匹配的信息，但任何人都能一眼辨认出它的轮廓。

那是 攻势 Mk.I，传说般的战舰。

options.en: Whoever tried this, what did they hope to accomplish?
options.zh: 无论是谁干的，他们到底是想要干什么？

texts.en:
Your tactical officer rapidly taps a few buttons; holodisplays flicker through status updates.

"If the shuttle power cores were overloaded simultaneously, well, with the shuttles so close to the wreck? The hull would have likely been damaged past any hope of recovery. In addition to killing the salvor crews, of course. But I don't think that was their goal; there are easier ways to kill salvage crews."

As you indicate to your operations chief to ready the salvage teams for a second attempt, your tactical officer adds, "It comes to mind that what we just experienced was an attempt at an old Tri-Tach trick from the Second AI War. They left black-box EW traps to keep the Hegemony from recovering intel and tech from disabled hulls. And it worked. For a while, anyway. I'm just glad we kept that legacy commsec package installed."
texts.zh:
你的战术军官快速地摁了几个按钮，全息投影上闪现出了更新过的数据。

"假如在距离残骸这么近的情况下，所有穿梭机的能量核心同时被过载的话会怎么样？那这船体就可能受到严重的损伤，没有修复的希望了。当然也会杀死打捞小组，但我认为这并不是他们的目的，毕竟明显有比这更容易杀死打捞小组的办法。"

当你指示行动长官让打捞小组做好开展第二次尝试的准备的时候，战术军官补充道，"长官，看起来刚刚我们遇到的应该是第二次 AI 战争时 速子科技 用的小把戏罢了。他们会在黑匣子上留下电磁脉冲陷阱，防止 霸主 从他们停机的船体里回收提取有价值的信息和科技。这方法挺管用的，至少管用过一段时间。我还蛮高兴那些旧的通讯链接安全包都还装着没被卸掉。"

texts.en:
You dismiss your tactical officer and ponder the situation as the call-and-return proceeds between your command crew and the salvage teams waiting at standby. Reports trickle up through the hierarchy, from junior officers in after-action/sim analyst teams to your bridge crew. A picture begins to form that has too many gaps for your liking: The core-collapse signal appears to have originated not exactly in, but uncomfortably near to a secure cargo bay holding an Alpha Core. The core was shielded in complete isolation at the time, and it denies any responsibility as effortlessly as it offers you its service and advice during this crisis, if you would be so kind as to open up a small data-link. You curtly terminate the secured comm-channel and order the AI put back in isolated lock-down.

Your comms officer reports that there is uncertainty whether the AI was involved, or if the signal was sent from that location to throw suspicion onto the core. Both possibilities have troubling implications. In the meantime, however, your ops chief calls in, requesting the order to enter the wreck.
texts.zh:
你结束了与战术军官的讨论，一边考量着当前的情况，一边听着指挥人员和原地待命的打捞小组之间维持着呼叫-应答流程。行动后/模拟分析小组的下级军官们的报告逐层汇总，集中在了你和你的舰桥船员面前。虽然还远不能让你满意，但事件的全貌逐渐被拼凑完全了：这艘舰船上有个装载有 Alpha 核心的安全货舱，发出能量核心崩溃指令的信号源虽然并不在那个货舱内部，但位置近得令人不安。AI 核心在事件发生时正受到屏蔽，与外界完全隔绝，而它一边拒绝为此事件负责，一边积极地自荐要在这场危机中为你提供帮助和建议，只要你能好心地帮它打开一个小小的数据链接。你毫不客气地终止了 Alpha 核心的隔离通讯频道，并下令把它重新放进隔离舱。

你的通讯军官汇报道，并不确定这次是 AI 参与了这一事件，还是信号源被故意放在核心附近，以便将怀疑引向核心。这两种可能性细推下去都令人感到担忧。然而，就在这时，行动长官接入通讯，申请再次进入残骸中。

texts.en:
After a few tense minutes, reports start to come in - the vessel is heavily damaged, and though of exotic design, it is theoretically recoverable.

Your operations chief reports that for all of the fancy hull features, it is clear that this ship requires crew to operate. But there are no traces of a crew, not even a single body caught in the battle damage, and the escape pods are all in their berths.

The operation proceeds with telemetry feeds, salvors' reports, and authorization orders flowing around you, through the bridge of your flagship. You catch yourself listening for that unheard music in a quiet moment, and shake your head just as a comms request from your technology officer appears, bringing you back from your reverie. You accept as a matter of course.
texts.zh:
度过了焦灼的几分钟后，各种报告终于开始汇总了上来 —— 尽管目标舰船构造奇特且受损严重，但理论上还是可以恢复的。

行动长官的报告中描述虽然该船体外观复杂花俏，但这艘船仍需要船员进行操纵。然而打捞小组在调查中并未发现任何船员留下的痕迹，连一具因战损而留下的尸体都没有，甚至连逃生舱也全都原封不动地留在发射槽上。

随着行动的开展，各种遥测回馈、打捞汇报和指令传达的信息在喷涌在你身旁，向旗舰舰桥的各处奔去。你猛然意识到自己正倾听着那一段之前未曾听闻过的旋律，失神了有好一会儿了。你甩了甩头试图让自己回过神，而总工程师的通讯申请这时正巧也传了过来，一同把你拉回了现实。你就如同无事发生一样接受了通讯请求。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, if I understand half of these systems, this ship is truly one of a kind," your technology officer speaks with genuine excitement.

"I've found a device that appears to generate and control - I'm not sure that either is the right word, really - these ... swarming motes, the EM anomalies. The device appears to have two stages, the first as I've described, and what appears to be a later addition which is, unfortunately, damaged beyond repair."

"Judging by the complexity of the components and the bizarre discharge pattern... this is the work of a team of specialists doing bleeding-edge work. It's amazing! A device like this, it's simply unheard of nowadays. Except," Tech looks abashed suddenly, "Rumors. You know, people talk."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，如果我的结论没错，这就是一艘独一无二的舰船。" 你的技术军官的声音里按耐不住其发自内心的兴奋。

"我发现了船上一个负责生成与控制的装置 —— 我真的，不确定我的用词是否准确，那些...尘埃，奇特的电磁脉冲源。这个装置明显有两个阶段，第一个就是我刚刚说的，而第二个...很可惜，坏得彻底。

根据这个设备的复杂度和放电模式...这可是一群专家的最前沿成果。太棒了！这样的装置现今根本无从听闻，除了..." 技官脸一红，"...传说。你知道的，人们喜欢谈的那种。"

texts.en: Your technology officer clears their throat, then continues "I think I can get the main part of this device working again, though I can't claim to understand why it works. Not at all. The ship itself will be fit to fly, too, if we do the usual repairs. Should we proceed with recovery?"
texts.zh: 技术军官清了清嗓子，随后继续说了下去。"我觉得，我可以让这个装置的主要部分再度正常工作，但我得说我一点都不知道它是怎么运作的。如果执行维修，大概就能让这艘船重新飞起来。所以，我们要开始恢复吗？"

texts.en:
How old must it be, thousands of cycles?

If you had been asked a shift ago, your reasonable reply would have been to call it a myth. The Onslaught Mk.I could easily be a just-so founding narrative element of the Human Domain, a story about united struggle and hardship against an implacable Other with a shiny bit of military kit in center stage. An imagined avatar of the empire's holy trinity: military, industry, gate system.

Yet here that avatar appears, unbelievably far and wayward from the heart of the Human Domain - or even what was once the Domain's frontiers a thousand cycles ago.

Your ops chief, unperturbed, looks to you for confirmation. Words are unneeded, the question is clear: send in the salvors?
texts.zh:
它究竟存在了多久？成千上万个星历年？

如果在一个星历日前被问及，照理，你会称其为一个传说。攻势 Mk.I 很容易被当作 人之领 恰到好处的创世叙事元素 —— 一个关于团结抗争无情异族的艰辛故事，核心点缀着一件闪亮的军事装备。那是帝国三位一体的想象化身：军事、工业、星门系统。

然而这个化身此刻正现身于此，并难以置信地远离 人之领 的中心 —— 甚至比一千个星历年前的 人之领 边疆更加遥远荒僻。

你的行动长官神色如常，等待着你的确认。他的问题不言自明：是否要派遣打捞员们？

texts.en:
Ops nods, then turns to bark commands on the salvors' command frequency.

Junior officers scurry to cajole crew prepping cargo-handling drones while Sensors puts one analysis team on careful outward watch and another on the hulk to ensure there are no surprises.

Within short minutes, the first salvors dock their open-vacuum shuttle frames and utility drones at various entry points identified along the vessel's massive hull.

Ops gives the go-order.
texts.zh:
行动长点了点头，然后通过指挥频道向打捞员们下达命令。

下级军官动员着准备装卸无人机的船员，传感器技官则分派一队分析小组严密监视外围，一队留守残骸应对意外。

几分钟后，第一批打捞小组驾驶着真空穿梭机和辅助无人机，在巨大船体上预选的各个入口处就位。

行动长下达了行动指令。

texts.en:
You notice your comms officer furiously working their interface, then turn and call a report to you.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam! Salvor-four is picking up something on an open frequency- um, radio-only. Very low power. Some kind of analogue encoding? We did this in... training..."

A few more taps, and a message is formed from noise, letter by letter, across your display.
texts.zh:
你注意到通讯军官正忙着操作界面，然后转身向你汇报。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam！第四打捞小组在一个开放频率上接收到信号 —— 呃，仅限无线电频率。功率很低，像是某种模拟编码？我们在...训练中遇到过这种情况..."

又敲了几下，嘈杂的噪声中，一条信息在屏幕上逐字逐句地排列起来。

texts.en:
This gives your officers pause - Ops calls a hold order while the situation is assessed. Internal self-defense systems activating? War-drone deployment?

Only silence.

Then acoustics picks up a few taps as salvors secure themselves to bulkheads, powering down their tools and, no doubt, reaching for what small-arms they do carry.

Still, no movement.

Low, steady EM activity - just the repeater, a chorus of them in fact, mechanically intoning the same message to one another.
texts.zh:
这让军官们犹豫起来 —— 行动长下达了暂停指令，等待态势评估。自卫系统启动？战斗无人机部署？

一片寂静。

随后，声学设备捕捉到几声轻敲，那是打捞员们正在舱壁上固定自己，关闭电子工具，以及毫无疑问的，掏出随身的小型武器。

仍然没有任何动静。

低而稳定的电磁活动 —— 只有中继器，一群中继器的合唱，机械地向彼此发出相同的信息。

texts.en:
Fevered analysis proceeds. In the midst of what appears to be structured noise buried in the analog waveform - datasets which are insensible without context - analysis teams discover a set of coordinates; a position at some distance from the small gravity well you're orbiting in archaic but parseable Domain astrogation units. The message still repeats itself.

"The signal is weak," your sensors officer says. "Unlikely to be picked up by anything that isn't in close-order formation with the... the hull. Tactical telemetry to coordinate distributed systems?"
texts.zh:
分析工作火热地进行着。在看似结构性噪音的模拟波形深处 —— 那些缺乏上下文便无法理解的数据集 —— 分析团队发现了一组坐标；一个用古老但可解析的 人之领 天文导航单位标注的位置，与你正在环绕的小型重力井保持着一定距离。信号仍在持续重复着。

"信号很微弱，" 你的传感器技官说道，"除非与...船体保持密集编队，否则任何设备都难以捕捉。是协调分布式系统的战术遥测信号吗？"

texts.en:
Cautiously, team by team, your operations chief reactivates exploration and assessment of the hulk.

Bafflingly crude automation is wormed throughout the ship, whispering to itself. Interfaces are built on familiar fundamental principles, but aesthetically red-shifted, seemingly from an alien culture.

What records remain are damaged where they aren't missing entirely. The logs tell of aeons of war in the darkness between the stars. Human crew in and out of cryo, continually diminished, replaced by the augmented wounded, then the cyborg rebuilds, and then, and then... this exhausted humming, clicking thing threaded throughout the ship.
texts.zh:
慎之又慎，一队接一队，你的行动主管重启了对残骸的勘探与评估。

令人费解的原始自动化系统在整艘舰船中蔓延，低声自语。交互设施用熟悉的基本原理而构成，但其设计美学发生了红移，仿佛源自异界文明。

残存的记录大多损坏，或干脆完全缺失。那些日志诉说着恒星间黑暗深渊里绵延万古的战争。人类船员在低温休眠中进进出出，持续减员，先由强化过的伤员接替，然后是机械和生物的重构体，再然后，再然后...只剩下这遍布舰体、精疲力竭的嗡鸣声与咔嗒声。

texts.en:
The logs are empty for long periods- dark, hibernating leaps. Then there is a noted uptick in activity less than 200 standard cycles ago. The enemy is only identified as "Threat". A datastore reference leads to blocks of information decayed by time. But the reconstruction algorithms leap into action and, despite troublingly low reliability ratings, sew together a set of files.

Patch notes.

The hardware specs are arcane, the software obtuse and plagued by null library calls, but the common language of human mathematics sketches out the intent. There, your technology officer's team assembles a new spec of the sensor modifications required to detect this "Threat".

Adapting these requirements on your relatively modern systems is a far easier task than the labors described by the ancients.
texts.zh:
日志存在多段很长时间的空白 —— 应该是停止活动的休眠期。在接下来在距今 200 个标准星历年之内，活动记录出现了显著激增。敌人仅被标识为 "威胁"。数据存储索引指向的几个信息块已经被时间侵蚀损坏。但随着重建算法的介入，一组文件还是被拼凑了出来，尽管可靠性评级低得令人不安。

补丁说明。

虽然硬件配置写得晦涩难懂，一团糟的软件里还充斥着无效库调用，但人类数学的通用语言还是勾勒出了设计意图。凭借那些，你的技术军官团队整合出一套探测此 "威胁" 所需的新传感器改装需求方案。

将这些需求方案适配到你相对现代的系统上，远比古人描述的艰巨工程要轻松得多。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, I'm not sure it's working." Your sensors officer speaks, standing at a control console to demonstrate a first test of the adaptations. Line after line is dumped into an output log.

The characters sprout and repeat. Your technology officer's face is underlit by their glow.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam ，我不确定它是否起效了。" 你的传感器技官站在控制台前说道，一边展示着适配方案的首次测试。一行行字符不断灌入输出日志。

那些符号不断涌现、重复，你的技术军官的脸庞也被它们的光芒所照亮。

texts.en: "I think it's working." Their words are almost a whisper.
texts.zh: "I think it's working." Their words are almost a whisper.

texts.en: "Got a long-range hit..." Sensors reports. "Something is approaching our orbit. Without maneuvers we have one shift? Two? Half a day, max. What are your orders, $playerSirOrMadam?"
texts.zh: "远距接触..." 传感器技官报告。"有什么东西正高速向我们靠近，不进行规避的话我们会在一两个...不对，最多半个星历日的时间相遇。$playerSirOrMadam？你的命令是？"

texts.en: "Got a long-range hit..." Sensors reports. "Something is approaching our orbit. Without maneuvers we have one shift? Two? Half a day, max."
texts.zh: "远距接触..." 传感器技官报告。"有什么东西正高速向我们靠近，不进行规避的话我们会在一两个...不对，最多半个星历日的时间相遇。"

texts.en:
Academician Elek could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

It's too big, too dangerous for a pretentious, if bombastic, academic like Elek to have stumbled upon himself. And based on what you know from the sensor array data, it was someone else's project entirely around 200 cycles ago.

Someone long dead. Probably.
texts.zh:
Elek 院士不可能预料到他的传感器数据会导致...这种情况，对吧？

这玩意太大了，也太危险了，像 Elek 这样自命不凡、甚至有些夸夸其谈的学者，不可能是自己偶然发现。而且，根据你从传感器阵列数据中了解到的情况来看，它在大约 200 个星历年前属于别人的项目。

或许，那个人早就死了。

texts.en:
Academician Elek could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

It's too big, too dangerous for a pretentious, if bombastic, academic like Elek to have stumbled upon himself. And based on what you know from the sensor array data, it was someone else's project entirely around 200 cycles ago.

Someone long dead. Probably.
texts.zh:
Elek 院士绝不可能料到，他那份传感器数据竟会引向...这般境地。真的不可能吗？

这东西太大、太危险，不像是 Elek 这种自命不凡、又爱夸夸其谈的学者能独自撞上的。而据你从传感器阵列数据里得知的情况，大约 200 个周期之前，它完全是另一个人主导的项目。

一个早已作古的人。多半如此。

texts.en:
This Academician Elek of the Galatia Academy could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

You might be justified to ask him with an urgency proportional to the magnitude of the situation you now find yourself in.

Only if you manage to survive this 'Threat' and make it back to the Core Worlds, of course.
texts.zh:
这位来自 Galatia 学院的 Elek 院士，不可能预料到他的传感器数据会导致...这种情况，对吧？

鉴于你现在所处的境地如此危急，你或许有理由迫切地向他询问此事。

当然，前提是你能从这场 '威胁' 中幸存下来，并返回核心星区。

texts.en:
Your sensors officer finally suppresses the new detector's alerts, then turns to you. The Onslaught Mk.I rotates threateningly in the primary display, an avatar of ancient violence.

"What are your orders, $playerSirOrMadam?" they ask.
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官终于控制住了新探测器的警报，然后转向你。主显示屏上，攻势 Mk.I 威胁性地旋转着，仿佛是远古暴力的化身。

"你有什么指示，$playerSirOrMadam？" 对方问道。

texts.en: You can only speculate what Tri-Tachyon thought they were setting you up to find using him as a front. It might be nice to find out.
texts.zh: 你只能猜测 速子科技 想利用他作为幌子，进而期望你找到些什么。或许查明真相会很有意思。

texts.en: You can only speculate what Director Glamor-Rotanev and Tri-Tachyon thought they were setting you up to find using him as a front. It might be nice to find out.
texts.zh: 你只能猜测 Glamor-Rotanev 总监和 速子科技 想利用他作为幌子，进而期望你找到些什么。或许查明真相会很有意思。

texts.en: You can only speculate what his 'patron' thought they were setting you up to find, using him as a front. It might be nice to find out. If you make it out of this alive, a pointed word with Elek about the identity of his patron might be in order.
texts.zh: 你只能猜测他的 "赞助人" 究竟想让你通过他这个幌子发现什么。若能查明真相倒也不错。你应该和 Elek 好好谈谈那赞助人的身份，前提是你能活着离开这里。

texts.en:
It's too big, too dangerous for him to have stumbled upon himself. And based on what you know from the sensor array data, it was originally someone else's project entirely... around 200 cycles ago.

Someone long dead. Probably.
texts.zh:
它太大了，也太危险了，不像是他能自己偶然发现的。而且根据你从传感器阵列数据中了解到的情况，这原本属于别人的项目...在大约 200 个星历年前。

也许，那个人早就死了。

Your sensors officer finally suppresses the new detector's alerts, then turns to you. The Onslaught Mk.I rotates threateningly in the primary display, an avatar of ancient violence.

"What are your orders, $playerSirOrMadam?" they ask.

你的传感器技官终于控制住了新探测器的警报，然后转向你。主显示屏上，攻势 Mk.I 威胁性地旋转着，仿佛是远古暴力的化身。

"你有什么指示，$playerSirOrMadam？" 对方问道。

texts.en:
You request a salvage plan, giving due consideration to the likely difficulty of your request.

Before long, you hear back from your chief engineer - mumbling something about not being a miracle worker to someone offscreen before noticing you've accepted the link request.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They have the self-awareness to look appropriately embarassed but the professionalism not to let it interrupt a report. "With apologies, no can do. It'd take days just to catalogue all the different critical-level defects. This hull is destined for the scrappers, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh:
你要求拿出一份打捞方案，并充分考虑这一请求多半有多棘手。

没多久，你的轮机长回了话 —— 察觉到你已接通链接之前，还正冲着画面外什么人嘟囔自己又不是能起死回生的神仙。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。\" 对方还算有自知之明，露出恰到好处的窘态，却又职业地没让这打断汇报，\"恕难从命，长官。光是把各种致命级别的故障清点一遍就得花上好几天。这船壳注定是进拆解场的命，$playerSirOrMadam。"

哦，人类
    将彼之恶归于彼手

    吾必将刻出如人类般分离的一体

options.zh: 我有你们要的行星杀手。

texts.en:
$PersonName's hands go together and $heOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes, mumbling what sounds like thanks to Providence.

"I confess, captain, I did not expect you to return," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
$PersonName双手合十，闭上了自己的双眼，一边喃喃自语着，听起来像是在感谢天意。

"我承认，舰长，我没想到你会回来，" $heOrShe说道。

options.en: Make arrangements to turn it over
Isn't it useless without the codes?
options.zh: 没有密码的话，它不就是一块废铁？

options.en: I want you to promise you're not going to use this on people.
options.zh: 我要你保证你们不会对人们使用这个东西。

texts.en:
You coordinate with the Pather to have the planetkiller transferred to their keeping.

"This is a praiseworthy act, $playerSirOrMadam, in service of Ludd's vision - twisted and dark though the Path we walk together be."

"Word of your... cooperation shall be spread among the True Faithful." $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together once more. "Holy peace be upon you $playerName, until the End of Days when all shall be judged."
texts.zh:
你与左径分子协调配合，把行星杀手移交给他们保管。

"你的行为值得赞扬，$playerSirOrMadam，你为卢德的愿景服务 —— 尽管我等的卢德之径将会如此黑暗，如此扭曲。"

"你的... 合作将由那些真正忠诚的人口口相传。" $HeOrShe再次将双手合十，"愿神圣的和平降临于你，$playerName，直到末日，直到一切受到审判之时。"

texts.en: "Not so useless as you might think," $heOrShe says. "It is a God-cursed totem, a demonic thing feared and worshipped by heretics. There is power-" $heOrShe stops $himOrHerself, realizing that despite $hisOrHer excitement, it is best not to speak too openly of The Path's plans.
texts.zh: "并不像你想的那样无用，" $heOrShe说道，"这是一个被造物主诅咒的图腾，是异端害怕和崇拜的恶魔。它拥有力量 —— " $heOrShe克制住了自己。你意识到了尽管$heOrShe很兴奋，但还是不要太过公开地谈论左径的计划。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe stares at you for a long moment. "You know as well as I that I could easily lie to you, one way or the other; I am no saint. Let us not waste time play-acting."

"A weapon is a threat as much as it is a weapon. You know this as well as I. If, truly, I professed that it would never be used, and I was believed, then it is no longer a threat." $HeOrShe pauses, then continues. "-Only a weapon. Which is all the more dangerous, don't you think?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe凝视了你好一会儿才开口。"你和我都很清楚，我对你撒谎简直易如反掌。毕竟借口这么多，而我又非圣贤。所以我们就别浪费时间演戏了。"

"武器可以成为一种威慑，也能成为一件凶器。你对这方面的了解应该不比我差。假如我发自内心地宣称它永远不会被使用，而且大家都相信我，那么它就不再是一种威慑。" $HeOrShe顿了顿，继续说道，"—— 那它就只能成为一件凶器了。这种情况显然对我们大家来说都更加危险，你不觉得吗？"

options.en: I'd like to discuss planetkiller weapons.
options.zh: 我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。

texts.en: $PersonRank $personLastName's face tightens. "I do not have the time or inclination to re-debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. If you have no other pressing business, then let us conclude this conversation."
texts.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸绷紧了。"我没有时间也没有兴趣重新争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长。如果您没有其他紧急事务，那就让我们到此为止吧。"

texts.en: Admiral Rao's face tightens. "I do not have the inclination to debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. Nor discuss certain mutinous former officers of the Hegemony and their crimes."
texts.zh: 海军上将 Rao 的脸绷紧了。"我不想争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长，也不讨论某些叛变的前 霸主 军官及其罪行。"

options.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
options.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

options.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
options.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

texts.en:
The Hegemony $post's eyes go wide, and $heOrShe says "I... I see. We will need to send a technical team to confirm your claim. And bring the weapon in for safekeeping."

Skepticism remains in $hisOrHer tone, but it seems more of a fading hope that you are lying than actual disbelief.
texts.zh:
霸主 $post 瞪大了眼睛，而后说道："我... 我明白了。我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，并将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

$hisOrHer的语气里充满了怀疑，但比起真的不相信你，听起来更像是某种微弱的希望 —— 那人希望你只是在撒谎。

texts.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow, surprised; but not surprised, somehow. "I see."

"I suppose I should say 'Well done'," he says with a sigh. "We shall need to send a technical team to confirm your claim - and bring the weapon in for safekeeping, of course."

A note of skepticism remains in his tone, but you've certainly got his attention.
texts.zh:
海军上将 Rao 惊讶地扬起眉毛；但不知为何，他看上去也没有那么惊奇。"我明白了。"

"我想我应该说声 '做得好'，" 上将叹了口气，"我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，当然也要将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

他的语气中仍然带有怀疑的意味，但可以肯定的是，你已经引起了他的注意。

options.en: Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities.
options.zh: 当然。向有关当局提交违禁武器是每个公民的责任。

options.en: Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do.
options.zh: 你不认为这样的诚实值得奖励吗？500,000 星币就可以了。

texts.en:
"Your dedication and service are to be commended! I personally salute your dedication to the mission of the Hegemony to protect humanity and its habitable environs, as per the vision of the first High Hegemon Kali Molina who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

You would swear that $personName is posing for the recording of the comms-feed.
texts.zh:
"你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！我以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

texts.en:
"You are to be commended for your dedication and service, $playerName!"

"As a commissioned auxiliary, you have pledged yourself to the cause of the Hegemony, but I would like to take this moment to personally salute your dedication to protecting humanity and its habitable environs according to the vision of the first High Hegemon, Kali Molina, who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

$HeOrShe, in fact, salutes you.

You would swear that $personName is putting on a show for the recording of the comms-feed.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！"

"作为一名现役辅助军，你已经宣誓效忠于 霸主 的事业，但我仍以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

$HeOrShe本人直接向你敬了个礼。

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

texts.en: Regardless, the wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis. A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
texts.zh: 无论如何，霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

texts.en:
The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.

A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
texts.zh:
霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

texts.en:
The reward is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller, one assumes, shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere.
texts.zh:
报酬被打到了你的账户里，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

texts.en:
A reward above and beyond your commission payment is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere. One assumes.

"For the Restoration!" $heOrShe  says triumphantly. "And burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
除了佣金，还有一笔奖励被打进你的账户，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

"为了 人之领 的复兴！" $heOrShe昂首挺胸地说道，"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Of course," the $rank grits $hisOrHer teeth. "It is... policy... to incentivize the safety of all citizens within Hegemony space."

"I shall have to confirm your exceptional," $heOrShe lets the word sink in, "request with a superior officer. Of course."
texts.zh:
"当然，" $rank 咬牙切齿地说道，"奖励有助于 霸主 疆域内全体公民安全生活的行为... 符合... 政策。"

"我必须确认您的 '特殊' 请求，" $heOrShe着重强调了 "特殊" 二字，"当然，还得有上级确认。"

texts.en:
"Of course," the $rank grits $hisOrHer teeth. "It is official policy to incentivize the safety of all citizens within Hegemony space."

"I shall have to confirm your exceptional," $heOrShe lets the word sink in, "request with Central Command. Of course."
texts.zh:
"当然，" $rank 咬牙切齿地说道，"奖励有助于 霸主 疆域内全体公民安全生活的行为符合官方政策。"

"我必须确认您的 '特殊' 请求，" $heOrShe着重强调了 "特殊" 二字，"当然，还得有上级确认。"

options.en: Of course. I await that confirmation.
It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward.
options.zh: 这只是我一个想法。我当然会把行星杀手无偿交给你。

It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward.
options.zh: 这只是我一个想法。我当然会把行星杀手无偿交给你。

texts.en:
Although $PersonRank $personName seems personally displeased with your mercenary demand, $hisOrHer superior appears to have no objections.

The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.
texts.zh:
尽管 $PersonRank $personName 个人似乎对你在有一份佣金的情况下还提出这样的要求感到不满，但$hisOrHer的上级似乎没有反对意见。

霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

texts.en:
Although $PersonRank $personName seems personally displeased with your mercenary demand, Central Command appears to have no objections.

The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.
texts.zh:
尽管 $PersonRank $personName 个人似乎对你在有一份佣金的情况下还提出这样的要求感到不满，但指挥部似乎没有意见。

霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

texts.en:
The Hegemony tech-team verifies your claim of having possession of a planetkiller, and when the credits-transfer comes in, they remove the weapon from your $shipOrFleet.

"If all citizens were as dutiful as you, $playerSirOrMadam, I would soon be out my operating budget," $personName says coolly. "Good day."
texts.zh:
霸主 的技术团队证实了你持有行星杀手的说法，在星币到账时，他们就把这件武器运出了你的$shipOrFleet。

"如果所有公民都像你一样 '尽职尽责' ，$playerSirOrMadam，我很快就会花光我的部队预算。" $personName 冷淡地说。"祝好。"

texts.en: "Naturally, citizen." Your backing down seems to put $himOrHer into a better mood; $heOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat, putting a bit of unpleasantness behind $himOrHer.
texts.zh: "这是当然，公民。" 你的让步似乎让$himOrHer心情好了一些。$heOrShe清了清自己的嗓子，把一些不愉快抛之脑后。

texts.en: $PersonRank $personLastName's face tightens. "I do not have the time or inclination to re-debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. If you have no other pressing business, then let us conclude this conversation."
texts.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸绷紧了。"我没有时间也没有兴趣重新争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长。如果您没有其他紧急事务，那就让我们到此为止吧。"

options.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
options.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

texts.en: Admiral Rao's face tightens. "I do not have the inclination to debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. Nor discuss certain mutinous former officers of the Hegemony and their crimes."
texts.zh: 海军上将 Rao 的脸绷紧了。"我不想争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长，也不讨论某些叛变的前 霸主 军官及其罪行。"

options.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
options.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

texts.en:
The Hegemony $post's eyes go wide, and $heOrShe says "I... I see. We will need to send a technical team to confirm your claim. And bring the weapon in for safekeeping."

Skepticism remains in $hisOrHer tone, but it seems more of a fading hope that you are lying than actual disbelief.
texts.zh:
霸主 $post 瞪大了眼睛，而后说道："我... 我明白了。我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，并将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

$hisOrHer的语气里充满了怀疑，但比起真的不相信你，听起来更像是某种微弱的希望 —— 那人希望你只是在撒谎。

options.en: Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities.
options.zh: 当然。向有关当局提交违禁武器是每个公民的责任。

options.en: Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do.
options.zh: 你不认为这样的诚实值得奖励吗？500,000 星币就可以了。

texts.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow, surprised; but not surprised, somehow. "I see."

"I suppose I should say 'Well done'," he says with a sigh. "We shall need to send a technical team to confirm your claim - and bring the weapon in for safekeeping, of course."

A note of skepticism remains in his tone, but you've certainly got his attention.
texts.zh:
海军上将 Rao 惊讶地扬起眉毛；但不知为何，他看上去也没有那么惊奇。"我明白了。"

"我想我应该说声 '做得好'，" 上将叹了口气，"我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，当然也要将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

他的语气中仍然带有怀疑的意味，但可以肯定的是，你已经引起了他的注意。

options.en: Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities.
options.zh: 当然。向有关当局提交违禁武器是每个公民的责任。

options.en: Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do.
options.zh: 你不认为这样的诚实值得奖励吗？500,000 星币就可以了。

texts.en:
"Your dedication and service are to be commended! I personally salute your dedication to the mission of the Hegemony to protect humanity and its habitable environs, as per the vision of the first High Hegemon Kali Molina who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

You would swear that $personName is posing for the recording of the comms-feed.
texts.zh:
"你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！我以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

texts.en: Regardless, the wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis. A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
texts.zh: 无论如何，霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

texts.en:
The reward is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller, one assumes, shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere.
texts.zh:
报酬被打到了你的账户里，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

texts.en:
"You are to be commended for your dedication and service, $playerName!"

"As a commissioned auxiliary, you have pledged yourself to the cause of the Hegemony, but I would like to take this moment to personally salute your dedication to protecting humanity and its habitable environs according to the vision of the first High Hegemon, Kali Molina, who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

$HeOrShe, in fact, salutes you.

You would swear that $personName is putting on a show for the recording of the comms-feed.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！"

"作为一名现役辅助军，你已经宣誓效忠于 霸主 的事业，但我仍以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

$HeOrShe本人直接向你敬了个礼。

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

texts.en:
The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.

A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
texts.zh:
霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

texts.en:
A reward above and beyond your commission payment is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere. One assumes.

"For the Restoration!" $heOrShe  says triumphantly. "And burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
除了佣金，还有一笔奖励被打进你的账户，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

"为了 人之领 的复兴！" $heOrShe昂首挺胸地说道，"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Of course," the $rank grits $hisOrHer teeth. "It is... policy... to incentivize the safety of all citizens within Hegemony space."

"I shall have to confirm your exceptional," $heOrShe lets the word sink in, "request with a superior officer. Of course."
texts.zh:
"当然，" $rank 咬牙切齿地说道，"奖励有助于 霸主 疆域内全体公民安全生活的行为... 符合... 政策。"

"我必须确认您的 '特殊' 请求，" $heOrShe着重强调了 "特殊" 二字，"当然，还得有上级确认。"

options.en: Of course. I await that confirmation.
It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward.
options.zh: 这只是我一个想法。我当然会把行星杀手无偿交给你。

options.zh: 我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe puts on an expensive-looking smile. "I'm very sorry to say that we don't have any available for sale right now, but if you'd like to submit your contact information for the waitlist..."

"We also have a dazzling range of lower-yield weapons, including AM-catalyzed fusion devices with a proven track record in both civilian and private military contractor applications. I'd be more than happy to provide you with a catalog, including our Tri-Tachyon holo experience featuring a hand-curated selection of some of our most popular items."
texts.zh:
"啊，" $heOrShe摆出一副高贵的微笑。"我很遗憾我们现在并没有任何可供出售的物品，但如果您想提交您的联系方式来浏览其他商品... "

"我们还有一系列令人眼花缭乱的低当量武器，比如反物质催化聚变装置，在民用和私人军事承包商方面都有着良好的效用记录。我非常乐意为您提供一份目录，即使用我们的 速子科技 全息体验影像，其中包括我们亲自挑选的一些最受欢迎的物品。"

options.zh: 我不是来买的，我是来卖东西的。

options.en: I'll just take the catalog and be on my way.

texts.en:
"Oh!" $heOrShe exclaims, "Please accept my apologies, $playerSirOrMadam. It is not often that we find a, a supplier of such items."

$HeOrShe taps at something on a TriPad, and the cheerful business-persona turns its glow down a notch or three.

"If what you say is true - and we shall have to have a technician, ah, inspect the item before any payment is made - then rest assured that we shall deal with utmost secrecy. It's nothing more than Tri-Tachyon's guarantee to respect the privacy of our valued partners."
texts.zh:
"哦！" $heOrShe惊叫道，"请接受我的道歉，$playerSirOrMadam。我们并不经常遇到，呃，这种东西的供应商。"

$HeOrShe快速地在 TriPad 上点击着什么东西，同时欢快的贸易人格瞬间降低了几个档次。

"如果您说的是真的 —— 在付款之前，我们必须让一名技术人员，嗯，检查一下那个东西。请放心，我们会尽最大努力保密。这只不过是 速子科技 尊重我们宝贵合作伙伴的隐私的保障。"

options.en: How about I give you the planetkiller for no charge, and Tri-Tachyon will owe me a favor. A big favor.
options.zh: 我把行星杀手免费送你怎么样，这样 速子科技 就会欠我一个人情，一个大大的人情。
协商要求 500,000 星币的报酬

texts.en:
The expensive smiles appears once more, a part of a mask.

"I'm very sorry to say that such an arrangement will be impossible, $playerSirOrMadam. You must understand, of course, that we owe our shareholders - and I include myself among that esteemed group - we owe our shareholders quantifiable reports on investments and profits."

"An open-ended promise of that magnitude is, well..." $heOrShe searches for the word, and with a small look of disgust, finds it. "Unbusinesslike."
texts.zh:
那副高贵的笑容再一次像面具一样凝固在了$heOrShe的脸上。

"我很遗憾地说，这样的安排是不可能的，$playerSirOrMadam。当然了，您必须明白，我们 —— 指我和我的合作伙伴，都欠股东一份投资和利润的量化报告。"

"一个如此重大的开放式承诺是，嗯..." $heOrShe斟词着酌句，一边露出了恶心的表情，最终找到了$heOrShe想要的形容词，"非商业化的。"

texts.en:
$PersonName is eager to do business - presumably they will negotiate a finder's fee with the relevant VP for this find - and with Tri-Tachyon's deep pockets, it is not difficult to negotiate for a half million credits payment.

A small team of elite techs is shuttled to your $shipOrFleet to inspect the planetkiller. Your technical officer can barely refrain from asking questions about their advanced diagnostic tools, but the work is soon done and the deal confirmed.

You receive a small fortune, and the planetkiller disappears into the machinery of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
texts.zh:
$PersonName急切地想要促成这笔交易 —— 你推测对方将与相关副总裁就这一发现谈一笔中介费。并且，凭借 速子科技 的雄厚财力，支付 500,000 星币并不困难。

一支由精英技术人员组成的小组被派往你的$shipOrFleet，对行星杀手展开鉴定工作。你的技术军官几乎忍不住要就那些先进的鉴定仪器向他们发出疑问，但工作很快就完成了，交易也得到了确认。

你发了一笔小财，行星杀手则被喂进了 三一速子科技公司 这部巨大的企业机器之中，自此销声匿迹。

texts.en: "Here you are," $heOrShe says brightly, tapping at a TriPad. "I hope you'll choose to do business with us soon."
texts.zh: "发给您了，" $heOrShe高兴地说着，一边在 TriPad 上点来点去，"希望不久后您会选择与我们做生意。"

options.en: I have something that will be of great interest to the Lion of Sindria.
options.zh: 我有件辛达瑞亚之狮会非常感兴趣的东西。

texts.en: $HeOrShe barely raises an eyebrow, "And what is that?"
texts.zh: $HeOrShe几乎没有抬眼看你，"那是什么？"

options.zh: 一台完好无损的行星杀手。
哦，其实什么都没有。我口误了。

texts.en:
That seems to get $hisOrHer attention. "I see," $heOrShe says, eyes narrowed. "You shall surrender the alleged planetkiller device to my custody for... confirmation of your claims. It is, of course, illegal to possess such a weapon without the direct authorization of the Supreme Executor."

"This matter is quite delicate, you surely understand," $heOrShe says in a lower voice. "Imagine a repeat of the Opis Incident - the rebel terrorists blew up their own moon to vex Admiral Andrada's authority!"

In a conciliatory tone, $heOrShe adds, "I'll ensure you receive compensation, of course. 100,000 credits.
texts.zh:
这好像引起了$hisOrHer的注意。"我明白了。" $heOrShe眯起眼睛说，"你应该把你说的行星杀手交给我保管以... 证实你的说法。当然了，未经最高元首的直接授权，持有这种武器是非法的。"

"这件事很微妙，你肯定知道。" $heOrShe低声说道，"想象一下 Opis 事件重演 —— 反叛的恐怖分子炸毁了自己的卫星，以此来挑战 Andrada 上将的权威！"

$heOrShe安抚道，"当然，我保证你能得到补偿。10,000 星币。

options.en: Gladly, and at once, for the glory of Supreme Executor!
options.zh: 乐意之至，我立刻照办，为了最高元首的荣耀！

options.en: A planetkiller is worth at least 500,000 credits to your glorious Lion.
options.zh: 对你那荣耀的狮王来说，一台行星杀手至少值 500,000 星币。

options.en: A planetkiller is worth at least a pristine Executor-class battleship, don't you think?
options.zh: 一台行星杀手至少值一艘全新的 执行官-级 战列舰，你不这样认为吗？

texts.en:
You comply with the $rank's request, allowing a technical team to board your $shipOrFleet to inspect and remove the planetkiller.

The Diktat $rank beams. "The Lion is generous to those that serve his Great Movement and I- you are sure to be recognized for your small contribution to his Final Victory. A weapon such as this... it will ensure the reign of the Sindrian Diktat for a thousand cycles!"

With a final satisfied grin, $heOrShe turns to shut off the comms, halts, then touches $hisOrHer forehead. "I almost forgot- your payment."

A tap at a datapad. "See? Both of us may be rewarded by service to the Supreme Executor."
texts.zh:
你遵照 $rank 的要求，允许一支技术小队登上你的$shipOrFleet来检查并带走行星杀手。

辛达强权 $rank 眉开眼笑。"狮王对那些为他的伟大事业服务的人很慷慨，并且我 —— 你，肯定会因为你为他的最终胜利做出的小小贡献而得到认可。"

最后，带着满意的笑容，$heOrShe正要关闭通讯链接，却又停顿了一下，然后拍了拍自己额头。"我差点忘了你的报酬。" $heOrShe在数据平板上轻轻一点，"看到了吗？咱们两个都会因服务于最高元首而得到奖励。"

texts.en:
You comply enthusiastically to the $rank's request, welcoming a technical team to board your $shipOrFleet to inspect and remove the planetkiller.

The Diktat $rank follows your lead to espouse enthusiastic admiration for the Supreme Executor. "The Lion is generous to those who serve his Great Movement and Eternal Vision! A weapon such as this... it will ensure the reign of the Sindrian Diktat for a thousand cycles! You and I are sure to be recognized and rewarded," here, $heOrShe gives a wink, "for our contributions to his Final Victory. Ah, let's add a little to that reward; the Movement serves those who serve it, don't you agree?"

$HeOrShe produces a satisfied smile, leaving this hanging as a rhetorical question as $heOrShe signs off to see the planetkiller turned over to some secret arsenal or other.
texts.zh:
你热情地履行了 $rank 的要求，欢迎一支技术小队登上你的$shipOrFleet来检查并带走行星杀手。

辛达强权 $rank 紧随其后，表达了自己对最高元首的热烈钦佩。"狮王对那些为他的伟大事业和永恒愿景服务的人很慷慨！你和我肯定会得到认可和奖励。" 这时，$heOrShe向你眨了眨眼，"为我们对他的最终胜利做出的贡献。啊，我们干脆把赏金加倍吧，辛达强权为那些服务于它的人服务，你认可吗？"

$HeOrShe露出满意的笑容，把这个问题留作一句反问，一边目送行星杀手被送进某个秘密武器库。

texts.en:
"Outrageous!" $heOrShe shouts, "I should have you arraigned for subversion for even suggesting such a thing! You... you are personally betraying the Supreme Executor's vision!"

The Diktat $Rank takes a breath, then summons as much menace as they are capable of; "Surrender the planetkiller. Immediately."
texts.zh:
"岂有此理！" $heOrShe吼道，"光凭你竟敢提出这种要求这一点，我就应当以颠覆罪将你立马传唤！你... 你这是亲自背叛了最高元首描绘下的伟大愿景！"

辛达强权 $Rank 深吸了一口气，然后竭尽全力威胁道，"交出行星杀手，马上！"

options.en: Funny, I don't recall pledging loyalty to Andrada. The price is still 500,000 credits.
options.zh: 有趣，我可不记得我对 Andrada 宣誓效忠过。我的要价还是 500,000 星币。

texts.en: "Your selfishness and greed will not be forgotten, $playerName."
texts.zh: "你的自私和贪婪将不会被忘记，$playerName。"

texts.en:
"Outrageous!" $heOrShe shouts, "I should have you arraigned for subversion for even suggesting such a thing! You... you are personally betraying the Supreme Executor's vision!"

The Diktat $Rank takes a breath, then summons as much menace as they are capable of; "Surrender the planetkiller. Immediately."

"岂有此理！" $heOrShe吼道，"光凭你竟敢提出这种要求这一点，我就应当以颠覆罪将你立马传唤！你... 你这是亲自背叛了最高元首描绘下的伟大愿景！"

辛达强权 $Rank 深吸了一口气，然后竭尽全力威胁道，"交出行星杀手，马上！"

options.en: My price stands. If you take a moment to use your brain I think you'll find it quite reasonable.
options.zh: 我的要价不变。如果你花点时间动动脑子，我想你会发现这很合理。

options.en: My price stands. Oh, and make sure not a trace of your Lion's 'special' modifications remains.
options.zh: 我的要价不变。哦，还请确保把你家狮心卫队的那些 '特殊' 改造给拆干净。

texts.en:
The Diktat $Rank's face turns an odd shade of red, and $heOrShe breathes heavily. But something in your words seems to take.

"I must consult my superior," $heOrShe says through gritted teeth, then slams the comms-hold.

You take a minute to watch the crest of the Sindrian Diktat spinning over implausible propaganda-holos of the Lion of Sindria's greatest victories.
texts.zh:
辛达强权 $Rank 的脸红得相当别扭，就连$heOrShe喘出来的气都粗重了不少，但你的提议在其看来似乎仍旧有些道理。

"我必须请示我的上级。" $heOrShe咬牙切齿地说，然后猛地挂掉了通讯链接。

你盯着旋转的 辛达强权 徽标看了一会，徽标后面一直播放着鼓吹辛达瑞亚之狮最伟大胜利的全息宣传影像，宣传内容却难说有多少说服力。

texts.en:
An image of soldiers in power armor marching to the cheers of the 'liberated' citizens of Volturn is interrupted by the cowed-looking Diktat $Rank.

"My superior approved your... request," $heOrShe says, looking like $heOrShe ate something rotten. "It'll take one week to make the arrangements. Return to me then to complete the trade."

"I will add that, against my personal wishes, nearby patrols have received the... suggestion... to tolerate your presence."

With that said, $heOrShe slams the comms shutoff.
texts.zh:
面前的图像中，Volturn 上身着动力装甲的士兵正在 '获得解放' 的人民的欢呼致意中列队前行。而很快那个辛达强权 $Rank 就带着一副刚被训斥过的神色接入了通讯。

"我的上级批准了你那些...请求。" $heOrShe说道，脸色就像吃了条虫子般难看，"我们需要{一个星期}的时间来安排，到时候再回来敲定这笔交易。"

"另外，尽管这并非我本意，但附近的巡逻队已经都接到了...容忍你存在的...建议。"

说完这句话，$heOrShe狠狠挂掉了通讯链接。

texts.en:
An image of soldiers marching to the cheers of the 'liberated' citizens of Volturn is interrupted by the cowed-looking Diktat $Rank.

"My superior approved your... your demeaning extortion," $heOrShe says with a face like $heOrShe has eaten something rotten. "It'll take one week to make the arrangements. Return then to complete the trade."

"I will add that, against my personal recommendation that you be arrested and executed as a terrorist, nearby patrols have received the... suggestion... to tolerate your presence."

With that said, $heOrShe slams the comms shutoff.
texts.zh:
面前的图像中，Volturn 上被 '解放' 的人民们正在向着列队行军的士兵欢呼致意。而很快那个辛达强权 $Rank 就带着一副刚被训斥过的神色接入了通讯。

"我的上级批准了你那些...有辱人格的勒索。" $heOrShe说道，脸色就像吃了条虫子般难看，"我们需要{一个星期}的时间来安排，到时候再回来敲定这笔交易。"

"另外，就我个人而言，我更愿意把你当作恐怖分子来逮捕并处决。但附近的巡逻队都收到了...容忍你存在的...建议。"

说完这句话，$heOrShe狠狠挂掉了通讯链接。

texts.en:
The Diktat $Rank gives you a funny look.

"Spacers," $heOrShe says under $hisOrHer breath.
texts.zh:
辛达强权 $Rank 向你投来了一个古怪的眼神。

"死太空佬。" $heOrShe低声抱怨了一句，几乎没让你听见。

texts.en:
"It's ready," $heOrShe says, sneering. "The Executor-class battleship, a thing of beauty and vision that you will never understand."

$HeOrShe slams a comms-cutoff, leaving a confused but unquestioningly loyal junior officer to make the actual arrangements. A technical team takes possession of the planetkiller and remove it from your $shipOrFleet into the custody of the Sindrian Diktat.

Andrada only knows what will be done with it.
texts.zh:
"一切就绪了。" $heOrShe语气讥讽，"执行官-级 战列舰，此等尤物的精美绝伦就凭你可永远都品味不出来。"

$HeOrShe旋即切断了通讯链接，留下一名虽然困惑但忠诚无疑的下级军官来做出实际安排。一支技术小队接管了行星杀手，并把它从你的$shipOrFleet移送给 辛达强权 保管。

只有 Andrada 才知道它以后派得上怎样的用场。

options.zh: 我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。

texts.en: "There is little to say," $PersonName says, frowning. "They are an abomination to all that is holy and good. Their mere existence is a crime against humanity and God alike."
texts.zh: "这没什么好说的，" $PersonName 皱眉说到，"它们是对一切圣洁良善之物的亵渎。它们仅是存在，便是对人类与神犯下的罪过。"

options.en: I wish to give a planetkiller into the custody of the Church.
options.zh: 我希望把一个行星杀手置于教会的监管下。

options.en: Er, good to know. I'll try to avoid them.
options.zh: 啊，好吧，我会尽量避开它们的。

texts.en:
"What?!" $HeOrShe draws back in shock, "I pray that you are merely a liar making a joke in poor taste. If indeed you did possess such a demonic artifact, I would implore you to take it far from this place and destroy it, immediately! Or, or, the Knights will deal with you!"

"Speak not to me," $heOrShe says, face red, then slams the comms shut-off.
texts.zh:
"什么？！" $HeOrShe震惊地向后退去，"我祈祷你只是个编造蹩脚笑话的骗子。假如你真的持有此等魔物，我恳求你立刻将其远远带离此地，或者将其毁灭！否，否则骑士团会来处置你的！"

"不要再和我说话了。" $heOrShe红着脸说道，随后重重地关闭了通讯链接。

texts.en: "Yes. Good." $HeOrShe examines you suspiciously. "Was there something you wished to discuss?"
texts.zh: "嗯，不错。" $HeOrShe满腹狐疑地打量着你，"你还有什么想讨论的吗？"

texts.en: "Begone from here!" $HeOrShe shouts, then hits the comms shut-off.
texts.zh: "从这里滚出去！" $HeOrShe吼道，随后关闭了通讯。

texts.en: "There is little to say," $PersonName says, frowning. "They are an abomination to all that is holy and good. Their mere existence is a crime against humanity and God alike."
texts.zh: "这没什么好说的，" $PersonName 皱眉说到，"它们是对一切圣洁良善之物的亵渎。它们仅是存在，便是对人类与神犯下的罪过。"

options.en: I wish to give a planetkiller into the custody of the Church.
options.zh: 我希望把一个行星杀手置于教会的监管下。

options.en: Er, good to know. I'll try to avoid them.
options.zh: 啊，好吧，我会尽量避开它们的。
